articles.title: SolarWM: Open Data and Scalable Training for Long-Horizon Video World Models
articles.content: We introduce SolarWM, a fully open foundation for building interactive video world models from data preparation through long-horizon inference. Training across heterogeneous data sources and video backbones is challenging: datasets differ in temporal scale, camera geometry, visual quality, motion, and captioning styles, while video generators use distinct representations and architectures. Naive data mixing and model-specific implementations therefore produce inconsistent supervision and make results difficult to reproduce and compare. SolarWM addresses this coupling with a reconfigurable multi-source data engine and a backbone-native adaptation framework. The engine converts 1.43 million canonical clips from 10 datasets into a unified, frame-aligned contract covering visual observations, metric camera geometry, captions, quality metadata, selection decisions, and provenance, while decoupling source processing from mixture construction. Under shared camera-conditioning, training, and inference interfaces, we instantiate four 5B--33B models based on Wan2.2, LTX-2.5, and MiniMax-H3 while preserving their native representations and objectives. A unified three-stage recipe combines bidirectional adaptation, teacher-forced autoregressive initialization, and distribution matching distillation. The resulting causal models enable real-time interaction over rollouts ranging from minutes to hours after being trained on only 5s sequences. By releasing the resulting data, pipeline, recipes, weights, and framework, SolarWM provides a reproducible and extensible foundation for interactive world-model research.

articles.title_zh: SolarWM:长视视频世界模型的开放数据和可扩展培训
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍了SolarWM,这是从数据准备到长视距推论建立交互式视频世界模型的完全开放的基础. 不同数据来源和视频主干线的培训具有挑战性:数据集在时间尺度、相机几何、视觉质量、运动和字幕样式方面各不相同,而视频生成器则使用不同的表示和架构。 因此,自然数据混合和具体模式的实施造成监管不一致,结果难以复制和比较。 SolarWM用可重新配置的多源数据引擎和骨干本土适应框架来处理这种耦合. 引擎将10个数据集的143万条光子剪辑转换成一个统一,帧相配的合同,涵盖视觉观测,度量相机几何,标题,质量元数据,选择决定,以及出处,同时将源处理与混合构造脱钩. 在共享的相机空调,培训和推论接口下,我们以Wan2.2,LTX-2.5,和MiniMax-H3为基础,对四种5B-33B型号进行即时处理,同时保留其本土代表和目标. 统一的三阶段配方结合了双向适应,教师强制的自旋初始化,以及分布匹配的蒸馏. 由此产生的因果模型使得在推广后能够进行实时互动,在只接受5s序列培训后从几分钟到几小时不等。 通过释放所产生的数据、管道、食谱、权重和框架,SolarWM为交互式世界模型研究提供了可复制和可扩展的基础。

articles.title: Thinking in Pictures: A Systematic Benchmark for Reasoning-driven Image Generation
articles.content: Recent advancements in unified generative models (UGMs) and world simulators have achieved unprecedented results in visual perception and synthesis. However, these models primarily rely on surface-level event alignment, leaving the capacity for high-level visual reasoning underexplored. True visual generative intelligence demands "Reasoning-to-Generation", an ability to infer latent rules from visual inputs and manifest solutions through precise, logically constrained visual outcomes. We introduce RIG-BENCH, a novel comprehensive benchmark that systematically evaluates Reasoning-driven Image Generation (RIG) across four cognitively demanding domains: Concept-based, Transformation-based, Pattern & Structure, and Scenario-based. Featuring 2000 curated samples, RIG-BENCH serves as a rigorous stress test for RIG. Our extensive evaluations of state-of-the-art UGMs and image/video generation models reveal a significant reasoning-generation gap, wherein models frequently produce locally plausible but globally illogical outputs. RIG-BENCH provides a vital diagnostic framework to guide the development of next-generation, logically grounded UGMs and world simulators.

articles.title_zh: 图片中的思考:理性驱动图像生成的系统基准
articles.content_zh: 最近统一基因模型(UGMS)和世界模拟器的进步在视觉感知和合成上取得了前所未有的成果. 然而,这些模型主要依靠地表级事件对齐,使得高水平视觉推理的能力被低估. 真实的视觉基因智能需要"对基因的共振"(Reasoning-to-Generation),一种通过精确的,逻辑上受限制的视觉结果从视觉输入和表征解决方案中推断潜在规则的能力. 我们引入RIG-BENCH,这是一个全新的综合基准,它系统地评价理性驱动的图像生成(RIG),涉及四个认知要求高的领域:概念、转型、模式和结构以及情景。 RIG-BENCH为2000年的试样配制,是对RIG的严格压力测试. 我们对最新技术的UGM和图像/视频生成模型的广泛评价表明,在推理生成过程中存在重大差距,模型经常在当地产生合理但却不符合全球逻辑的产出。 RIG-BENCH提供了一个至关重要的诊断框架,用以指导下一代、有逻辑基础的UGM和世界模拟器的发展。

articles.title: PlantC2USeg: Cross-Scale Consistent Pre-Training for Few-Shot Unified Plant Point Cloud Segmentation
articles.content: Modern crop breeding demands precise organ-level analysis for trait quantification, making plant point cloud segmentation (PPCS) increasingly important. However, conventional deep learning approaches rely heavily on densely annotated datasets that are labor-intensive to acquire. Unified PPCS adaptation from distribution-shifted examples with minimal additional training remains challenging. To address this, we propose PlantC2USeg, a deep transfer learning framework featuring cross-scale consistency learning to explicitly align features across spatial scales and an information-restricted decoding strategy that prevents reconstruction shortcuts and promotes robust adaptation. The resulting pre-training enables stable few-shot generalization across species and sensing conditions, while unified fine-tuning with inherited thresholds further reduces adaptation overhead. Under full supervision on Soybean3D, PlantC2USeg achieves the highest semantic IoU and instance mWCov among compared methods, at 91.91% and 94.62%. With 20 labeled samples, it leads both metrics at 89.78% and 90.27%; with only 10 samples, it retains the highest mWCov of 83.23% while achieving 83.19% IoU. Across HR3D, 10-shot transfer to tobacco, tomato, and sorghum averages 78.41% IoU and 79.42% mWCov, while 22-shot transfer to SYAU-Maize achieves the highest IoU and mRec at 92.75% and 93.51%. Furthermore, a leading category-averaged mIoU of 85.0% on ShapeNet Part demonstrates the framework's capability to handle diverse shape variations beyond agricultural domains. These results demonstrate that PlantC2USeg reduces overall adaptation effort under distribution shifts, enabling scalable plant phenotyping and transferable 3D representation learning beyond agriculture.

articles.title_zh: PlantC2USeg:用于少部分热统一植物点云分化的跨尺度一致预训
articles.content_zh: 现代作物育种要求对特征量化进行精确的器官水平分析,使植物点云分化(PPCS)越来越重要. 然而,传统的深入学习方法严重依赖大量附加说明的数据集,而这些数据集是劳动力密集型的。 单一的PPCS调整办法仍然具有挑战性,需要从分配转移的事例中调整,并尽量减少额外培训。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议PlantC2USeg是一个深度转移学习框架,其特点是进行跨尺度的一致性学习,以明确协调不同空间尺度的特征,并采用信息限制的解码战略,防止重建捷径,促进有力的适应。 由此产生的预训可以使不同物种和感知条件之间稳定的几发一般化,而与继承阈值的统一微调则进一步减少适应性间接费用。 在大豆3D的全面监督下,PlantC2USeg在方法上实现了最高的语义IoU和例mWCov,分别为91.91%和94.62%。 它有20个标注样本,其标注量分别为89.78%和90.27%;只有10个标注,它保留了最高的mWCov,为83.23%,同时实现了83.19%的IoU. 横跨HR3D,10发转至烟草,番茄,高粱平均为78.41%IoU和79.42%mWCov;22发转至SYAU-Maize,达到最高的IoU和mRec,为92.75%和93.51%. 此外,ShapeNet部分的主要类别平均mIoU为85.0%,这表明该框架有能力处理农业领域以外的各种形状变化。 这些结果表明,PlantC2USeg减少了在分配转移下的总体适应努力,使可伸缩的植物麻黄和可转让的三维代表学习超越农业。

articles.title: MuyBridge: Mobile Human Center-of-Mass Estimation from Monocular Video via Sparse Fusion
articles.content: The 3D center of mass (CoM) is a primary quantity in the biomechanical analysis of sport, rehabilitation, and clinical movement, yet existing 3D pose tracking, mesh recovery, and multi-view triangulation methods either optimize 3D keypoint accuracy without anatomical constraints or carry compute and capture infrastructure too heavy to deploy where CoM tracking is most useful. As a result, the metric CoM remains difficult for coaches and movement analysts to measure from a single camera where athletes train and compete. In this work, we introduce MuyBridge, an on-device system that estimates the athlete's segmental center of mass trajectory from a single phone camera video stream. MuyBridge couples a compact 2D pose network and a distilled single-step monocular depth network through an analytic metric fusion that uses anatomical and physical priors to anchor the metric CoM, requiring no 3D or task-specific supervision. Evaluated on the athletic movements of AthletePose3D (running, track and field, and figure skating), MuyBridge achieves 33-41 mm vertical CoM error and 2.3-6.6% absolute-relative range error (AbsRel) under a one-time calibration, and produces CoM estimates at the 63 FPS pose-estimation rate using asynchronous 2.86 Hz depth updates on iPhone 15. Code is available at: https://github.com/Abradshaw1/Muybridge

articles.title_zh: MuyBridge:移动人类中心-来自单曲的马斯估计 通过 Sparse 组合的视频
articles.content_zh: 3D质量中心(CoM)是运动,康复,临床运动的生物力学分析中的首要数量,然而现有的3D姿势跟踪,网状恢复,以及多视三角测量方法要么在无解剖限制的情况下优化3D键点精度,要么承载计算和捕获基础设施过重,无法部署在CoM跟踪最有用的地方. 因此,对教练员和运动分析员来说,衡量标准COM仍然很难从运动员训练与比赛的单相机中测量. 在这部作品中,我们引入了MuyBridge,这是一个在线设备系统,它从一个单一的电话摄像机视频流中估算出运动员在质量轨迹的片段中心. MuyBridge 配对一个紧凑的 2D 姿势网络和一个蒸馏的单步单倍深度网络,通过一个分析的量子聚变,使用解剖学和物理前科来锁定度量衡 CoM,不需要3D或任务特定的监督. 对AthletePose3D(跑步,田径,以及数字滑冰)的田径运动情况进行评估后,MuyBridge在一次性校准下实现了33-41毫米垂直CoM误差和2.3-6.6%的绝对相对射程误差(AbsRel),并利用iPhone 15上的同步2.86赫兹深度更新得出了ComM的63 FPS的姿势估计率. 代码见:https://github.com/Abradshaw1/Muybridge。

articles.title: RoGe: Novel View Synthesis via End-to-End Implicit Reconstruction and Generation
articles.content: Novel view synthesis from sparse inputs requires both geometric grounding from the observed views and generative priors of unobserved regions, motivating recent hybrid methods that combine reconstruction and generation. However, existing methods bridge the two with rendered images or explicit 3D representations such as point maps or 3D Gaussians. Generation is thus conditioned on a lossy and imperfect projection of the scene, inheriting its errors, and reconstruction receives no signal from generation to correct them. We present RoGe, an end-to-end unified reconstruction and generation framework that removes this explicit bridge. It targets roaming within a scene anchored by sparse views: given a few posed images and a camera trajectory, it synthesizes a temporally coherent video along that trajectory. From the sparse input views, RoGe builds an implicit scene representation with a feed-forward reconstruction model, and queries it with target camera rays to obtain per-view geometric features. These features are injected into a video diffusion model as conditioning, without any 3D intermediate. Both modules are trained jointly, so the generation objective directly shapes its own geometric conditioning. We conduct experiments on DL3DV, where RoGe outperforms reconstruction-based, generation-based, and hybrid baselines on image-level metrics and video-level temporal consistency. Ablations confirm that ray-queried implicit features outperform both raw reconstruction tokens and rendered RGB as conditioning, and that joint training brings further gains.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RoGe:小说视图通过端到端的隐形重建和生成合成
articles.content_zh: 从稀少的投入中合成小说,既需要从观测到的观点中几何定位,又需要未观测到的区域的遗传学前科,从而推动最近结合重建与生成的混合方法。 然而,现有方法将两者与渲染的图像或显式的3D表示方式(如点图或3D Gaussians)相连接. 因此,世代以场景的失落和不完美的投影为条件,继承了它的错误,重建从一代人那里没有得到任何信号来纠正它们. 我们介绍RoGe,一个端到端的统一重建与生成框架,它消除了这个明确的桥梁. 它的目标是在一片景色中徘徊, 由稀少的视线: 有一些画面和相机轨迹, 从稀疏的输入视图中,RoGe构建了带有向导重建模型的隐含场景代表,并用目标镜头射线进行查询,以获得每个视图的几何特征. 这些功能被注入到视频传播模型中作为调制,没有任何3D中间体. 这两个模块都是共同训练的,因此生成目标直接塑造了自己的几何条件. 我们进行了DL3DV的实验,其中RoGe在图像层面的度量衡和视频层面的时间一致性上超越了基于重建,基于生成的混合基线. 膨胀证实,射线射线的隐含特征既优于原始重建标志,又使RGB成为条件,联合培训带来进一步收益.

articles.title: Efficient All-in-One Weather Restoration using Spectral Harmonization
articles.content: Adverse weather conditions such as rain, haze, and snow significantly degrade image quality, posing challenges for both human perception and physical AI. Existing restoration methods require large computational budgets, struggling to process high-resolution images and handle different degradations. In this paper, we present Frequency Reconstruction via Spectral Harmonization, a novel lightweight all-in-one restoration method that explicitly decomposes feature representations into high- and low-frequency components at each scale of a hierarchical encoder-decoder architecture. By combining spectral decomposition with spatial processing through Fourier-based skip connections, FReSH-IR captures complementary frequency information without sacrificing spatial detail. Our approach achieves similar restoration quality with 80% fewer parameters and operations than transformer-based models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method offers a great efficiency-performance trade-off, highlighting its practical applications in constrained-resource systems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 利用光谱协调实现高效的全方位天气恢复
articles.content_zh: 雨、雾和雪等恶劣的天气条件明显地降低了图像质量,对人的认知和身体的AI提出了挑战。 现有的恢复方法需要大量的计算预算,难以处理高分辨率图像和处理不同的降解. 在本文中,我们通过Spectral Coordination介绍频率重建,这是一种新型的轻量级全元修复方法,它明确分解在分级编码器-解码器架构的每个尺度上将表示物分解为高频和低频元件. FRSH-IR通过以Fourier为基础的跳转连接,将光谱分解与空间处理相结合,在不牺牲空间细节的情况下获取互补频率信息. 我们的方法实现了类似的修复质量,其参数和操作比基于变压器的模型少80%. 广泛的实验表明,我们的方法提供了极大的效率-性能权衡,突出了它在有限资源系统中的实际应用。

articles.title: Benchmarking RAW and RGB Restoration in Image Signal Processors
articles.content: Modern cameras transform RAW sensor measurements into sRGB images through an image signal processor (ISP). We benchmark two placements for blind restoration around a fixed ISP: (A) pre-ISP restoration in the RAW domain and (B) post-ISP restoration in the sRGB domain. The benchmark covers four smartphone device groups, two learned ISPs, three degradation regimes--noise, blur, and joint noise and blur--, and several representative RAW and RGB restoration models. Our results show that placement alone does not determine performance. The RAW restoration strategy outperforms the best generic RGB restoration models. However, RGB restoration models trained considering the ISP transformations, achieve the best overall performance. Our novel benchmark demonstrates that the image reconstruction performance strongly depends on the alignment between the restoration model and the target imaging pipeline. We consequently recommend reporting restoration placement and ISP-aware supervision as key experimental factors. Our code is available at https://github.com/mv-lab/AISP
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 图像信号处理器中的RAW和RGB恢复基准
articles.content_zh: 现代相机通过一个图像信号处理器(ISP)将RAW传感器测量结果转化为SRGB图像. 我们围绕一个固定的ISP,将两个盲修复位置作为基准:(A) RAW域的ISP前修复和(B) SRGB域的ISP后修复。 基准包括4个智能手机设备组,2个有知识的ISP,3个退化系统-噪声,模糊,以及联合噪声和模糊-,以及几个有代表性的RAW和RGB修复模型. 我们的结果表明,单靠安置不能决定业绩。 RAW修复战略的绩效超过了最好的通用RGB修复模型. 然而,经过培训的RGB修复模型考虑了ISP的转换,实现了最佳的整体性能. 我们的新基准表明,图像重建的性能在很大程度上取决于恢复模型与目标成像管道之间的一致。 因此,我们建议将恢复安置和ISP-意识监督作为关键的实验因素。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/mv-lab/AISP上查阅。

articles.title: GDB-Reward: From Evaluation Metrics to Training Rewards for Graphic Design
articles.content: Text-to-image models excel at natural image synthesis but struggle with graphic design, where success depends on satisfying precise constraints on typography, layout, color, and visual communication. While prompt optimization offers an attractive alternative to expensive diffusion model fine-tuning, learning prompts for frozen image generators requires informative reward functions despite the entirely non-differentiable generation process. Reinforcement learning does not require differentiable objectives; it requires only scalar rewards capable of ranking candidate outputs. This raises a simple question: can design evaluation metrics themselves become reinforcement learning rewards? Our central contribution is GDB-Reward, a framework that systematically transforms heterogeneous graphic design evaluation metrics into a unified reinforcement learning reward. Experiments demonstrate that GDB-Reward provides an effective optimization objective, substantially improving adherence to the design specification in perceptual quality, rendering fidelity, and spatial accuracy while keeping the image generator entirely frozen. More broadly, our results demonstrate that heterogeneous, non-differentiable evaluation metrics can move beyond passive benchmarking to become effective optimization objectives for reinforcement learning in domains where differentiable supervision is unavailable.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GDB- 奖励: 从评价计量到图形设计培训奖励
articles.content_zh: 文本到图像模型在自然图像合成方面表现优异,但在图形设计方面却挣扎不已,其成功取决于能否满足印刷、布局、颜色和视觉交流方面的精确限制。 虽然迅速优化为昂贵的传播模型的微调提供了有吸引力的替代办法,但对冷冻图像生成器的学习提示需要信息性的奖励功能,尽管生成过程是完全无差别的。 强化学习不需要不同的目标;它只需要能够对候选人产出进行排名的分级奖励。 这提出了一个简单的问题:设计评价衡量标准本身能否成为强化学习的奖励? 我们的中心贡献是GDB-Reward,这个框架系统地将各种图形设计评价指标转化为统一的强化学习奖励. 实验表明,GDB-Reward提供了一个有效的优化目标,大大提高了在视觉质量方面对设计规格的遵守程度,使精度和空间精确度,同时保持图像生成器完全冻结. 更广泛地说,我们的成果显示,不同、无差别的评价衡量标准可以超越被动基准,成为在缺乏不同监督的领域加强学习的有效优化目标。

articles.title: AutoCompass: Accurate Visual Localization on Public Maps by Learning from Weak Labels
articles.content: Neural map matchers estimate an image's 3-DoF pose relative to a 2D map. These models are trained on large-scale datasets of geo-referenced images, whose position and heading labels often contain noise that affects the trained models. To address this, we present AutoCompass, a supervision approach for training neural map matchers from inaccurate absolute pose labels. First, we show that heading labels are unnecessary: trained from raw GPS labels, models learn to predict accurate headings, automatically. Second, defining a tolerance region around raw GPS improves positional accuracy. Third, if available, our supervision uses relative poses between training images, obtained via SLAM or SfM, which provide a more accurate training signal. Across driving and egocentric benchmarks, AutoCompass consistently outperforms counterparts trained with the usual strong reliance on absolute pose labels.

articles.title_zh: AutoCompass: 通过学习弱标签在公共地图上的精确视觉本地化
articles.content_zh: 神经图匹配者估计一个图像的3-DoF相对于一个2D地图的姿势. 这些模型在地理参考图像的大规模数据集上接受培训,其位置和标题标签中往往含有影响训练有素模型的噪声. 为了解决这个问题,我们介绍AutoCompass,一种从不准确的绝对姿势标签中培训神经图匹配器的监督方法。 首先,我们显示标题标签是不必要的:从原始的GPS标签中训练出来的,模型学会自动预测准确的标题. 第二,在原始全球定位系统周围确定一个耐受区域,提高位置准确性。 第三,如果有的话,我们的监督使用通过SLAM或SfM获得的培训图像之间的相对形式,这提供了更准确的培训信号。 在整个驱动和以自我为中心的基准中,AutoCompass一直比训练有素的对应方业绩优于通常高度依赖绝对姿势标签的对应方。

articles.title: ShallowStream: Index Shallow then Answer Deep for Streaming Video Understanding
articles.content: Streaming video understanding is a critical capability for real-world applications, including embodied intelligence, autonomous driving, industrial monitoring, surveillance and early warning, and wearable assistants. However, processing continuous video streams with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is computationally expensive. Existing efforts have explored reducing streaming overhead through visual token pruning, token merging, quantization, on-demand frame retrieval, and context offloading. However, most existing methods overlook the dimension of model depth. Repeatedly executing full-depth MLLM prefill over incoming frames is prohibitively expensive, incurring substantial computational overhead and causing the KV cache to grow at a rate directly proportional to the prefill depth. To address these challenges, we propose ShallowStream, a novel framework that leverages the shallow layers of an MLLM to simultaneously perform frame encoding and retrieval index building. During stream processing, ShallowStream maintains an always-on lightweight index using the KV cache of shallow layers. During query-time answering, we leverage the attention scores generated by the shallow layers to score context frames and employ a diversity-aware selection strategy to retrieve precise and comprehensive evidence. ShallowStream achieves performance on par with the strongest existing streaming methods, while reducing per-frame prefill latency and 10-second end-to-end latency by up to 52.1x and 11.9x, respectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/CURRENTF/ShallowStream.

articles.title_zh: 浅色结构:索引浅色,然后回答深色的流媒体理解
articles.content_zh: 流畅的视频理解是现实世界应用的关键能力,包括体现的智能、自主驾驶、工业监测、监测和预警以及可穿戴的助手。 然而,使用多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)处理连续视频流在计算上是昂贵的. 现有努力探索通过目视信物查抄、信物合并、量化、点播框检索和上下文卸载等方式减少流线性间接费用。 然而,大多数现有方法忽略了模型深度的层面。 反复在进入的框架上执行完全深入的MLLM预填,费用高昂,造成大量的计算间接费用,导致KV缓存以与预填深度直接成比例的速度增长. 为了应付这些挑战,我们提议采用ShallowStream这个新颖的框架,利用MLLM的浅层同时进行帧编码和检索索引建设。 在溪流处理过程中,ShallowStream使用浅层的KV缓存来维持一个恒定的轻量级指数. 在回答询问时,我们利用浅层产生的关注分数来评分上下文框架,并采用了解多样性的选择策略来检索准确和全面的证据。 ShallowStream与现有最强的流线法一样实现性能,同时将每帧的预填空闲和10秒的端对空闲分别减少至52.1x和11.9x. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/CURRENTF/ShallowStream上查阅。

articles.title: Video-Based Palm-Vein Authentication under Challenging Conditions
articles.content: Palm-vein biometrics are increasingly used for secure, contactless authentication. Yet real-world deployment exposes them to surface noise (sweat, dirt), illumination and motion variation, and temperature-driven changes in vascular visibility, which remain underexplored for lack of data captured under such conditions. To study these effects, we introduce the Columbia University Palm-vein (CUP) dataset, to our knowledge the first public video-based palm-vein dataset. CUP records every palm under four surface conditions (a clean baseline, warm, wet, and dirty) and pairs each subject with physiological and demographic metadata. On it we benchmark twenty-one recognizers spanning static, video, and multi-frame aggregation architectures. Models that verify reliably on clean palms lose most of their accuracy on dirty ones, and the mean equal error rate (EER) roughly quadruples. We recover much of that robustness along both axes of the capture. Temporally, a consensus over the few frames the sensor already returns cancels transient corruption; spatially, a test-time matcher that adds no learned parameters fuses the global cosine with a saliency-steered region-level optimal transport that routes the comparison around corrupted regions. The full design leads on every surface of CUP in EER, TAR@FAR=0.01, and Rank-1, at 4.3M parameters and 3.1 GFLOPs, a fraction of the video models' cost. Attached to four frozen state-of-the-art backbones it cuts their mean EER by 29-37% without retraining, and on four public single-image datasets the regional matching alone still helps. A preliminary audit across ten demographic and physiological traits finds two warm-condition gaps, along body water and gender, that survive multiple-comparison correction. CUP will be released for non-commercial research use at https://github.com/MobileX-CU/CUP_v1 upon publication.

articles.title_zh: 挑战条件下的视频Palm-Vein认证
articles.content_zh: 棕榈藤生物鉴别技术越来越多地用于安全、无接触的认证。 然而,现实世界的部署使它们暴露在表面噪音(湿气、泥土)、照明和运动变化以及血管可见度的温度驱动变化中,由于缺乏在这种条件下获取的数据,这些噪音仍然没有得到充分利用。 为了研究这些效果,我们引入了哥伦比亚大学Palm-vein(CUP)数据集,据我们所知,这是第一个基于公共视频的Palm-vein数据集. CUP记录每只棕榈在四个表层条件下(一个干净的基线,温暖,湿润,肮脏),每个科与生理和人口元数据对齐. 以此为基准,21个识别器 覆盖了静态、视频和多帧聚合结构 可靠地在干净的棕榈上验证的模型在肮脏的棕榈上丧失了大部分的精度,而平均等误率(EER)大约为四倍. 我们沿着捕捉的两条轴线恢复了大部分活力。 暂时,对于传感器已经返回的几条框架达成共识,就消除了瞬间腐败;在空间上,一个没有添加学到的参数的测试时间匹配器将全球余弦与一个能引导对比绕过腐败区域的最优区域级运输连接起来。 完整的设计在EER中的CUP的每个表面,TAR@FAR=0.01,和Rank-1,以4.3M参数和3.1GFLOPs,是视频模型成本的一小部分. 在4个冷冻的先进骨干上,它不进行再培训就将平均ER削减了29-37%,在4个公共单一图像数据集上,仅区域匹配仍然有帮助。 对10个人口和生理特征进行的初步审计发现,在身体水和性别方面,存在两个条件温和的缺陷,它们可以经受多重比较的矫正。 CUP将在发布后在https://github.com/MobileX-CU/CUP_v1上发布,供非商业性研究使用.

articles.title: Multi-Tool Image Editing Attribution in Facial Forgery
articles.content: As generative AI tools become increasingly powerful and easy to use, people can easily edit portrait images with a prompt, necessitating the task of image editing attribution, which predicts the involved editing tools from the given image. Existing attribution methods hold the single-tool assumption and can only attribute a specific editing tool, but struggle to handle the more complex and increasingly common multi-tool editing scenarios, where artifacts left by different editing tools are composite and overlapped. To address this gap, we explore Multi-Tool Image Editing Attribution (MIEA), which aims to identify multiple editing tools involved in a multi-tool edited facial image. To simulate the real-life editing operations on facial images, we then construct a new dataset, MultiEdit, which contains 500k+ edited facial images and covers six types of editing tools that support face swapping (Deepfake) and various facial enhancements. Inspired by the findings from data analysis, we design DPEC, a multi-tool attribution method that can capture distinguishable, locality-aware editing tool traces from both spatial and frequency domains with the support of an error-based curriculum learning strategy. Experiments show \Method\ outperforms nine methods for facial images edited in at most five steps.

articles.title_zh: 多工具图像编辑在 Facial Forgery 中的归属
articles.content_zh: 随着基因AI工具越来越强大和容易使用,人们可以很方便地以迅速的方式编辑肖像图像,这就需要完成图像编辑归属的任务,这预言了从给定的图像中涉及的编辑工具. 现有的归属方法持有单工具的假设,只能归属一个特定的编辑工具,但努力处理比较复杂和越来越常见的多工具编辑方案,其中不同编辑工具留下的文物是复合的,并且是重叠的. 为了弥补这一差距,我们探索多工具图像编辑属性(MIEA),旨在识别多工具编辑面部图像所涉及的多个编辑工具. 为了模拟面部图像上的真实生活编辑操作,我们然后构建一个新的数据集"MultiEdit",其中包含500k+编辑的面部图像,并涵盖支持面部互换(Deepfake)和各种面部增强的六种编辑工具. 受数据分析结果的启发,我们设计了DPEC,一种多工具的归属方法,在基于错误的课程学习战略的支持下,能够捕捉空间和频率域的可分辨的,具有局部意识的编辑工具痕迹. 实验显示\Method\ 超过九方法 面部图像编辑 在最多五个步骤。

articles.title: Balancing Frequencies and Pixels in Flow Matching
articles.content: Natural images follow a $1/f^2$ spectral distribution: most signal energy lies in the low spatial frequencies, while the perceptually important structures such as textures and edges occupy sparse high-frequency bands. Pixel-space reconstruction objectives, however, treat all spatial errors uniformly, causing low frequencies to dominate the optimization signal and delaying the learning of fine-scale details. In this work, we identify this objective-level spectral imbalance as a key inefficiency in training pixel-space flow models. To address it, we propose a Focal Log-Frequency Loss (f-loss), a spectrally balanced objective that equalizes the learning signal across frequencies, emphasizing high-frequency components that are otherwise underrepresented in pixel-space objectives. Building on this, we introduce a simple training strategy that combines frequency and pixel supervision: we first emphasize frequency-domain learning early to capture all frequencies, and then transition to standard pixel-space v-loss for spatial refinement. This balancing mitigates the low-frequency bias of pixel losses and aligns the training signal with the evolving needs of the model. Our approach is conceptually simple, requires no architectural changes, and acts as a drop-in replacement for flow matching losses. Across multiple model scales, it accelerates convergence by up to 40% while consistently improving FID and perceptual fidelity. We will release code and models.

articles.title_zh: 在流量匹配中平衡大小和像素
articles.content_zh: 自然图像遵循1/f^2美元光谱分布:大多数信号能量位于低空间频率,而知觉重要的结构如纹理和边缘占据了稀疏的高频波段. 然而,像素空间重建目标统一处理所有空间误差,导致低频率主导优化信号,并推迟精细尺度细节的学习. 在这项工作中,我们确定这种客观水平的光谱不平衡是训练像素-空间流模型的关键效率低下. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了一个“焦点日志-频率损失”(f-loss),这是一个光谱平衡的目标,它使不同频率的学习信号相等,强调在像素-空间目标中本来代表性不足的高频组件。 在此基础上,我们引入了将频率和像素监督相结合的简单训练策略:我们首先强调频率-域学早期,以捕捉所有频率,然后过渡到标准像素-空间v-损失,以进行空间改进. 这种平衡减轻了像素损失的低频偏差,使训练信号与模型不断变化的需要相配合. 我们的方法在概念上很简单,不需要任何建筑改变,并且充当流量匹配损失的倒置替代. 在多个模型尺度上,它加速了40%的趋同,同时不断改善FID和观念上的忠诚。 我们将发布代码和模型。

articles.title: InceptionGS: Generative Bootstrapping for Large-Scale Gaussian Splatting under Unstructured View Sampling
articles.content: Achieving truly immersive large-scale scene digitization necessitates consistent and visually pleasing rendering across all possible viewing perspectives. However, collecting multi-view images covering every fine detail of a large-scale scene is prohibitive due to scene complexity, capture cost, negligence, or accessibility constraints. As a result, the sampled views tend to be highly unstructured -- the majority of the scene is well covered yet certain regions inevitably lack sufficient observations. Existing reconstruction based methods are vulnerable to view scarcity while generation based approaches suffer from generalization, controllability, and 3D consistency issues. To address this challenge, we propose InceptionGS, which bootstraps Gaussian splatting by subtly balancing reconstruction and generation. Starting from an initial Gaussian splatting, InceptionGS reasonably rethinks and repairs problematic regions caused by view scarcity while preserving the quality elsewhere, by softly incorporating scene- and view-adaptive generative priors. Extensive experiments on real-world large-scale scenes demonstrate the superiority and broad applicability of our approach in handling unstructured imagery and boosting high-fidelity Gaussian splatting. Please refer to the supplementary video for better visual demonstrations.

articles.title: RVSD: Retrieval Vision Sparse Decoding for Mitigating Visual Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Large vision-language models have achieved remarkable success in vision-language tasks. However, they remain prone to Visual Hallucinations (VHs), undermining their reliability in real-world applications. Existing solutions typically require curated datasets, additional training, or multi-round decoding, resulting in considerable computational overhead. In this paper, we propose \textbf{RVSD} (\underline{R}etrieval \underline{V}ision \underline{S}parse \underline{D}ecoding), a training-free and plug-and-play decoding framework that, for the first time, unifies token sparsification and \textbf{Semantic-Space Visual Retrieval} (SSVR) within a single decoding pass. Within RVSD, we introduce a \textbf{semantics-directed token selection} strategy that selectively sparsifies redundant tokens while preserving critical visual information. We further propose the SSVR mechanism, which reformulates visual compensation as an on-demand cross-modal retrieval process within a shared semantic space. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RVSD achieves state-of-the-art performance in mitigating VHs while maintaining robust suppression capabilities under long-context generation settings. Our code is available here.\footnote{https://github.com/canjie-liu/RVSD}

articles.title_zh: RVSD:大型视觉-语言模型中用于减轻视觉幻觉的 Retrival Vision Sparse 解码
articles.content_zh: 大型视觉语言模式在视觉语言任务上取得了显著成功. 然而,它们仍然容易发生视觉幻觉,破坏了它们在现实世界应用中的可靠性。 现有解决办法通常需要经过整理的数据集、额外的培训或多轮解码,从而产生相当大的计算间接费用。 在本文中,我们提出\textbf{RVSD}(\underline{R} etrieval\nderline{V}\nderline{S}parse\underline{D}编码),这是一个训练无阻和插件与游戏解码框架,它首次在单一解码通道内统一了标语拼接和\textbf{Semantic-Space Visual Retrieval}(SSVR). 在 RVSD 中, 我们引入了\ textbf{语义引导的符号选择} 策略, 它有选择地将冗余的符号缩放, 同时保存关键的视觉信息 。 我们进一步提出SSVR机制,将视觉补偿重新设定为共享语义空间内点播的跨模式检索过程. 广泛的实验表明,RVSD在降低VH的同时,在长文本生成环境中保持了强大的压制能力,实现了最先进的性能. 我们的代码可在此获取.\footnote{https://github.com/canjie-liu/RVSD {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}你觉得呢?

articles.title: MV-dVRK: A Multi-Viewpoint Benchmark for Spatial Surgical Perception
articles.content: Large-scale training and refined optimization techniques have greatly improved sparse multi-view 3D reconstruction. Despite their relevance to surgery, such methods have never before been rigorously evaluated on real endoscopic images. Current clinical telerobots deploy a single stereo camera inside the patient, making multi-viewpoint data extremely rare. This paper presents MV-dVRK, the first ex-vivo surgical dataset to combine multiple exposure-synchronized stereo viewpoints with accurate surface geometry and camera poses. The static subset of the benchmark provides dense SfM reference geometry, validated against an industrial 3D scanner, together with ground-truth camera poses and sparse-view test sets. We use MV-dVRK to systematically compare zero-shot monocular, stereo, multi-stereo, and multi-view 3D reconstruction methods as the number of viewpoints increases. With two endoscopes, multi-stereo reconstruction achieves the highest coverage. With a third viewpoint, optimization-based multi-view methods perform best, covering 67% of ground-truth surface points within a 1 mm tolerance and recovering highly accurate relative camera poses. By contrast, feed-forward foundation models cover only 43% of the ground-truth surface in the same setting. MV-dVRK also includes ten dynamic sequences spanning multiple surgical tasks, with increasing kinematic complexity and tissue deformation, providing a basis for future research in multi-viewpoint surgical perception. The project is available at: https://mv-dvrk.is.mpg.de.

articles.title_zh: MV-dVRK:空间外科观察多视点基准
articles.content_zh: 大规模的培训和精细优化技术极大地改善了稀少的多景3D重建. 尽管这些方法与手术有关,但从未对真实的内视图像进行过严格的评价。 目前临床远程机器人在患者体内部署单声道相机,使得多视点数据极为罕见. 本文介绍MV-dVRK,这是第一个将多个曝光同步立体立体视点与准确的表面几何和相机姿势相结合的前虚拟外科数据集. 基准的静态子集提供稠密的SfM参考几何,与工业的3D扫描仪进行验证,并配有地面真相机和稀有的视野测试集. 我们使用MV-dVRK系统比较了零镜头单镜头,立体声,多立体声,以及多视的3D重建方法,随着视点数量的增加. 利用两块内镜,多立体重建实现最高覆盖. 以第三种观点来看,基于优化的多视图方法表现最佳,覆盖了1毫米耐力范围内67%的地面真实表面点,并恢复了高度精确的相对相机姿势. 相比之下,饲料前方基础模型仅覆盖43%在同一环境下的地面真相表面. MV-dVRK还包括10个动态序列,这些序列跨越多个手术任务,运动复杂度和组织变形度不断提高,为未来多视点手术感知研究提供了基础. 该项目见https://mv-dvrk.is.mpg.de。

articles.title: A Top-Down Framework for Metric-Scale Athlete Localization from Single Broadcast Frames
articles.content: Accurate world-coordinate localization of athletes from single-frame broadcast footage is inherently challenging due to extreme scale disparities in ultra-high-resolution imagery. In this paper, we propose a top-down framework for metric-scale athlete localization from a single calibrated frame. Our approach centers on three key contributions. First, we propose Boundary-Aware Adaptive Tiling, a semantics-guided extension of standard sliced inference. By iteratively expanding tile boundaries based on coarse bounding-box predictions, it systematically ensures full object containment, effectively mitigating boundary-splitting artifacts through a lightweight pipeline adaptation without architectural modifications. By substantially mitigating recall degradation under extreme scale variance, Boundary-Aware Adaptive Tiling enables us to isolate perspective distortion as the primary source of residual localization error. Second, we adapt the RTMPose-X architecture into a specialized two-keypoint estimator (pelvis and ground projection), employing a reformulated Gated Attention Unit optimized for this geometrically coupled point pair, and then deterministically lift the 2D ground projections into world coordinates via camera-calibrated ray casting. On the public test set, our method achieves a LocSim score of 97.44 and an mAP of 0.9128, outperforming the baseline by over 21 \% and establishing a robust solution for high-resolution scale variance.

articles.title_zh: 单个广播框架中的量级运动员本地化的上下框架
articles.content_zh: 由于超高分辨率图像的极端尺度差异,单帧广播镜头中运动员准确的世界坐标本地化在本质上具有挑战性. 在本文中,我们提出一个自上而下的框架,从一个单一校准框架进行公尺级运动员本地化. 我们的方法集中于三个主要贡献。 首先,我们提出 边界-智能适应性倾斜, 一个语义指导扩展 标准切片推论。 它通过基于粗边框预测的迭代扩大瓦片边界,系统地确保了完全的物体封存,通过不进行建筑改造的轻量级管道改造,有效缓解了分界文物. 通过在极端尺度差异下大幅缓解回溯退化, " 边界敏感 " 适应性倾斜使我们能够将视角扭曲作为剩余本地化错误的主要来源。 第二,我们把RTMPose-X架构改造成一个专门的双键估计器(骨盆和地面投影),使用一个经过重新调整的Gated 注意单元,对这个几何组合的点对进行优化,然后通过照相机校准射线投影将2D 地面投影提升到世界坐标. 在公共测试中,我们的方法实现了LocSim的97.44分和mAP的0.9128分,比基线高出21%,为高分辨率尺度差异建立了强有力的解决方案。

articles.title: Generating Medical Image Counterfactuals using Causal Explanations
articles.content:
Deep learning models have achieved impressive performance in medical image diagnosis, yet their deployment in clinical settings remains constrained by limited explainability. Counterfactual images provide one means of auditing model behavior by showing how an image would need to change for a classifier to produce a different prediction. Existing approaches typically generate such explanations using auxiliary models, including generative adversarial networks and diffusion models. While often capable of producing visually realistic images, these methods explain one black-box model using another, making it difficult to separate the classifier's decision-making process from the inductive biases of the generator.
  We propose a novel counterfactual-generation framework that requires no generative model. Instead, counterfactuals are constructed directly from causal evidence extracted from the classifier. The resulting approach is deterministic, requires no additional model training, and enables controllable edits within user-specified regions of interest. Experiments on real-world medical imaging datasets demonstrate that the proposed method successfully changes classifier predictions while remaining closer to the original image than generative baselines, providing a more direct and transparent view of the classifier's decision boundary.

articles.title_zh: 使用因果解释生成医疗图像反事实
articles.content_zh:
深层学习模型在医学图像诊断方面取得了令人印象深刻的成绩,然而,由于解释性有限,这些模型在临床环境中的应用仍然受到限制。 反事实图像为审计模型行为提供了一种手段,通过显示一个图像如何需要改变分类器来产生不同的预测. 现有办法通常利用辅助模式,包括基因对抗网络和传播模式,得出这种解释。 虽然这些方法往往能够产生视觉上现实的图像,但用另一种方法解释一个黑盒模型,使得分类者的决策过程与生成者的诱导偏差难以区分.
我们提出一个新的反事实生成框架,不需要基因模型。 相反,反事实直接来自从分类器中提取的因果关系。 由此产生的方法是决定性的,不需要额外的模式培训,并且能够在用户指定感兴趣的区域内进行可控制的编辑。 对现实世界医学成像数据集的实验表明,拟议方法成功地改变了分类器预测,同时与基因基线相比仍然更接近于原始图像,为分类器的决定边界提供了更直接和透明的视角.

articles.title: GaLe: memory-efficient Global Approximate and Local Exact features
articles.content: Embedded devices typically lack the resources of GPU-equipped machines, and existing inference methods suffer from either high computational overhead (patch-based) or accuracy loss (approximation-based). We propose GaLe, a memory-efficient technique that enables the deployment of pretrained networks on constrained devices without retraining. GaLe partitions feature maps into two components: a local exact (Le) representation that preserves fine details and a global approximate (Ga) representation that retains long-range dependencies. Unlike standard tiling, GaLe supports global operations and attention mechanisms found in hybrid CNN-transformer models. Validated on ImageNet, our method matches exact-inference performance while achieving up to 65% speedup and 90% RAM reduction on a Cortex-M33 compared to patch-based inference. We further demonstrate GaLe's versatility across classification, detection, and generation tasks, highlighting its potential as a foundation for resource-efficient architecture design.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GALE: 内存高效的全球近似和本地精确特性
articles.content_zh: 嵌入式设备通常缺乏GPU设备化的机器的资源,现有的推论方法要么受到高计算率(patch基),要么受到精度损失(近似基)的影响. 我们提议加莱(Gale),这是一种具有记忆效率的技术,它使得在不进行再培训的情况下,在受限制的装置上部署预先训练的网络。 Gale分区将地图分为两个部分:当地精确(Le)的表示,保留精细细节;全球近似(Ga)的表示,保留远程依赖. 与标准平板化不同,Gale支持在混合式CNN-transformer模型中发现的全球操作和关注机制. 经ImageNet验证,我们的方法匹配精确推论性能,同时在Cortex-M33上实现高达65%的加速和90%的RAM减速,与基于补丁的推论相比. 我们进一步展示了Gale在分类、检测和生成任务方面的多功能性,突出了它作为资源节约型建筑设计基础的潜力。

articles.title: Genesis: A Generative Engine for Hierarchical Satellite Image Synthesis
articles.content: Earth observation is fundamentally multi-scale; geospatial tasks span varied resolutions, and satellite imagery is organized into cascading tile pyramids that nest fine detail within wide coverage. Current generative models of satellite imagery, however, operate along a single axis: they either zoom to enhance a single tile's resolution or pan to extend imagery at a fixed scale. As a result, no existing method produces a complete pyramid that stays consistent across both scale and space, where a high-zoom tile must agree with the coarse context it refines and with the neighbors it meets. Motivated by this gap, we introduce a new task, multi-scale tile completion: given a sparse set of seed tiles at arbitrary zoom levels and positions, synthesize a complete, uniform quadtree that is globally consistent across both scale and space. We approach this task with Genesis, a generative engine that brings both axes together by composing two specialized operators over the quadtree: a vertical super-resolution model and a horizontal mask-based outpainting model, producing pyramids that are consistent across zoom levels and seamless across neighboring tiles. Each operator achieves state-of-the-art results on its subtask, and the engine propagates sparse seeds into seamless, multi-resolution maps from any initial configuration. To evaluate the task and benchmark Genesis, we introduce dense500, a fully observed multi-scale pyramid dataset spanning diverse geographic regions, together with a suite of pyramid-level metrics. Code, models, and our dataset are available at https://github.com/mvrl/genesis.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 创世纪:分级卫星图像合成的基因引擎
articles.content_zh: 地球观测基本上是多尺度的;地理空间任务跨越不同分辨率,卫星图像被组织成叠叠叠的瓦片金字塔,在广泛覆盖范围内,这些金字塔有着细细的覆盖。 然而,目前卫星图像的基因模型沿着单一轴线运行:它们要么放大以提高单一瓦的分辨率,要么在固定尺度上扩展图像。 因此,没有一种现有的方法产生一个完整的金字塔,在尺度和空间上都保持一致,一个高角的瓷砖必须同意它精炼的粗糙上下文,并与它相遇的邻居们一致. 受这一差距的驱使,我们提出了一个新的任务,即多尺度的瓦片完成:在任意缩放水平和位置上,将一组稀疏的种子瓦片合成一个完整、统一的四棵树,在尺度和空间上都具有全球一致性。 我们用创世纪(Genesis)来完成这项任务,它是一个基因引擎,通过在四方树上搭配两个专门的操作员,将两轴集合在一起:一个垂直的超分辨率模型和一个水平的基于面具的外涂模型,产生金字塔,在放大水平之间一致,在邻近的瓷砖之间无缝. 每个操作员在其子任务上取得最先进的结果,引擎将稀有的种子传播到任何初始配置的无缝多分辨率地图中. 为了评估任务和基准 " 创世纪 " ,我们引入了密集的500,一个覆盖不同地理区域的完全观察到的多尺度金字塔数据集,以及一套金字塔级的计量标准。 代码、模型和我们的数据集可在https://github.com/mvrl/generation上查阅。

articles.title: LoFi RADIO: A Distilled In-Domain Backbone Applied for Artifact-Severity Grading of Ultra-Low-Field Neonatal Brain MR
articles.content: Ultra-low-field MRI makes neonatal brain imaging deploy- able in low-resource settings, but its low SNR, lack of shielding, and long scan duration make it especially prone to acquisition artifacts, motivating automated quality control. We address the LISA 2026 Task 1a challenge: multi-label severity grading (0/1/2) of seven common image artifacts on ULF T2 weighted volumes. We identify that a number of backbones may be successfully paired with a classification MLP, but that no single backbone is uniformly best across artifacts. To improve performance, we evaluate routing complementary foundation model teachers through a per-artifact gate, as well as distilling the teachers into a single in-domain ViT-S student (LoFi RADIO) over an unlabeled low-field MRI corpus. Both of these strategies improve the weighted composite. The distilled backbone matches or exceeds the gate and has the added advantage of not requiring deployment of multiple large foundation models at infer- ence.

articles.title_zh: LoFi RADIO:用于超低视距新生儿脑的人工-严重分级的Distilled in-Domain Backbone
articles.content_zh: 超低地核磁共振使得新生儿脑成像的部署——能够在低资源环境下进行,但是它的低SNR,缺乏屏蔽,以及长时间的扫描使得它特别容易获得文物,激发自动化质量控制. 我们处理LISA 2026任务1a挑战:在ULF T2加权量上对7件常见图像文物进行多标签重度分级(0/1/2). 我们发现,一些骨干可以成功地与分类的MLP配对,但是没有一个单一的骨干在文物上是统一的最好. 为了提高绩效,我们通过一个全天候门对辅助性的基础模型教师进行定位评估,并将教师在无标签的低田核磁共振中分馏成一个单一的域内VIT-S学生。 这两个战略都改进了加权组合。 蒸馏的骨干匹配或超过闸门,并具有额外优势,无需在推断时部署多个大基模型.

articles.title: Query Rewriting for Complex Object Segmentation in 4D Gaussian Representations
articles.content: Recent 4D Gaussian representation frameworks have demonstrated strong performance in language-guided dynamic scene understanding. However, these methods remain highly sensitive to verbose and narrative-style queries that contain noisy contextual information. In this paper, we investigate the impact of query rewriting for complex object segmentation in 4D Gaussian representations. Inspired by recent findings in retrieval-augmented language models and keyword-guided query reformulation, we propose a training-free reinterpretation strategy that transforms long descriptive queries into concise keyword-grounded forms. Our approach progressively reduces linguistic noise while preserving semantic anchors relevant to object-centric representations. Experiments on HyperNeRF and Neu3D demonstrate that concise rewritten queries significantly improve both temporal localization and spatial segmentation performance. In particular, our method improves average temporal accuracy from 60.92% to 92.21% and average vIoU from 20.08% to 76.94% without any additional fine-tuning. Extensive ablation studies further reveal that shorter, keyword-focused queries consistently yield stable video-feature similarity distributions and better alignment with object-centric Gaussian representations
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 4D Gaussian 表达式中复杂对象分割的查询重写
articles.content_zh: 近期的4D高斯代表框架在语言引导动态场景理解方面表现出强劲的表现. 然而,这些方法仍然对含有噪音背景信息的动词和叙事式询问高度敏感。 在本文中,我们调查了4D高斯表示法中复杂对象分解的查询重写的影响. 受最近检索-增强语言模型和关键词指导查询重构的发现的启发,我们提出了免费培训-重新解释战略,将长篇描述性查询转变为简明的关键词格式。 我们的方法逐渐减少语言噪音,同时保留与以物体为中心的表述相关的语义锚。 关于HyperNERF和Neu3D的实验表明,简洁的重写查询大大改善了时间定位和空间分割性能. 特别是,我们的方法提高了平均时间精度,从60.92%提高到92.21%,平均紫外线铀从20.08%提高到76.94%,没有增加任何微调。 广泛的消化研究进一步表明,简短的、以关键词为重点的查询始终产生稳定的视频版面相似性分布,并更好地与以物体为中心的高斯表达方式保持一致

articles.title: Characterizing Text Branch Sensitivity in Medical Vision-Language Segmentation via Evidence Decoupling
articles.content: Pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promising performance in medical image segmentation by incorporating clinical text. However, it remains unclear how much textual information actually contributes to pixel-level predictions. In this work, we systematically investigate the role of text in multimodal medical image segmentation. We first analyze several commonly used fusion strategies and find that segmentation performance is largely insensitive to the choice of fusion module. To further understand modality interactions, we propose an Evidence Decoupling Decoder (EDD) based on evidential deep learning and deep supervision. EDD serves as an internal representation analysis tool that decomposes image evidence and text-modulated evidence throughout the decoding process while maintaining competitive segmentation performance. Experimental results show that the sensitivity to text perturbation varies substantially across datasets. On BUSI and BTMRI, removing text causes catastrophic performance drops, indicating strong model reliance on textual input. On ISIC and Kvasir-SEG, text exerts relatively marginal influence. We further find that text affects predictions mainly through global semantic modulation rather than independent spatial localization, and that the specific semantic components driving text sensitivity differ across datasets. These findings provide a deeper understanding of modality interaction in multimodal medical image segmentation and offer practical insights for future model design.

articles.title_zh: 通过证据脱钩使文本处在医疗视觉-语言分解中具有敏感性
articles.content_zh: 训练有素的视觉语言模型(VLMs)通过纳入临床文本,在医疗图像分解方面表现出有希望的表现. 然而,仍然不清楚文字信息对像素水平预测的实际贡献有多大. 在这项工作中,我们系统地调查了文本在多式联运医疗图像分割中的作用。 我们首先分析几种常用的聚变策略,发现分化性能对聚变模块的选择基本不敏感. 为了进一步理解模式互动,我们提议在证据深入学习和深入监督的基础上,进行证据脱钩。 EDD作为一个内部代表分析工具,在整个解码过程中分解图像证据和文本调制的证据,同时保持竞争性的分解性能. 实验结果表明,各数据集对文本扰动的敏感性差异很大。 在BUSI和BTMRI上,删除文本会导致灾难性性能下降,表明强烈的模型依赖文本输入. 关于国际标准行业分类和Kvasir-SEG,文本的影响相对较小。 我们进一步发现,文本主要通过全球语义调式而不是独立的空间定位来影响预测,具体语义成分驱动文本敏感度因数据集而异. 这些研究结果加深了对模式在多式联运医疗图像分割中的相互作用的理解,并为今后的模型设计提供了实际的见解。

articles.title: Learning to Attract and Repel: Dual Quality Margin Learning for Face Recognition (DQM-Face)
articles.content: Face recognition in unconstrained environments remains highly challenging due to diverse and extreme variations encountered in real-world scenarios. To mitigate these effects, existing margin-based approaches model sample quality through feature magnitude. However, magnitude-based modeling alone is susceptible to identity-agnostic noise, which can degrade the reliability and discriminative power of learned representations. In this paper, we propose Dual Quality Margin Learning for Face Recognition (DQM-Face), a novel framework that enables refined attraction and repulsion dynamics during representation learning. Our approach unifies conventional magnitude-based quality estimation with a newly introduced semantic quality learning mechanism, realized via squeeze-and-excitation semantic attention. By jointly leveraging magnitude and semantic cues, we construct enhanced quality-aware margins that adaptively strengthen intra-class compactness through improved attraction during learning. To further enhance inter-class discrimination, we introduce a repulsion margin formulation that explicitly enlarges inter-class separation. The unified integration of semantic quality modeling with dual attraction-repulsion margin optimization results in a more structured and discriminative feature geometry. Extensive experiments on multiple challenging benchmarks demonstrate that DQM-Face consistently outperforms state-of-the-art face recognition methods. Moreover, we show that the quality learned for margin optimization is highly effective for face image quality assessment within the proposed framework, demonstrating that the learned quality signal is intrinsically aligned with the recognition objective. The code is publicly available: https://github.com/RAIB-group/DQM-Face
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 学习吸引和报复:为面部识别而学习双重质量边际(DQM-Face)
articles.content_zh: 在不受限制的环境中,由于在现实世界中遇到的各种极端差异,脸部识别仍然极具挑战性。 为了减轻这些影响,现有的以差值为基础的方法通过特征规模进行样本质量模型。 然而,仅基于量的模型就容易受到身份不可知噪声的影响,这可能会降低所学表现的可靠性和歧视力. 在本文中,我们提出双重质量边际学习(DQM-Face)用于面部识别(DQM-Face),这是一种新颖的框架,在表现式学习中,能够精细的吸引力和反感动力. 我们的方法统一了以传统规模为基础的质量估计,并采用了一种新引入的语义质量学习机制,这种机制是通过挤压和引用语义来实现的。 通过联合利用体积和语义提示,我们构建了增强质量意识的边缘,通过在学习期间提高吸引力来适应性地加强阶级内部的紧凑性。 为了进一步加强阶级间的歧视,我们采用了明确扩大阶级间隔离的反排斥幅度。 语义质量模型与双重吸引力-反感幅度优化的统一整合,形成了更有条理,有区别的特征几何. 对多种挑战性基准的广泛试验表明,DQM-Face的成绩始终高于最先进的面部识别方法。 此外,我们表明,为优化差值而学得的质量对于拟议框架内的面部图像质量评估非常有效,表明所学得的质量信号与识别目标有着内在的一致。 该代码可公开查阅:https://github.com/RAIB-group/DQM-Face.

articles.title: From Detection to Localization: A Unified Forensics Framework for Fully Synthetic and Tampered Images
articles.content: The rapid advancement of generative models has significantly worsened the problem of manipulated image detection, as these methods are capable of producing highly realistic forgeries, reinforcing the importance of multimedia forensics. Conventional approaches typically frame image manipulation detection as a binary classification task (real vs. generated), which limits the capability to distinguish and localize different forms of manipulation. To address these constraints, this work extends an existing detector by introducing a unified multiclass framework (real vs. fully generated vs. tampered). In addition to classifying image authenticity, the framework incorporates a segmentation branch to enable pixel-level localization of tampered regions. The proposed approach outperforms selected recent benchmarks, offering an efficient solution with improved classification accuracy and higher IoU scores for the localization task. Find the code at https://github.com/anngal01/From-Detection-to-Localization-A-Unified-Forensics-Framework-for-Fully-Synthetic-and-Tampered-Images.

articles.title_zh: 从侦测到本地化:全面合成和坦佩雷图像的统一法证框架
articles.content_zh: 基因模型的迅速发展大大加剧了被操纵的图像探测问题,因为这些方法能够产生高度现实的伪造,强化了多媒体法医学的重要性. 常规方法通常将图像操纵检测作为二进制分类任务(real vs. generous),这限制了区分和定位不同形式的操纵的能力. 为解决这些制约因素,本作通过引入一个统一的多类框架(real vs. 充分生成 vs. 篡改)来扩展现有的探测器. 除了对图像真实性进行分类外,框架还包含了一个分块分支,使被篡改区域能够像素级本地化. 拟议办法的绩效超过了最近选定的基准,为本地化任务提供了一个有效的解决方案,提高了分类准确度和IoU分数。 在https://github.com/anngal01/From-Detection-to-localization-A-United-Forensics-Framework- for-Fully-Synthetic-and-Tampered-Images上查找该代码.

articles.title: AffectDelta: Beyond Emotion Labels for Image Editing
articles.content: Emotion-driven image editing aims to evoke a specified target emotion by modifying emotion-relevant visual cues in a source image, while preserving the overall composition and semantic-structural coherence of the original scene. Existing scene-level editors typically specify the target with a single emotion category and often learn visual transformations from operation-level text instructions. A category collapses a mixed affective endpoint into one dominant label, while language cannot precisely quantify how coexisting emotions should increase, decrease, or remain stable. We introduce AffectDelta, a source-aware editor that treats editing as a transition between eight-dimensional emotion distributions. A frozen Emotion Distribution Predictor estimates the source state, and the signed source-to-target difference encodes the direction and magnitude of the requested transition. Within AffectDelta, an internal transition encoder and a source-aware diffusion backbone jointly translate this signal into context-dependent semantic and appearance changes. To train this formulation, we construct AffectPair-249K, comprising 248,841 source-target pairs with predicted eight-dimensional distributions and spanning both cross-category and within-category transitions. Experiments against six baselines, combining quantitative evaluation with qualitative comparisons, demonstrate improved affective alignment and content preservation, while ablations validate our design choices. Code and dataset will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FifeDelta: 超越情感标签用于图像编辑
articles.content_zh: 情感驱动的图像编辑旨在通过修改源图像中与情感相关的视觉提示来激发特定的目标情感,同时保持原场景的整体组成和语义-结构的一致性. 现有的场景级编辑器通常会以单一的情感类来指定目标,并经常从操作级文本指令中学习视觉转换. 一个类别将混合的情感端点倒入一个主导标签,而语言无法精确量化共存的情绪应如何增加、减少或保持稳定。 我们引入了AffectDelta,一个有源知觉的编辑器,将编辑作为八维情感分布之间的过渡. 一个被冻结的情感分布预导器估计出源状态,所签名的源到目标差编码了所请求的过渡的方向和规模. 在AffectDelta内部,一个内部过渡编码器和一个有源意识的传播主干器共同将这个信号转化为依赖上下文的语义和外观变化. 为了训练这种配方,我们建造了AffectPair-249K,由248,841个源目标对组成,并预测了八维分布,跨越了跨类别和类内过渡。 对照6个基线进行实验,将定量评价与定性比较结合起来,显示出效果一致和内容保存得到改善,同时模拟验证我们的设计选择。 守则和数据集将在接受后公开提供。

articles.title: Generalizable Brain Tumor Segmentation with Self-Training and Tumor-Aware Deformations
articles.content: This work presents an approach to the Generalizability Across Tumors (BraTS-GoAT) task of the BraTS 2026 Challenge, which focuses on robust segmentation of brain tumor sub-regions across a heterogeneous patient population. The proposed method employs the nnU-Net framework with a large residual encoder architecture, integrating a semi-supervised learning technique with pseudo-labels generated from the unlabeled training data and a tumor-aware deformable augmentation that locally deforms the lesion while preserving the surrounding anatomy. We evaluate the individual contributions of each component, as well as their combination, using varying proportions of the most confident pseudo-labeled cases. The submitted configuration for the generalization task achieves Dice and NSD scores of 0.881 and 0.473 for Whole Tumor, 0.817 and 0.490 for Tumor Core, and 0.775 and 0.533 for Enhancing Tumor on the BraTS-GoAT validation set, improving over the labeled-only baselines across all tumor regions and confirming that self-training and the proposed augmentation are complementary. Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Henrique-zan/brats-goat-2026/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 具有自修和肿瘤-心肌畸形的普通脑肿瘤分化
articles.content_zh: 这项工作为 " BratS-GOAT " 2026年挑战中的 " 肿瘤通览性 " 任务提供了一种方法,该任务侧重于不同病人群体中脑瘤分泌的强力分化。 拟议的方法采用nU-Net框架,采用大型残余编码器架构,将半监督学习技术与未贴标签的培训数据产生的伪标签相融合,并采用肿瘤感知变形增强法,在保存周围解剖学的同时使损伤变形。 我们利用不同比例的最具信心的假标签案件,评估每个组成部分的个别贡献及其组合。 一般化任务的提交配置实现全肿瘤分数为:Dice和NSD分数为:0.881分和0.473分;肿瘤核心分数为:0.817分和0.490分;在BrATS-GOAT验证集上增强肿瘤分数为:0.775分和0.533分;改进了所有肿瘤区域的标注唯一的基线;确认自我训练和拟议的增强是互补的. 我们的源代码可在https://github.com/Henrique-zan/brats-goat-2026/上公开查阅。

articles.title: Deeply Interleaved Text-Image Contexts for Multimodal LLMs Assessment
articles.content: Current evaluations and training of multimodal models predominantly focus on multi-image tasks, largely overlooking interleaved text-image scenarios. In such multi-image tasks, text typically serves merely as task instructions, lacking deep semantic interaction with the visual content. In contrast, realworld applications like text-image co-creation, character tracking, and spatial reconstruction require constant interaction between text and images. Consequently, models must possess a deep understanding of these interleaved contexts. To bridge this gap, we introduce a novel benchmark, TIC-Bench (deeply interleaved Text-Image Contexts), designed to evaluate the capability of models to integrate text-image clues and recover the ground truth facts within deeply interleaved contexts. This benchmark encompasses three core domains: Logical, Temporal, and Spatial Association, which are further categorized into eight specific types, comprising a total of 2,280 questions. We evaluated 10 state-of-the-art MLLMs and observed a substantial performance gap compared to human experts, together with persistent difficulties in integrating evidence distributed across interleaved visual and textual inputs. Ultimately, this benchmark provides a valuable analytical tool for assessing and advancing the ability of multimodal models to effectively integrate text and image information in deeply interleaved contexts. TIC-Bench is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/pino10010/TIC-Bench

articles.title_zh: 深交错 多式联运有限责任方案评估的文本图像背景
articles.content_zh: 目前对多模式模式的评价和培训主要侧重于多图像任务,基本上忽略了互放的文本图像设想。 在这样的多图像任务中,文本通常只是作为任务指示,缺乏与视觉内容的深度语义互动. 相形之下,文本-图像共生,字符跟踪,空间重建等现实世界应用需要文本和图像之间的不断互动. 因此,模型必须深入了解这些互不关联的背景。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了一个新的基准——TIC-Bench(深度互出式文字-图像背景),旨在评价模型在深度互出式背景下整合文本-图像线索并取回地面真相的能力. 这一基准包括三个核心领域:逻辑、临时和空间协会,它们进一步分为8个具体类别,共包括2 280个问题。 我们评价了10个最新水平的MLLMs,发现与人类专家相比,性能差距很大,而且始终难以综合通过相互间视觉和文字投入分发的证据。 归根结底,这一基准提供了一个宝贵的分析工具,用于评估和提高多式联运模式的能力,以便在深层互不关联的情况下有效地整合文本和图像信息。 东京中心-奔驰可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/pino-10010/东京中心-奔驰公开查阅。

articles.title: MARS: What Retrieval Signals Are Hidden in Multimodal Large Language Models for Text-Video Retrieval?
articles.content: Text-video retrieval requires representations that can distinguish videos with similar scenes, actions, and temporal patterns. Recent multimodal large language models have been adapted as embedding models, but they often represent each input using a single token from the final layer. This can compress diverse video-text cues into a single vector and limit fine-grained retrieval. To address this limitation, we propose MARS, a multi-layer and multi-slot embedding framework for text-video retrieval. MARS constructs multiple adaptive representation slots by combining hidden states from different decoder layers, compares corresponding text and video slots, and aggregates their similarities for retrieval. To better handle confusing candidates, we further introduce a hard-negative-aware slot specialization objective that encourages the slots to capture discriminative matching cues. Experiments on four text-video retrieval benchmarks show that MARS achieves state-of-the-art results in both direct similarity-based retrieval and reranking settings. Ablation studies and analyses demonstrate that multi-layer fusion, multiple slots, and hard-negative-aware slot specialization provide complementary gains. Code is available at https://github.com/sejong-rcv/MARS.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MARS: 文本-视频检索的多式大语言模型中隐藏着什么检索信号?
articles.content_zh: Text-video reference 需要能够区分具有相近场景,动作和时间规律的视频的表示. 最近的多式大型语言模型被改编为嵌入模型,但它们经常使用从最后一层取出的一个单一符号来代表每个输入. 这可以将各种视频文本提示压缩成单一向量并限制精细的检索. 为解决这一局限性,我们提议建立多层次和多片段的文本视频检索嵌入框架MARS。 MARS通过结合不同解码层的隐藏状态来构建多个适应性表示槽,比较相应的文本和视频槽,并汇总它们的相似性进行检索. 为了更好地处理令人困惑的候选人,我们进一步引入了硬负意识的档位专业化目标,鼓励档位捕捉出带有歧视性的匹配提示. 对四个文本-视频检索基准的实验表明,MARS在基于直接相似性的检索和重新排序的设置中都实现了最先进的结果. 分解研究与分析表明多层聚变,多槽和硬负意识分解分解的分解专业化可提供互补收益. 守则见https://github.com/sejong-rcv/MARS。

articles.title: Stereo 4D Radar for 3D Object Detection: Integrating Geometric Alignment and Absolute Velocity Estimation
articles.content: Four-dimensional (4D) Radar is a powerful sensing modality capable of detecting surrounding three-dimensional (3D) objects under diverse weather conditions and providing Doppler-based motion information. However, raw 4D Radar signals contain significant clutter from road surfaces, guardrails, and surrounding vehicles, along with multipath-induced ghost reflections and the receiver's inherent noise floor. Consequently, preprocessing algorithms designed to remove such invalid measurements often make the Radar data excessively sparse. Moreover, the Doppler measurements provided by 4D Radar describe only the radial component of an object's velocity, limiting their ability to recover the full motion state. In this paper, we introduce a stereo 4D Radar-based 3D object detection framework that exploits the geometric disparity between left and right Radars to estimate the absolute velocity of objects and achieve more robust perception through the fusion of their complementary features. The effectiveness of the proposed framework is validated on our in-house stereo 4D Radar dataset, demonstrating performance gains of 8.82 points in AP 3D and 9.0 points in AP BEV over state-of-the-art mono 4D Radar baselines. These results demonstrate that absolute velocity estimation combined with stereo geometry-aware feature fusion leads to substantial improvements in 3D object detection.

articles.title_zh: 三维物体探测立体4D雷达:整合几何对接和绝对高速估计
articles.content_zh: 四维(4D)雷达是一种强大的感知方式,能够在不同的天气条件下探测周围的三维(3D)物体并提供多普勒运动信息. 然而,生于4D 雷达信号中含有从路面、护栏和周围车辆上取出的大量杂乱无章地信号,以及多路径引起的鬼倒影和接收器固有的噪音地层。 因此,旨在去除这种无效测量的预处理算法往往使雷达数据过于稀少。 此外,由4D雷达提供的多普勒测量只描述了物体速度的射线成分,限制了它们恢复全运动状态的能力. 在本文中,我们引入了以立体4D雷达为基础的三维天体探测框架,利用左右雷达之间的几何相差来估计物体的绝对速度,并通过将相能互补的特征相融合来达到更强的感知. 拟议的框架的有效性在我们的内部立体声4D雷达数据集上得到验证,显示在AP 3D的8.82分和AP BEV的9.0分的性能收益高于最先进的单一4D雷达基线。 这些结果表明,绝对速度估计与立体几何-知觉特征聚变相结合,导致3D天体探测得到大幅改进.

articles.title: RGB-to-IR image translation for infrared vehicle detection in unseen UAV domains
articles.content: Synthetic training data is crucial for developing vision AI when real-world data is scarce, as in thermal infrared (IR) aerial vehicle detection. While abundant UAV RGB imagery motivates RGB-to-IR translation for data augmentation, unobservable thermal traits (e.g., engine heat) make learning transferable mappings challenging. This work investigates whether modern generative translators can overcome this cross-modal gap to improve infrared vehicle detection on unseen UAV target domains. Translators are trained on paired RGB-IR source datasets and applied to RGB training images from held-out target datasets to generate synthetic IR data. Evaluated methods include supervised GANs, ControlNet-based diffusion models, and foundation-model editing via LoRA. The resulting synthetic IR imagery is used to train RF-DETR vehicle detectors, which are evaluated on unseen IR target test splits across five aerial datasets, with Kust4K and VTUAV serving as target domains. Synthetic IR consistently outperforms RGB and grayscale baselines. Stable Diffusion 3.5 with ControlNet yields the best results, improving mAP from 50.8 to 60.1 on Kust4K and from 25.6 to 38.4 on VTUAV compared to models trained only on source-domain IR data. Increasing output diversity via multiple seeds (+1.1 mAP) and prompt variations (+3.3 mAP) provides additional gains on VTUAV. Although a performance gap to real target IR data remains, generative RGB-to-IR translation effectively mitigates IR data scarcity and improves cross-domain aerial vehicle detection.

articles.title_zh: 无人机域红外飞行器探测的 RGB- 到IR 图像翻译
articles.content_zh: 合成培训数据在现实世界数据稀缺时,如热红外(IR)飞行器探测中,对于开发视觉AI至关重要. 虽然丰富的UAV RGB图像激发了RGB到IR的翻译以进行数据增强,但不可观测的热特性(如发动机热能)使得学习可转移绘图具有挑战性. 这项工作调查了现代基因翻译是否能够克服这一跨模式的漏洞来改进无人机目标域上的红外飞行器探测. 翻译人员接受配对的RGB-IR源数据集的培训,并被应用到从被搁置的目标数据集的RGB训练图像中生成合成IR数据. 评价的方法包括受监督的GANs、基于ControlNet的传播模型和通过LORA进行的基础模型编辑。 由此产生的合成IR图像用于训练RF-DETR车辆探测器,这些探测器在未见的IR目标测试中被分出5个航空数据集进行评价,由Kust4K和VTUAV作为目标域. 合成IR的性能始终超过RGB和灰度基线. 与ControlNet的平稳扩散3.5产生最佳效果,与仅接受源域IR数据培训的模型相比,Kust4K的mAP从50.8提高到60.1,VTUAV从25.6提高到38.4。 通过多种子(+1.1 mAP)和即时变异(+3.3 mAP)来增加输出多样性,为VTUAV提供了额外的收益. 虽然与真实目标IR数据仍有性能差距,但基因RGB对IR的翻译有效缓解了IR数据的稀缺性并改进了跨域航空飞行器的检测.

articles.title: Spatially Aware World Action Model via Geometric Latent Diffusion
articles.content: World Action Models (WAMs) leverage the capabilities of large-scale pretrained video diffusion models to jointly predict future observations and actions, inheriting rich visual and physical priors from internet-scale video. This has made them a promising paradigm for robot policy learning, yet the prevailing models operate exclusively on RGB observations and do not leverage 3D information. To bridge this gap, we introduce a Spatially Aware World Action Model (SA-WAM), which repurposes a pretrained video model for joint action, RGB, and depth prediction, enabling 3D-aware world modeling and action prediction within a single diffusion backbone. We use a nonlinear encoding that maps the unbounded depth signal into the bounded input domain expected by the frozen VAE tokenizer. This allows us to reuse the tokenizer without 3D-specific fine-tuning, incorporating geometric information without sacrificing the pretrained priors. SA-WAM achieves state-of-the-art results on the RoboCasa and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks, while simultaneously improving future-state predictions. Furthermore, SA-WAM outperforms strong baselines in real-world evaluation using a UR5 robotic arm, with strong gains in randomized environments. We analyze the correlation between world model prediction quality and rollout success, providing insights into WAM performance and avenues for its improvement.

articles.title_zh: 通过几何底线扩散实现空间意识世界行动模型
articles.content_zh: 世界行动模型(WAMS)利用大规模预先训练的视频传播模型的能力,共同预测未来的观察和行动,继承了互联网规模视频中丰富的视觉和物理前科. 这使得它们成为了机器人政策学习的有希望的范式,而目前流行的模型完全在RGB观测上运行,并没有利用3D信息. 为了弥合这一差距,我们引入了一个空间意识世界行动模型(SA-WAM),该模型重新使用一个经过预先培训的视频模型,用于联合行动、RGB和深度预测,从而能够在单一的传播主干内进行3D意识世界模型和行动预测。 我们使用一个非线性编码,将无限制的深度信号映射到被冻结的VAE表示器所期望的有限制的输入域. 这使得我们能在不进行3D特异性的微调的情况下再用活化剂,在不牺牲预先训练过的前科的情况下,纳入几何信息. SA-WAM在"RoboCasa"和"LIBERO-Plus"基准上取得了最先进的成绩,同时改善了未来状态预测. 此外,SA-WAM使用UR5机器人臂在现实世界评价中超越了强基线,在随机化环境中取得了显著收益。 我们分析了世界模型预测质量与推出成功之间的关联,提供了对WAM性能的洞察,以及改进WAM的途径.

articles.title: Fine-Grained Anomaly Perception in Wild UGC-Enhanced Images: A Comprehensive Dataset and Difference-Fusion Framework
articles.content: Image enhancement and restoration have become standard back-end operations on short-video and social media platforms to boost UGC visual experience. Yet these processes inevitably introduce visual anomalies--especially in faces, texts, and textures--that directly undermine perceptual fidelity and viewer trust. While existing IQA methods perform well on classic distortions, they target holistic quality assessment and fail to capture the specific, localized anomalies caused by enhancement algorithms in real-world UGC. To bridge this gap, we formally define a new task-quality Anomaly Perception for UGC image Enhancement (UEAP), and contribute the first UEAP benchmark dataset, named UEAP-4k, curated from the real business scenarios. It provides fine-grained annotations for anomaly categories, localization and severity levels. Furthermore, we propose a Difference-Fusion Anomaly Perception Method (DFAP-UGC) for wild UGC-enhanced images, which leverages explicit problem-reference difference fusion with dense spatial querying, regional verification, and quality-aware ranking, enabling robust anomaly identification in challenging scenarios. To handle the inherent coupling of subtasks in this new task, we propose a Locality-Aware Dynamic Task Prioritization (LADTP) training strategy that enables effective end-to-end learning and eliminates multi-stage overhead. Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms baselines adapted from classical approaches for this task, validating the value of this dataset and the superior of DFAP-UGC for robust UGC-enhanced image anomaly perception. Code and data will be public.

articles.title_zh: 野生UGC增强的精致异常感知 图像:综合数据集和差异组合框架
articles.content_zh: 图像增强与恢复成为了短视频和社交媒体平台的标准后端操作,以提升UGC视觉体验. 然而,这些过程不可避免地带来了视觉异常——特别是在面相、文字和纹理方面——从而直接地破坏了观念上的忠诚和观众的信任。 虽然现有的IQA方法在经典扭曲上表现良好,但它们针对的是整体质量评估,未能捕捉到现实世界UGC中由增强算法所引发的具体,局部的异常. 为了弥补这一差距,我们正式定义了UGC图像增强(UEAP)的新任务质量异常感知,并提供了第一个UEAP基准数据集,取名UEAP-4k,从真实的业务情景中整理出. 它为异常类别、地方化和严重程度提供了精细的说明。 此外,我们提议对野生UGC增强图像采用不同致幻异常感知方法(DFAP-UGC),通过密集的空间查询、区域核查和对质量的认知排名,利用明确的问题参考差异聚变,在具有挑战性的情景中进行有力的异常识别。 为了在这项新任务中处理子任务的内在结合,我们提议一个本地化-智能动态任务优先化(LADTP)培训战略,以便有效进行端到端的学习,并消除多阶段的间接费用. 广泛的实验表明,我们的方法超越了从古典方法为这项任务所改编的基线,验证了这个数据集的价值和DFAP-UGC对于强大的UGC增强图像异常感知的上等值. 代码和数据将公开。

articles.title: Doppio: A Dataset for Contactless Weight Estimation of Falling Particles
articles.content: Measuring the mass of powder, including falling particles, is a common task in industrial applications. While scales are effective for static measurements, many applications require contactless sensing, where existing solutions are often costly, application-specific, and technically complex. In this work, we investigate computer vision as a practical alternative for contactless mass estimation. As an accessible real-world case study, we focus on coffee grinding and introduce \emph{Doppio}, a novel video dataset capturing videos of falling ground coffee, paired with precise, per-frame ground-truth weight measurements. To demonstrate contactless measuring, we evaluate deep learning-based approaches ranging from purely spatial feed-forward networks to recurrent spatio-temporal models. These models are analyzed with respect to their predictive accuracy and computational trade-offs. We demonstrate that deep learning-based computer vision models accurately estimate the cumulative weight of falling particles, establishing a solid foundation for future vision-based contactless measurement solutions.

articles.title: Beauty is in the AI of the beholder: MLLMs systematically overrate facial attractiveness
articles.content: Beauty assessments from Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly popular amongst users, companies, and aestheticians. This raises the question of whether these AI models can accurately reflect human judgments of attractiveness. In a pre- registered exploratory study, we compared the attractiveness ratings of 2,513 human participants to four widely used commercial AI models: Claude, Gemini, GPT, and Grok. Results showed that MLLMs systematically rate faces more favourably and within a narrower range than humans and, at the time of study, do not reproduce human ratings in absolute terms. However, MLLMs exhibit strong correlations with human attractiveness judgments, accurately tracking the rank-ordering of faces. MLLMs may judge faces by different cues than humans; only face age was a predictor of facial attractiveness in both humans and MLLMs, with inconsistent patterns across models for ethnicity and gender. AI models strongly agree with one another, except for Grok, which also showed the lowest agreement with humans. Our findings suggest that while they may be able to approximate rank-orderings of human attractiveness, current off-the-shelf commercial MLLMs systematically overrate the beauty of human faces.

articles.title_zh: 美貌在观众的AI中: MLLMs系统地高估了面部吸引力
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型的美貌评估在用户、公司和美学家中越来越受欢迎。 这就提出了一个问题,即这些AI模型是否能够准确反映人类对吸引力的判断. 在一项注册前的探索性研究中,我们把2,513名人类参与者的吸引力评级比作被广泛使用的四种商业AI模型: 克劳德 双子座 GPT 还有Grok 结果显示,MLLMS系统化的收视率比人类更有利,范围更窄,在研究时不以绝对值来再现人类收视率. 然而,MLLMs表现出了与人类吸引力判断的强烈相关性,准确地跟踪了面相的排序. MLLM可能用与人类不同的暗示来判断面相;只有面相年龄可以预测人类和MLLM的面相吸引力,不同种族和性别模型的模式不一致。 AI模型互相强烈认同,除了格罗克之外,后者也表现出了与人类最低的一致. 我们的研究结果表明,虽然它们可以大致了解人类吸引力的排序,但目前的现成商业MLLMs系统地夸大了人脸的美。

articles.title: Orthogonal Ensembles and Tested Explanations for Performer-Independent Body-Motion Emotion Recognition
articles.content: We study body-only, 12-class acted-emotion classification from skeleton motion under leave-performer-out (LPO) evaluation, a hard, underdetermined setting: chance is 8.3%, and a protocol-matched reproduced STGCN++ baseline reaches only 25.73 +/- 4.03% Macro-F1. We show that reliable gains come not from a new architecture but from combining eleven models with orthogonal error modes: under 10-fold LPO cross-validation on the labeled training performers, an equal-weight logit-mean ensemble reaches 36.80 +/- 4.00% per-fold Macro-F1, a protocol-matched +11.07 pp (+43% relative) over the same-split reproduced baseline. Our central contribution is a tested explanation suite: for a strong ensemble member, part-masking and counterfactual edits show (rather than assert) that its decisions depend on motion-grounded body-region evidence, and this region saliency aligns with rule-based Laban Movement Analysis (LMA) attributes far more than with classical kinematics: region-level saliency-LMA Spearman rho = +0.500 versus +0.033, roughly 15x, and the alignment holds for the submitted 11-way ensemble itself at rho = +0.517; the audit is post hoc and needs no retraining. The same suite faithfully reports a negative: within-window temporal saliency is diffuse rather than localized.

articles.title: SR-Edit: Region-Aware Image Editing via Self-Refinement
articles.content: With the recent rapid progress in generative models, image editing has made remarkable advances, yet achieving faithful edits that precisely modify only the target regions while strictly preserving all other regions remains challenging. Since externally provided region annotations are often difficult to obtain in practice, a growing body of work seeks to improve preservation by automatically inferring edit and non-edit regions, and then enforcing consistency on the latter. However, these approaches still suffer from inaccurate region estimation and heuristic correction strategies that distort the native inference process, making methods designed for fidelity themselves a new source of artifacts. We propose SR-Edit, an image editing framework that overcomes these issues via iterative self-refinement. Specifically, at each iteration, SR-Edit first (i) extracts progressively precise and self-consistent region separation from the model's own predictions by lightweight post-processing, and then (ii) enforces preservation in non-edit areas through correction updates that remain aligned with the original sampling dynamics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SR-Edit achieves superior preservation and overall image quality compared to existing editing techniques.

articles.title_zh: SR-Edit:通过自译自审的区域智能图像编辑
articles.content_zh: 随着最近基因模型的快速发展,图像编辑工作取得了显著进展,然而,在严格保护所有其他区域的同时,实现仅精确修改目标区域的忠实编辑仍然是一项挑战。 由于外部提供的区域说明在实践中往往难以获得,越来越多的工作试图通过自动推断编辑区和非编辑区来改进保存工作,然后对后者强制执行一致性。 然而,这些方法仍然受到不准确的区域估计和高压修正策略的影响,这些策略扭曲了本地推论过程,使为忠诚而设计的方法成为了新的文物来源。 我们提议进行SR-Edit,这是一个图像编辑框架,通过迭接自我改进来克服这些问题. 具体来说,在每次迭代时,SR-Edit首先(一)通过轻量级后处理从模型本身的预测中逐步取出精确而自相容的区域分出,再(二)通过与原始采样动态保持一致的校正更新在非编辑区执行保存. 广泛的实验表明,SR-Edit与现有的编辑技术相比,实现了更好的保存和整体图像质量.

articles.title: Blending Concepts: Benchmarking Visual Metaphor Generation in Text-to-Image Models
articles.content: Text-to-image (T2I) models have achieved remarkable success at faithfully rendering specified objects and attributes, yet their ability to produce visual metaphors, images that convey abstract ideas by combining elements from two distinct domains, remains largely unexamined. To bridge this gap, we introduce VMetaphor-Bench, the first benchmark for evaluating visual metaphor generation in T2I models. It comprises 1,500 visual metaphors curated from real-world creative imagery, organized into three levels and ten categories, with each sample paired with two prompts of differing specificity. For evaluation, we develop a hybrid framework within an MLLM-as-judge paradigm, combining a multiple-choice question (MCQ) based protocol of 9,594 questions across four levels of metaphorical fidelity with a dimension-based scoring protocol along three perceptual dimensions. Extensive evaluation of 11 representative T2I models reveals that even the strongest proprietary models struggle with compositional structuring and cross-domain mapping, key aspects of metaphorical expression, highlighting visual metaphor generation as an important frontier for future T2I research.

articles.title_zh: Blending Concepts: 文本到图像模型中视觉元数据生成基准
articles.content_zh: 文本到图像(T2I)模型在忠实地渲染特定对象和属性方面取得了显著的成功,然而它们产生视觉比喻的能力,通过结合两个不同领域的元素来传达抽象思想的图像,基本上仍未被考量. 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了VMetaphor-Bench,这是T2I模型中第一个评价视觉比喻生成的基准. 它由1 500个视觉比喻组成,从现实世界的创造性图像整理而成,分为三个层次和十个类别,每个样本配以两个不同规格的提示。 为了评价,我们在MLLM-as-judge范式内开发了一个混合框架,将基于多个选择问题的9,594个问题在4个比喻忠实级别上与基于维度的评分协议结合到3个认知维度上。 对11个具有代表性的T2I模型的广泛评价揭示出,即使是最强的专有模型也与组成结构与跨域绘图,比喻表达的关键方面相抗衡,强调视觉比喻生成是未来T2I研究的重要前沿.

articles.title: ViSAR: Training-Free Adaptive-$k$ Retrieval for Visual Document Question Answering
articles.content: Document Visual Question Answering (DocVQA) often leverages Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), where late-interaction encoders are commonly used to identify document pages relevant to a user query, before answer generation by a Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM). Existing approaches typically retrieve a fixed top-$k$ number of pages regardless of query complexity, which increases LVLM latency and may degrade answer accuracy. We introduce ViSAR (Visual Semantic Activation Retrieval), a training-free adaptive-$k$ retrieval method for late-interaction visual document retrieval. ViSAR operates directly in the embedding space to construct a query-conditioned page-level similarity matrix that highlights query-relevant semantics and dynamically determines the number of pages to retrieve. Across multiple encoders and LVLMs, ViSAR retrieves compact, query-adapted page sets that reduce RAG latency by up to 58.7\%, while maintaining or improving answer accuracy compared with fixed top-$k$ and adaptive retrieval heuristics. Furthermore, we show that the similarity matrix structure correlates with answer accuracy, suggesting future directions for retrieval quality-aware document understanding.

articles.title_zh: ViSAR:可视文件答题的免费培训适应性检索
articles.content_zh: 文档可视化问答(DocVQA)经常会利用检索-增强生成(RAG),其中后期交互编码器通常用于识别与用户查询相关的文档页面,而后再由大型视觉-语言模型(LVLM)生成答案. 现有方法通常可以检索固定的顶美元页数,而不论查询的复杂程度如何,这会增加LVLM的活度并可能降低答题的准确性。 我们采用Visual语义活性检索法(Visual Semanic Actionivation Retrieval),这是一种免费的适应性检索方法,用于后期交互视觉文件检索. ViSAR在嵌入空间中直接运行,以构建一个有查询条件的页面级类似矩阵,突出与查询相关的语义并动态地决定要检索的页面数量. 通过多个编码器和LVLM,VISAR检索了紧凑的,经过查询调整的页面集,可以将RAG的空闲度降低到58.7%%,同时与固定的上行元和适应性检索高压相比,保持或提高答案的准确性. 此外,我们表明,相似性矩阵结构与答案的准确性相关,为了解质量的文件提出未来方向。

articles.title: UnCapsTSR: An Unsupervised Transformer-based Image Super-Resolution Approach for Capsule Endoscopy Images
articles.content: Wireless Capsule Endoscopy (WCE) captures and streams video while passing through a patient's Gastrointestinal (GI) tract and is used to examine its irregularities. Although advantageous over conventional endoscopy, WCE suffers from limitations related to capsule size and wireless transmission, resulting in images with coarser resolution. This work presents UnCapsTSR, an unsupervised transformer-based Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) framework for improving the spatial resolution of Low-Resolution (LR) WCE images. The proposed method accomplishes SR without explicit degradation estimation of real-world LR data and eliminates the need for true LR-HR pairs. UnCapsTSR employs a Bilateral Total Variation (BTV) loss to ensure spatial continuity in SR images. A newly curated dataset from the Kvasir Capsule dataset is also presented for training WCE SR models. Generalizability is validated on KID and GIANA datasets that are not used during training. A new non-reference metric, Endoscopy Quality Metric (EndoQM), is introduced for quantitative evaluation of domain-specific WCE data. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvement over state-of-the-art unsupervised SR approaches using NIQE, BRISQUE, PIQE, and EndoQM. Statistical evaluation shows 40 to 80 percent improvement in EndoQM from LR to SR across the evaluated datasets.

articles.title_zh: UncapsTSR: Capsule Endoscopy 图像的无监督变形器超解方法

articles.title: Learning to Track from Privileged Target Appearances
articles.content: Target templates define what a visual tracker searches for, yet the templates available at inference trade off localization certainty with appearance freshness: the initial ground-truth template is exact but becomes stale, whereas recent templates better reflect the current appearance but are cropped from uncertain predictions. We quantify this bottleneck with a non-deployable oracle that supplies an exact current-frame target crop, improving AUC on LaSOT by 15.2 percentage points. This gap reveals a training-only opportunity: frame-level ground truths provide exact current- and future-frame target crops, although such crops are unavailable at deployment. We introduce Privileged Appearance Transfer for Tracking (PATT), a teacher-student training framework that transfers these privileged appearances to a deployable tracker through multi-level representation prediction. The privileged teacher observes exact target crops from past, current, and future frames, whereas the student receives only past-frame templates and learns to predict the teacher's search representations. To avoid transferring unreliable teacher signals, PATT weights this transfer by the teacher's relative localization advantage over the student and its absolute localization accuracy. After training, the teacher, latent predictor, reliability weights, and privileged crops are removed, leaving standard student-only inference. Across seven benchmarks at two model scales, PATT achieves consistent gains under both long- and short-term tracking protocols.
