articles.title_zh: 从特权目标外观学习到跟踪
articles.content_zh: 目标模板界定可视化跟踪器的搜索内容,然而可以推断的模板将本地化的确定性与外观的新鲜性相交换:最初的地面真实模板是准确的,但变得僵硬;而最近的模板则更好地反映了目前的外观,但来自不确定的预测。 我们用一个无法调动的甲骨文来量化这个瓶颈,该甲骨文提供了准确的当前目标作物,使拉索特岛的AUC提高了15.2%. 这一差距暴露出只有培训的机会:框架一级的地面真相提供了准确的当前和未来目标作物,尽管部署时没有这种作物。 我们引入了 " 跟踪的特权外观转移 " (PATT),这是一个师生培训框架,通过多层次的代表预测,将这些特权外观转移到可部署的跟踪器上。 优等教师从过去、现在和未来的角度观察确切的目标作物,而学生只收到过去的框架模板并学会预测教师的搜索表现。 为了避免传输不可靠的教师信号,PATT通过教师相对于学生的相对本地化优势及其绝对本地化精度来权衡这种转移. 经过培训后,教师、潜在预测器、可靠性重量和特有作物被删除,留下标准的只有学生的推断。 在两个模型尺度的7个基准中,PATT在长期和短期跟踪协议下都取得了一致的收益。

articles.title: VIPS: Vehicle-Infrastructure Cooperative Planning Benchmark via Pseudo-Simulation
articles.content: End-to-end autonomous driving in urban environments requires robust decision-making under partial observability and complex multi-agent interactions. Severe occlusions and dense traffic at intersections limit the perception capability of single-agent systems, motivating recent efforts on Vehicle-to-Infrastructure (V2I) cooperation for perception and planning. However, existing evaluation protocols face a fundamental trade-off: open-loop evaluation fails to capture error accumulation and recovery from deviations, while closed-loop evaluation is costly, difficult to scale, and often relies on simulated environments that may suffer from domain gaps. To bridge this gap, we propose VIPS, a benchmark for cooperative autonomous driving in V2I settings based on pseudo-simulation. VIPS extends pseudo-simulation by integrating vehicle and infrastructure observations. This enables scalable yet realistic evaluation of robustness and error propagation without full simulation. We further present CoS-V2X, a cooperative planning framework based on sparse representations. CoS-V2X models vehicle-infrastructure interactions using compact features for efficient communication and robust decision-making under heterogeneous observations. Code and dataset are available at https://vips2026.github.io.

articles.title_zh: VIPS: 通过Pseudo-模拟的车辆基础设施合作规划基准
articles.content_zh: 城市环境中的端到端自主驱动需要在部分可观察性和复杂的多剂相互作用下进行有力的决策. 交叉路口的严重隔离和密集交通限制了单一代理系统的感知能力,促使最近在车辆与基础设施(V2I)合作促进感知和规划方面作出努力。 然而,现有的评价协议面临着一个根本的权衡:开球评价未能捕捉出出错的积累和从偏差中恢复,而开球闭球评价成本高昂,难以规模化,并且往往依赖于可能受域间隙影响的模拟环境. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出VIPS,这是基于伪模拟在V2I环境下合作自主驾驶的基准. VIPS通过整合车辆和基础设施观测来扩展伪模拟. 这有助于在不进行全面模拟的情况下,对稳健性和误差传播情况进行可扩展而现实的评估。 我们进一步提出COS-V2X,这是一个基于稀少陈述的合作规划框架。 COS-V2X型机车与基础设施的相互作用,采用紧凑的特性,在各种观测下进行有效的交流和有力的决策。 代码和数据集见https://vips2026.github.io。

articles.title: WiFlow: Estimating Optical Flow using WiFi Channel State Information
articles.content: Knowing where and how fast objects are moving within a scene is important across various domains. Usually, cameras are used to capture the data necessary for this task, but adding cameras often raises privacy concerns, and the quality of captured frames is heavily influenced by lighting conditions. In this work, we explore using WiFi channel state information (CSI) instead of camera frames for optical flow estimation. We propose WiFlow, a CSI based flow estimator, a preprocessor evaluation for CSI, and three model architectures that offer different trade-offs between accuracy and complexity. Further, we create the first dataset for training and evaluating CSI-based optical flow estimators, and our experiments provide insights into key design elements for this task. Code and data are available at https://visinf.github.io/wiflow.

articles.title: Adapting a Foundation Model for Lunar Surface Height Estimation
articles.content: Digital elevation models (DEMs) can provide accurate height information, making it invaluable for analyzing the lunar surface. As the European Space Agency (ESA) prepares for future lunar missions that aim to land on the Moon, a precise method for height estimation will be essential for hazardous terrain that could endanger the landing approach. Traditional approaches to generate DEMs from imagery, such as shape from shading (SfS) and stereophotogrammetry (SPG) have been proven highly valuable for this task. However, due to advancements in machine learning, especially computer vision, the focus has shifted towards monocular depth estimation via deep learning. The lunar surface is covered by rocks and craters, and classic hazard detection methods rely solely on 2D image data. Our goal is to address this issue by developing a relative lunar surface height estimator that can provide additional information for hazard localization. In this letter, we present a methodology that builds on the well-known zero-shot relative depth estimation model Depth Anything V2 (DAV2). Other works have been using it as a state-of-the-art comparison for their proposed lunar DEM estimation method, but without adaptations to the target domain. Thus, it may underperform. Therefore, we propose a fine-tuning strategy with publicly available SPG-derived DEM data of the lunar surface. Our results demonstrate a significant improvement in performance compared to the zero-shot model, effectively transforming DAV2 into a reliable relative depth estimator of the lunar surface.

articles.title: Uncertainty-Guided Adverse Weather Restoration via Gated Transformer Network
articles.content: Restoring images degraded by adverse weather remains challenging due to spatially heterogeneous degradations. Many existing weather-specific restoration models rely on weather-agnostic global aggregation, naive cross-scale fusion, and deterministic objectives, which struggle to handle heterogeneous degradations in all-in-one adverse-weather settings. To address these limitations, we propose an Uncertainty-guided Adverse-weather Restoration Network (UAR-Net), a weather-specific AiO framework that integrates a gated transformer with balanced multi-scale skip connections. Specifically, we employ Gated Dual-scale Transformer Blocks (GDTB) to jointly model selective global interactions and multi-scale local structures, a progressive Balanced Multi-scale Skip Connection (BMSC) for balanced multi-scale feature integration, and an Uncertainty-Aware Refinement Head (URH) that performs artifact removal, detail enhancement, and predictive uncertainty estimation. The model is supervised by a Brightness-Aware Energy Loss (BAE-Loss) to encourage accurate reconstruction with well-calibrated uncertainty. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple adverse-weather benchmarks. The codes will open source upon acceptance.

articles.title_zh: 通过 Gated 变形器网络进行逆天气修复
articles.content_zh: 恢复因恶劣天气而退化的图像仍然具有挑战性,因为空间的退化各不相同。 许多现有的针对具体天气的恢复模型依赖于天气不可知的全球聚合、天真地的跨规模聚变和确定性目标,这些都难以在全天候的不利天气环境中处理不同的退化。 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议建立一个不确定的、有指导作用的逆向天气恢复网络(UAR-Net),这是一个针对天气的AiO框架,将门式变压器与平衡的多尺度跳过连接结合起来。 具体地说,我们利用Gated双相分级变压器块(GDTB)联合模拟选择性全球相互作用和多相分级局部结构,用于平衡多相分级特性整合的渐进平衡多相分级跳接连接(BMSC),以及进行文物清除,细节增强和预测不确定性估计的不确定-智能优化头(URH). 该模型由Brightness-Award Energy Loss(BAE-Loss)监督,以鼓励准确的重建,并精确地调整不确定性. 广泛的实验表明,我们的方法实现了跨越多种不利天气基准的最先进性能。 密码接收后会打开源码.

articles.title: The Diagnosis a Reporter Leaves Unspoken: Surfacing Frozen Tumor Features for Brain-Tumor MRI Reporting
articles.content: A capable brain-MRI report generator can still be, in effect, diagnostically silent. When a multi-chain chain-of-thought (CoT) reporter built on a medical Mistral-7B backbone is evaluated on held-out cohorts, it names most meningiomas and almost all metastases "glioma" (diagnosis recall 0.44/0.07). Yet the answer is not absent from the model: a supervised linear probe applied to its frozen segmentation features recovers the three tumour cohorts at 0.82 macro-F$_1$ (5-fold cross-validation; chance $\approx$0.33). We introduce NeuroFusion, an assistive reporter that surfaces this latent signal rather than overriding it: discriminative field-classifier heads over per-lesion features condition a fast, single-pass draft-then-review decoder on their committed outputs. Built on the identical Mistral backbone, this restores the diagnosis (meningioma 0.92, metastasis 0.75) and wins 8 of 9 prose-content comparisons across three held-out cohorts (RaTEScore, RadGraph-F$_1$, GREEN; Holm-corrected paired BCa), with no significant loss on the ninth, at 5-6x lower latency ($\approx$80 vs. 457 s/case). A controlled negative result sharpens the mechanism: a learned diagnosis pin that overrides the decoder instead of merely informing it collapses out-of-distribution metastasis recall to 0.03. Grammar-constrained decoding keeps 92.3% of records schema-valid, making every sentence entailment-checkable (7.5% contradicted vs. 36.8% for the direct baseline). In a blinded nine-case pilot, two board-certified neurologists independently rated NeuroFusion highest in every tumour type, the only system with zero critical errors, and gave it the top-rated sign-off in eight of nine cases (six outright, two ties).

articles.title_zh: 诊断一名记者离开未发言:脑-肿瘤磁共振突变异构 报告
articles.content_zh: 一个有能力的脑-MRI报告生成器实际上仍然可以诊断沉默. 当一个基于医疗Mistral-7B主干线的多链式思维链(CoT)记者在被搁置的组群上被评价时,它将大多数脑膜炎(meningiomas)和几乎所有元瘤(glioma)命名为"glioma"(诊断召回了0.44/0.07). 然而,模型中并非没有答案:适用于其冷冻分解特性的有监督的线性探测器将三个肿瘤群恢复到0.82个宏-F$_1美元(5倍交叉验证;概率约为0.33美元)。 我们介绍神经融合, 一个辅助记者 浮出这个潜在的信号,而不是压倒它: 歧义的场-分级器头 超过每层的特性 条件是一个快速的,单传的草稿 - 时审查的解码器 对于他们的承诺输出。 这基于同样的米斯特拉尔骨干,恢复了诊断(meningioma 0.92, metastasis 0.75),并在三个被搁置组别(RaTEScore,RadGraph-F$_1$,GREEN;Holm校正成对的BCa)中赢得了9个亲子内容比较中的8个,第9个没有重大损失,为5-6x低等(约80美元对457 s/case)。 一种可控的负面结果使机制更加精锐:一个能超越解码器的有学问的诊断针,而不是仅仅告知它会崩溃出分配元分解回溯到0.03. 语法限制的解码保留了92.3%的记录的系统验证,使每个句子都具有核对能力(直接基线的7.5%与36.8%相矛盾)。 在一个被蒙蔽了的9个病例飞行员中,两名板认证神经学家独立评分神经融合在每种肿瘤类型中最高,是唯一一个有零临界误差的系统,并在9个病例中的8个(6个彻底,2个联系)中给予它最高分的签注.

articles.title: CA-OPD: Confidence-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Structured Visual Prediction
articles.content: Autoregressive vision language models unify heterogeneous perception tasks but are highly susceptible to compounding errors. On-policy distillation (OPD) bridges the training-inference mismatch by training students on their own rollouts. However, unreliable student predictions, especially early in training, can derail the trajectory and degrade the quality of teacher supervision. While recent interleaved distillation methods allow the teacher to verify and replace student tokens, they primarily rely on rigid ranking metrics rather than exact teacher confidence, and they overlook how intervention decisions can inform token-level supervision. To address this, we introduce Confidence-Aware On-Policy Distillation (CA-OPD), a framework that couples reliable rollout construction with adaptive supervision. CA-OPD utilizes teacher confidence to selectively correct unreliable student transitions, gradually transferring rollout control to the student via a strict-to-relaxed schedule. Crucially, CA-OPD aligns knowledge transfer with these intervention decisions: corrected positions receive direct cross-entropy supervision from the teacher's prediction, while retained positions benefit from the teacher's full predictive distribution. Evaluated in a multi-teacher setting for GUI grounding and optical character recognition, CA-OPD substantially improves the Qwen3.5-0.8B baseline across all six target benchmarks, including gains of $9.50$ points on ScreenSpot-Pro and $6.72$ points on OCRBench-v2 English. Controlled studies further show that the gains depend on intervention placement, progressive rollout control, and intervention-aligned supervision, rather than intervention frequency alone.

articles.title_zh: CA- OPD: 结构化视觉预测的置信- 智能政策分级
articles.content_zh: 自动后退的视觉语言模型统一了不同的感知任务,但极易发生复合错误. 政策上提炼(OPD)通过对学生进行自己的推广培训来弥补培训与推论的不匹配. 然而,学生的预测不可靠,特别是在培训初期,可能使轨迹脱轨并降低教师监管的质量. 虽然最近的互出式蒸馏方法使教师能够验证和替换学生代币,但它们主要依靠严格的排名衡量标准,而不是精确的教师信心,它们忽略了干预决定如何为代币级监督提供信息. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了信心-知情的政策制定(CA-OPD)这一框架,夫妇在适应性监督下可靠地展开建设。 CA-OPD利用教师信心有选择地纠正不可靠的学生过渡,通过严格到放松的时间表逐渐将推广控制转移给学生. 关键的是,CA-OPD将知识转移与这些干预决定相协调:被纠正的职位从教师的预测中直接得到跨学科监督,而被保留的职位则得益于教师的全面预测分布. CA-OPD在为GUI定位和光学字符识别而设置的多教师环境中进行了评估,大大改进了所有6个目标基准的Quen3.5-0.8B基线,包括ScreenSpot-Pro的9.50分和OCR Bench-v2英语的6.72分。 受控制的研究进一步表明,这些成果取决于干预安排、逐步推出控制和干预协调监督,而不仅仅是干预频率。

articles.title: Seeing Beyond the Lesion: Disease Recognition from Reactive CNS Tissue
articles.content: Sampling error yields exclusively reactive, non-lesional brain parenchyma in a significant proportion of intracranial biopsies, leaving the underlying disease undiagnosed. We benchmark four pathology foundation models (UNI2-h, Virchow2, Prov-GigaPath, H-optimus-0) as frozen patch encoders within a shared attention-based multiple-instance learning framework using 245 whole-slide images from 186 patients with confirmed downstream diagnoses. We first show that coarse disease-category prediction can be reproduced largely from slide size alone. After restricting classification to three finer diagnostic distinctions within common tissue categories, this confound no longer explains performance, yet disease labels remain predictable above chance under permutation testing (p $\le 10^{-4}$ throughout). Surprisingly, performance is statistically indistinguishable across all foundation-model encoders, suggesting that recovering these weak morphological signatures is not limited by current patch representations. Signed instance-contribution maps and expert review further test whether predictive evidence localizes to reactive parenchyma rather than sampling-induced bias like blood introduced during tissue sampling. These results position acquisition-shortcut auditing via a provenance-only baseline as a necessary control in computational-pathology benchmarks, and show, once that confound is removed, that weakly supervised models still recover disease signal from tissue conventionally regarded as non-diagnostic.

articles.title: ProSR: Semantic-Prototype-Guided Discrete Modeling for Physically Consistent SAR Super-Resolution
articles.content: High-resolution Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery is critical for precision analysis such as automatic target recognition, yet its acquisition is costly. Although generative image super-resolution (ISR) models offer a promising alternative, current smooth-approximation based diffusion frameworks often struggle to preserve the coherent scattering statistics, causing stochastic structural distortions that are less consistent with real SAR physics. To address this, we propose Semantic Prototype-Guided Super-Resolution (ProSR), reformulating SAR ISR as a semantically-guided discrete token prediction task within a quantized latent space. By mapping signal features to discrete scattering primitives, ProSR preserves the impulsive nature of SAR without over-smoothing. Furthermore, we integrate a Self-Supervised Learning backbone into SAR ISR to extract label-free semantic priors, overcoming label scarcity. Guided by these priors, we introduce Semantic-Aligned Detail Encoding to decouple high-frequency signals into discrete scattering primitives. In parallel, the Semantic Prototype Map Generator explicitly constructs semantic prototype maps, allowing Prototype-Map-Guided Attention to route the information flows within identical categories and mitigate inter-class interference. To validate our approach, we present a large-scale 0.25m resolution benchmark from the Umbra Open Dataset. Experimental results show ProSR achieves superior visual quality while preserving essential scattering characteristics required for practical SAR applications.

articles.title_zh: ProSR:语义-原型-指向 物理上一致的合成孔径雷达超分辨率分解模型
articles.content_zh: 高分辨率合成孔径雷达(SAR)图像对于诸如自动目标识别等精准分析至关重要,然而其获取成本却很高. 虽然基因图像超分辨率模型提供了一个有希望的替代方案,但目前的平滑近似传播框架往往难以保存连贯的散射统计数据,造成结构扭曲,与真正的合成孔径雷达物理学不一致。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议采用语义原型 -- -- 指向超分辨率(ProSR),将SAR ISR改编为在被量化的潜在空间内进行分解的离散符号预测的任务。 通过将信号特征映射到离散散的原始人身上,ProSR保持了合成孔径雷达的冲动性而不会过沉. 此外,我们还将一个自我监督的学习主干网纳入搜索和救援ISR,以提取无标签语义学前科,克服标签稀缺的问题。 以这些前科为指导,我们引入了语义-相通详细编码,将高频信号解为离散散的原始相. 同时,语义原型地图生成器明确构建了语义原型地图,允许原型-马普-Guided Content对相同类别内的信息流进行路由,并减轻类间的干扰. 为了验证我们的方法,我们从Umbra Open Datas集中提出了一个0.25m的大规模分辨率基准。 实验结果表明,ProSR在保持实际合成孔径雷达应用所需的基本散射特性的同时,实现了较高的视觉质量。

articles.title: Information Density Imbalance in Visual Object Detection
articles.content: In object detection, the number of instances is typically used to determine whether a dataset exhibits a long-tailed distribution, implicitly assuming that the model will perform poorly on categories with fewer instances. This assumption has led to extensive research on category bias in datasets with imbalanced instance numbers. However, even in datasets where instance numbers are relatively balanced, models still exhibit category bias, indicating that instance count alone cannot explain this phenomenon. In this work, we first introduce the concept and measurement of information density. We then observe a significant negative correlation between a category's information density and its accuracy, and we investigate how the training process impacts this relationship. Empirical studies suggest that information density imbalance may be a potential source of category bias. To preliminarily validate the potential of information density, we made simple improvements to three advanced object detection loss functions using this concept. Experiments on the Pascal VOC, COCO-LT, and LVIS datasets demonstrate that information density can significantly reduce model bias while effectively enhancing the overall performance of existing loss functions. This study provides a new perspective for understanding the generalized bias phenomenon in object detection models and offers new tools for designing fairer loss functions and training strategies.

articles.title_zh: 视觉物体探测中的信息密度不平衡
articles.content_zh: 在对象检测中,通常使用实例数量来确定数据集是否显示长尾分布,含蓄地假设模型在实例较少的类别上表现不佳. 这一假设导致对有不平衡实例数字的数据集中的类别偏差进行了广泛的研究。 然而,即使在实例数字相对平衡的数据集中,模型仍然表现出类别偏差,表明仅凭实例计算无法解释这一现象。 在这项工作中,我们首先提出了信息密度的概念和测量. 然后,我们观察到一个类别的信息密度与其准确性之间的重大负面关联,我们调查培训过程如何影响这种关系。 经验研究表明,信息密度不平衡可能是类别偏差的潜在根源. 为了初步验证信息密度的潜力,我们利用这个概念对三个先进的对象检测丢失功能进行了简单的改进. 对Pascal VOC,COCO-LT,和LVIS数据集的实验表明,信息密度可以显著地降低模型偏差,同时能有效增强现有损失函数的整体性能. 这项研究为了解物体检测模型中的普遍偏差现象提供了新的视角,并为设计更公平的丢失功能和培训策略提供了新的工具.

articles.title: The Missing Temporal Link: Temporal Context Routing for Script-Driven Audio-Video Generation
articles.content: Joint audio-video generation models have made substantial progress in visual quality and audio-visual synchronization. However, they still provide limited control over when shot transitions occur and dialogue is spoken. This limitation constrains their application in script-driven content creation, where timing errors can undermine narrative coherence and the viewing experience. Current joint generators align video and audio representations on a shared temporal axis, yet the precise timing of shots and dialogue specified in a structured prompt is encoded only in the prompt's text representation and remains unaligned with the temporal coordinates of either modality. Consequently, video and audio may remain synchronized with each other while both fail to follow the script timeline. This mismatch motivates us to extend temporal alignment beyond video and audio to include the structured script. We therefore introduce Temporal Context Routing (TCR), which maps the script timing onto the shared temporal axis of video and audio generation and routes each prompt's guidance to the corresponding positions in both modalities. Compared with the baseline on 200 test scripts, TCR reduces Shot Boundary MAE by 96%, from 1.11 s to 0.042 s, and raises Dialogue Acc@0.5 s from 28.3% to 84.1%. TCR achieves these improvements while maintaining visual quality and audio-visual synchronization comparable to those of the baselines. A user study further shows that participants prefer TCR on all five evaluated dimensions.

articles.title_zh: 缺少的时序链接:脚本-驱动音频视频生成的时序运行
articles.content_zh: 联合音频视频生成模式在视觉质量和视听同步方面取得了实质性进展. 然而,它们仍然对何时发生即时过渡和何时开始对话提供有限的控制。 这种限制限制了它们在由脚本驱动的内容创建中的应用,其中计时错误会破坏叙事一致性和取景体验. 目前的联合生成器将视频和音频表达方式统一在一个共同的时间轴上,然而,在结构化的提示中具体规定的拍摄和对话的准确时间只在提示方式的文字表述中编码,并且与两种方式的时间坐标不一致。 因此,视频和音频可能相互保持同步,而两者都未能遵循脚本时间表。 这种不匹配促使我们超越视频和音频,将时间对接扩大到包括结构化脚本. 因此,我们引入了Temperal Control Routing(TCR),将脚本时间映射到视频和音频生成的共享时间轴上,以及路径每个提示对两种模式中相应位置的指导. 与200个测试脚本的基线相比,TCR将Shot Birder MAE减少96%,从1.11 s减少到0.042 s,并将对话框Acc@0.5 s从28.3%提高到84.1%. TCR实现了这些改进,同时保持了可与基线相媲美的视觉质量和视听同步. 一项用户研究进一步表明,参与者在所有五个评价层面都倾向于技术、技术和革新。

articles.title: TempoGround: State-Aware Streaming Visual Grounding with Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Visual grounding maps language referents to spatial targets and is central to open-vocabulary perception with vision-language models. Existing methods have made substantial progress on single-frame and video-based visual grounding, yet under streaming inputs they still suffer from identity drift, cross-frame inconsistency, and fragile localization under partial occlusion. To address these issues, we present TempoGround, a VLM-native framework that detects cross-frame object correspondence and explicitly models object presence states, thereby enabling accurate and consistent visual grounding under streaming inputs. The key is a curriculum prediction mechanism guided by state-aware cross-frame correspondence: TempoGround resolves 2D instance association, predicts whether each object newly enters, continues in, or leaves the view, decodes the 2D box, and then lifts it to a camera-frame 3D box. As token-level supervision alone cannot capture the geometric objectives of streaming grounding, we further introduce Streaming Grounding Reinforcement (SGR), which optimizes TempoGround with verifiable Grounding, Identity, and Consistency rewards, jointly reinforcing persistent localization and temporally consistent predictions. We carefully design a three-stage training strategy and train TempoGround on large-scale data. We evaluate visual grounding under causally streaming inputs on multiple challenging benchmarks: TempoGround improves F1_2D@0.5 and F1_2D@0.95 by 4.4 and 0.5 on average, and F1_3D@0.25 and AP_3D by 6.2 and 7.5, respectively. These results demonstrate that TempoGround provides a practical foundation for visual grounding under streaming inputs.

articles.title_zh: TempoGround: 以视觉语言模型进行国家意识流线视觉定位
articles.content_zh: 视觉地平面地图语言指向空间目标,是具有视觉语言模型的开放式地平面感知的核心. 现有方法在单帧和以视频为基础的可视定位方面已取得重大进展,但是在流入式输入中,它们仍然受到身份漂移、跨帧不一致和局部隔离下脆弱的本地化的影响。 为了解决这些问题,我们提出了TempoGround,这是一个VLM-内在框架,可以探测到跨框架对象的对应关系,并明确模拟对象的存在状态,从而能够在流入输入下进行准确而一致的视觉定位. 关键在于以国家认识的跨框架通信为指导的课程预测机制: TempoGround解决了2D实例关联,预测每个对象是否新进入,继续进入或离开视图,解码了2D盒,再将其提升到相机框3D盒. 光是象征一级的监督无法捕捉到流地平地的几何目标,我们进一步引入了流地平地强化(SGR),通过可核查的地平地、身份和一致性奖励优化了地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平 我们仔细设计了三阶段的训练战略 并用大数据训练TempoGround. 我们评价基于多种挑战性基准的因果源流投入的视觉基础: TempoGround将F1_2D@0.5和F1_2D@0.95平均改进为4.4和0.5;F1_3D@0.25和AP_3D则分别改进为6.2和7.5. 这些结果表明,TempoGround为在流出的投入下进行视觉定位提供了一个实际的基础.

articles.title: LookStep: Efficient Vision-Language Navigation with Linguistic Foresight and Event Driven Memory
articles.content: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to follow natural-language instructions in unseen environments. Recent progress has been largely driven by Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Existing methods follow a next-step action prediction paradigm, supervising only the expert action, which requires a high quantity of data for training. They also rely on cognitive maps, accumulated historical frames, or external 3D tools to maintain states, leading to high computational and memory overhead. To realize resource efficiency VLN, we propose LookStep, a unified end-to-end framework that combines Language Centric Future State Modeling and Event Driven Rolling Memory that uses language labels to generate coarse-grained navigation progress and future states for each candidate action, while autonomously deciding whether to write each observation into a bounded rolling memory with a semantic role. We validate LookStep empirically. On VLN-CE tasks, LookStep outperforms existing methods under the same training settings, achieving a 49.7\% success rate on R2R-CE Val-Unseen with better memory efficiency and less data usage. Code and model is available at https://github.com/kunyang-YU/LookStep.

articles.title_zh: LookStep: 具有语言前瞻和事件驱动记忆的高效视野语言导航
articles.content_zh: Vision-Language Navigation(VLN)要求一个被体现的代理在看不见的环境中遵循自然语言指令. 最近的进展主要是由多式大语文模式所推动的。 现有方法遵循下一步行动预测范式,仅监督专家行动,这需要大量培训数据。 他们还依靠认知地图,累积历史框架,或外部的3D工具来维持状态,导致高计算和内存间接. 为了实现资源效率 VLN,我们提议LookStep,一个统一的端到端框架,将语言百度未来状态建模和事件驱动的滚动记忆结合起来,使用语言标签生成粗糙的导航进度和每个候选动作的未来状态,同时自主决定是否将每个观察写入有语义作用的有界限的滚动内存. 我们以经验验证LookStep 在VLN-CE任务上,LookStep在相同的训练设置下超越了现有方法,以更好的内存效率和更少的数据使用率在R2R-CE Val-Useen上实现了49.7QX的成功率. 代码和模型见https://github.com/kunyang-YU/LookStep.

articles.title: GlyphAnchor: Enhancing Visual Text Rendering via Position-Anchored Glyph Priors
articles.content: Rendering accurate text remains difficult for image generation and editing models, especially when the target contains long, complex, and densely arranged text or rare characters. Existing approaches either improve native text rendering through stronger backbones and data-centric training without explicit glyph priors, or incorporate glyph priors through specialized designs that remain insufficiently accurate and robust under challenging scenarios. We introduce GlyphAnchor, a novel text-rendering enhancement method for both text-to-image and image-editing diffusion transformer models. GlyphAnchor enhances the backbone with lightweight glyph patch conditions whose positions are anchored to the target image through the model's native positional encoding. We train this capability with staged supervised finetuning and further refine it with text-aware post-training to improve robustness. We also introduce InfoTextBench, a benchmark for evaluating text-rich visual text rendering in both generation and editing settings. Experiments across multiple backbones and benchmarks, including long, complex, and densely arranged text and rare character scenarios, show that GlyphAnchor consistently improves text fidelity while preserving overall image quality.

articles.title_zh: GlyphAnchor:通过位置-安乔德Glyph Presidents增强视觉文本渲染
articles.content_zh: 渲染出准确的文字对于图像生成和编辑模型来说仍然很困难,特别是当目标包含长而复杂,且排列稠密的文字或稀有字符时. 现有方法要么通过更强大的主干和以数据为中心的培训改进本地文本的渲染,而没有明确的文字前科,要么通过专业设计纳入文字前科,这些设计在具有挑战性的情况下仍然不够准确和有力。 我们引入了GlyphAnchor,一种新型的文本渲染增强方法,既用于文本到图像,也用于图像编辑的传播变压器模型. GlyphAnchor用轻量级的glyph补丁条件来增强主干,其位置被固定在目标图像上,通过模型的原生位置编码. 我们通过分阶段的有监督的微调来培训这种能力,并通过文字意识的后培训来进一步完善这种能力,以提高稳健性。 我们还引入了InfoText Bench,这是评价在生成和编辑环境中富于文本的视觉文本渲染的基准. 跨越多条骨干和基准的实验,包括长而复杂,排列密集的文字和稀有的字符假想,显示GlyphAnchor在保持整体图像质量的同时,不断提高文字的忠实性.

articles.title: Structured-Prior-Guided Diffusion Inpainting with Physical Consistency for Traffic Sign Augmentation
articles.content: Traffic sign detection faces a long-tailed data distribution. Many rare signs matter as much as common ones from a regulatory standpoint, yet they have very few samples. Generative data augmentation is one way out. General-purpose inpainting models, however, distort digits, deform geometry and perspective, and shift colours when applied directly to sign regions. We trace this to a single gap: the conditioning signal is too abstract for the physical composition of a sign. We propose a structured-prior-guided diffusion inpainting framework with physical consistency. It injects the semantic, appearance and geometric priors of a sign through three orthogonal pathways: a JSON-formatted text prompt, a front-view vector template rendered with measured dominant colours (via IP-Adapter), and an affine-aligned vector template (via ControlNet). Two physical consistency losses constrain colour with a CIELAB chromaticity $L_1$ term and edge structure with a Sobel gradient term. We train by self-supervised reconstruction on a large set of images collected in-house at AMAP, then evaluate zero-shot on the public TT100K-2021 dataset, a different source. Our method uses a Stable Diffusion 1.5 backbone of about 1.4B parameters. It beats seven representative competitors on every metric of reconstruction fidelity, physical consistency and semantic controllability. Its OCR exact-match rate reaches 91.1\%, against 44.2\% for the 12B industrial model FLUX.1 Fill [dev], and it needs only $1/14$ of that model's inference time. Leave-one-out ablations confirm that each of the three prior pathways and both loss terms contribute on their own. In downstream detection, the synthetic data raises the group-pooled AP50 of rare classes by $1.23\times$ to $7.40\times$ over a real-data-only baseline. Code and pre-trained models are available at https://github.com/52hz-whale/TrafficSignInpaint.

articles.title_zh: 结构化-先导-引导分泌 与物理相容相通的交通信号增强
articles.content_zh: 交通标志检测面临长尾数据分布. 从监管角度看,许多罕见的迹象与常见迹象同样重要,但它们的样本很少。 基因数据增强是一条出路。 然而,通用涂装模型扭曲了数字,变形了几何和视角,并在直接应用到签名区域时会转变颜色. 我们追踪到一个空隙: 调节信号对于一个信号的物理组成来说太抽象了. 我们提出了一个结构化的、先行制式的传播涂装框架,以保持物理一致性。 它通过三个正向路径注入了符号的语义,外观和几何前缀:一个由JSON格式化的文本提示,一个前视图矢量模板所渲染出有被测量到的主要颜色(通过IP-Adapter),以及一个同芬相通的矢量模板(通过ControlNet). 两种物理相容性损失限制颜色,一种是CIELAB相色度 $L_1美元,一种是索贝尔梯度名词的边缘结构。 我们通过自我监督的重建,在AMAP内部收集的一大批图像上进行训练,然后在公共的TT100K-2021数据集上评价零镜头,这是一个不同的来源. 我们的方法使用稳定扩散 1.5个主干线 大约1.4B参数。 它在重建忠心、身体一致性和语义可控性的每一度标准上都战胜了7名有代表性的竞争者。 其OCR精确比分率达到91.1\%,而12B型工业型号为44.2\%. FLUX. 填 [dev],它只需要1/14美元 该模型的推断时间。 " 一劳永逸 " 证实,前三条路径和损失条款都各自承担。 在下游检测中,合成数据将组合的AP50稀有类比实取数据基准提高1.23\times$到7.40\tims$. 在https://github.com/52hz-whale/TrafficSignInpaint上可查到代码和预先训练过的模型。

articles.title: Towards Zero-Shot Transfer Across Embodiments For Driving VLAs
articles.content: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) have shown strong potential in autonomous driving by leveraging multimodal pretraining for instruction following, visual reasoning, and scene-level generalization. In robotic manipulation, scaling VLA fine-tuning across multiple robot setups--especially when unifying representations across embodiments--has been shown to improve in-dataset performance and cross-embodiment generalization; in autonomous driving, however, VLAs remain largely trained on individual datasets and are rarely evaluated for zero-shot transfer to unseen datasets and camera rigs; furthermore naively adding more datasets to the training data does not necessarily lead to better performance within seen embodiments. To address these problems, we study multi-dataset training for the driving task and BEV-Forcing, an auxiliary objective that transfers ground-plane object-layout information from a specialized Bird's-Eye-View model into the VLA backbone. By encouraging the model to represent object position through a shared BEV spatial interface, we show that an auxiliary task such as BEV-Forcing can improve both in-distribution and out-of-distribution performance when training on a small number of camera rigs. As the number of training embodiments increases, however, the benefits of the auxiliary task are reduced; we present this as evidence that new techniques in the literature may see their benefits diminish when simply scaling up training diversity, which motivates presenting results taking into account data scaling.

articles.title_zh: 实现无热跨嵌入式转录,用于驾驶紫外线
articles.content_zh: 远景-语言-行动模式(VLAs)通过利用多种模式的预训,进行后续教学、视觉推理和场景层面的概括,在自主驾驶方面显示出了巨大的潜力。 在机器人操纵方面,将VLA在多个机器人设置中进行微调,特别是当将跨浮雕的表示统一起来,以提高数据集的性能和跨浮雕的通用性时;但在自主驾驶方面,VLA仍然主要接受个人数据集的培训,很少被评价为零镜头传输到看不见的数据集和照相机钻机;此外,在培训数据中天真地添加更多数据集并不一定导致在可见浮雕内更好的性能。 为了解决这些问题,我们研究了驾驶任务和BEV-Forcing的多数据集培训,这一辅助目标将专业鸟眼-View模型的地面飞行物体发射信息传输到VLA主干线. 通过鼓励模型通过共享的BEV空间界面来代表对象位置,我们显示,BEV-Forcing等辅助任务在对少量相机钻机进行训练时,既可以提高分配性能,也可以提高分配性能. 然而,随着培训内容的增加,辅助任务的好处也减少了;我们提出这一点作为证据,表明文献中的新技术可能看到,仅仅扩大培训多样性,就可能减少其好处,而这种多样性促使在考虑到数据规模的情况下提出成果。

articles.title: ORB-SVM : An Innovative Hybrid Framework for Efficient Brain Tumor Detection from MRI Scans
articles.content: Brain cancer remains one of the most significant challenges in modern medicine, where the accuracy of early stage diagnosis is a decisive factor in patient survival and treatment efficacy. Although Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is the established gold standard for visualizing neurological structures, the interpretation of these high dimensional scans is often complicated by subjective variability among practitioners and the inherent noise present in complex medical images. While contemporary approaches frequently rely on high parameter deep learning architectures, such models often involve significant computational costs and require extensive data for effective training. This study introduces a hybrid framework that utilizes the Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF (ORB) algorithm for precise feature extraction and a Support Vector Machine (SVM) for classification [1], [2]. The proposed approach achieves a sub- stantial data reduction of approximately 99.5%, which effectively minimizes the influence of non informative background data while preserving critical diagnostic patterns essential for tumor identification. By balancing feature sparsity with a robust kernel based classifier, this methodology addresses the limitations of over parameterized systems while maintaining high diagnostic integrity. Experimental evaluations conducted on the Br35H dataset demonstrate that the framework attains a classification accuracy of 97.5%. The findings suggest that the integration of localized feature representation and optimized classification provides a reliable and resource efficient alternative for medical image analysis, offering a structured solution that maintains per- formance without the need for extensive computational overhead.

articles.title_zh: ORB-SVM:从核磁共振扫描中高效检测脑肿瘤的创新混合框架
articles.content_zh: 脑癌仍然是现代医学中最重要的挑战之一,早期诊断的准确性是患者生存和治疗效果的决定性因素. 虽然磁共振成像(MRI)是可视化神经结构的既定金本位标准,但这些高维扫描的解释往往由于从业者的主观可变性以及复杂医学影像中存在的固有噪音而变得复杂. 虽然现代方法经常依赖高参数的深层学习结构,但这种模型往往涉及大量的计算费用,需要大量数据才能进行有效的培训。 本研究引入了一个混合框架,利用Oriented FAST和旋转BRIEF(ORB)算法进行精确的特征提取,以及一个用于分类的辅助矢量机(SVM)[1],[2]. 拟议的方法实现了大约99.5%的亚结构数据减少,有效地将非信息性背景数据的影响降到最低,同时保留了肿瘤鉴定所必需的关键诊断模式。 这种方法通过平衡特征的sparsity与强内核为基础的分类器,解决了超参数化系统的局限性,同时保持高诊断完整性. 对Br35H数据集进行的实验评价表明,该框架的分类精确度达到97.5%。 调查结果表明,将局部特征表述和优化分类结合起来,为医疗图像分析提供了可靠和资源效率高的替代方法,提供了一个结构化解决方案,可以维持每个形式,而无需大量计算间接费用。

articles.title: YesTrack: Referring Multi-Object Tracking via MLLM-based Yes/No Verification
articles.content: Referring multi-object tracking (RMOT) aims to track every instance in a video that matches a given language expression. Despite the recent integration of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to enhance generalization, existing methods predominantly relegate them to the role of caption generators, necessitating external modules for final decision-making. This paradigm not only introduces extra latency but also severely underutilizes the inherent vision-language alignment capabilities of MLLMs. To address these limitations, we propose YesTrack, a novel two-stage RMOT method that reformulates referring as a discriminative task, directly leveraging MLLMs for Yes/No verification without explicit text generation. To further enhance the reliability and efficiency of this MLLM-based verification, we introduce two lightweight temporal consistency constraints: Temporal Confidence Prior (TCP) and Temporal Reference Propagation (TRP). We further validate the generality of this discriminative paradigm by proposing YesTrack-MOT, a straightforward yet highly effective instantiation for generic multi-object tracking (MOT). Experiments on Refer-KITTI and Refer-KITTI-V2 show that YesTrack significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods while maintaining high efficiency, even when implemented with the smallest variant of Qwen3-VL. Code is released at https://github.com/ggbondrighthere24/YesTrack.

articles.title_zh: 是跟踪:通过基于MLLM的多目标跟踪查询是/否核查
articles.content_zh: 提及多对象跟踪(RMOT)的目的是在匹配特定语言表达的视频中跟踪每个实例. 尽管最近结合了多种大型语言模式,以加强通俗化,但现有方法主要将其置于字幕生成者的角色,需要外部模块来进行最后决策。 这种范式不仅引入了额外的耐久性,而且严重低估了MLLMs固有的视觉语言调和能力. 为了消除这些局限性,我们提议采用YesTrack,这是一种新型的两阶段RMOT方法,它重新提出一项歧视性任务,直接利用MLLMs进行 " 是/否 " 核查,而不需要明确的文本生成。 为了进一步提高这种基于MLLM的核查的可靠性和效率,我们引入了两个轻量级时间一致性限制:Temperal Confession Por(TCP)和Temperal参考传播(TRP)。 我们进一步证实了这种歧视性范式的笼统性,提出YesTrack-MOT,这是通用多对象跟踪(MOT)的直截了当但非常有效的即时性。 关于Reference-KITTI和Reference-KITTI-V2的实验显示,YesTrack在保持高效益的同时,也大大超越了现有的最先进的方法,即使使用Qune3-VL最小的变体执行. 代码发布于https://github.com/ggbondrighthere24/YesTrack.

articles.title: User Feedback Provides a Unique Signal that LLMs Can not Detect
articles.content: Harnessing naturally occurring feedback from user interactions offers a promising learning signal for Large Language Models (LLMs). However, recent studies suggest this feedback is inherently noisy and difficult to leverage effectively. We challenge this conception by demonstrating that user feedback is a highly actionable signal for improvement, and that its perceived ineffectiveness stems from a systematic bias in current evaluation paradigms. To isolate the usefulness of feedback, we construct synthetic data with a definitive ground truth, alongside naturalistic data to validate that our findings hold in real-world scenarios. By comparing model revisions generated with and without access to feedback across both settings, we show that feedback-informed revisions resolve targeted issues at significantly higher rates than baseline revisions. Finally, we expose the root of the evaluation bias: when a model successfully fixes an issue exclusively due to feedback, LLM judges frequently fail to identify the genuinely corrected response, systematically preferring inferior baseline outputs instead.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 用户反馈提供 LLMs 无法检测的独特信号
articles.content_zh: 利用用户互动中自然产生的反馈为大语言模型(LLMs)提供了一个很有希望的学习信号. 然而,最近的研究表明,这种反馈本质上是吵闹的,难以有效利用。 我们质疑这一概念,表明用户的反馈是一个极可操作的改进信号,其认为的无效性源于当前评价范式的系统性偏差。 为了隔离反馈的有用性,我们用明确的地面真相构建合成数据,并配以自然主义数据,以验证我们的调查结果在现实世界中的存在。 通过比较两种情况下产生的和无法获得反馈的模型修订,我们显示,反馈知情的修订以大大高于基线修订的速度解决了有针对性的问题。 最后,我们揭露了评价偏差的根源:当一个模型完全由于反馈而成功地解决了一个问题时, LLM 法官往往不能确定真正得到纠正的反应,而是系统地倾向于低劣的基线产出。

articles.title: Post-Training Language Models for Gold-Medal Performance in Coding Competitions
articles.content: Competitive programming has become a key test of large language model reasoning, with international competitions such as IOI and ICPC representing its most challenging settings. We present an end-to-end specialization pipeline combining large-scale problem curation, synthetic reasoning traces, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL). Using 22,000 curated problems, we train Nemotron-3-Nano-CC (30B-A3B) with SFT and RL and Nemotron-3-Ultra-CC (550B-A55B) with SFT alone. We further introduce GenCorrect, a feedback-driven test-time compute strategy that iteratively generates, evaluates, and refines diverse solutions. On IOI 2025, Nano-CC improves from 130 points to 291 after post-training and to 468 with GenCorrect, exceeding the gold threshold of 438.3 while Ultra-CC reaches 502. Guided by these results, we develop a competition-specific Ultra-CC system and evaluate it prospectively during IOI 2026. Under the same time, internet-access, and submission constraints as human contestants, it scores 535.4 out of 600, exceeding both the gold threshold of 361.12 and the top human score of 498.27. To our knowledge, this is the first AI system to outscore the highest-scoring human contestant on an IOI problem set.

articles.title_zh: Gold-Medal在编码比赛中的表现培训后语言模型
articles.content_zh: 竞争性编程已成为大型语言模型推理的关键测试,IOI和ICPC等国际竞赛代表其最具挑战性的设置. 我们提出一个端到端专业化管道,将大规模问题解析、合成推理痕迹、监督微调和强化学习结合起来。 利用22,000个解剖问题,我们用SFT和RL和Nemotron-3-Ultra-CC(550B-A55B)单独训练Nemotron-3-Nano-CC(30B-A3B). 我们进一步引入了GenCorrect,这是一种由反馈驱动的测试时间计算策略,迭代生成,评价和完善多种解决方案. 在IOI 2025上,纳诺-CC在训练后从130分提升到291分,并在GenCorrect上提升到468分,超过了438.3的黄金门槛,而Ultra-CC则达到502. 在这些结果的指导下,我们开发了一种针对竞争的超CC系统,并在2026年国际竞争倡议期间对该系统进行预期评估。 同时,作为人类参赛者,互联网接入和提交限制,在600分中得分535.4,超过了361.12的黄金门槛和498.27的人类最高分。 据我们所知,这是第一个AI系统 在IOI问题集上 超越得分最高的人类选手

articles.title: Dutch Books for Language Models
articles.content: People increasingly use language models to support life decisions. Many such decisions involve a probabilistic forecast: How likely is a major life event, a natural disaster, or an economic outcome? Users of language models may implicitly trust that these forecasts fall out of a coherent world model. In this paper, we evaluate the coherence of language model probabilistic forecasts through a procedure that builds on a theorem due to de Finetti. We elicit forecasts from language models across events generated from stock returns data. We then use linear programs to compute the largest Dutch-book profit - the profit an arbitrageur could guarantee by betting against model-generated probabilities - which we use as a measure of incoherence. Our procedure does not require outcome labels, so we can evaluate coherence even in settings where outcomes are not observed or have not yet resolved. We find substantial evidence of incoherence in language model forecasts. Such incoherence increases when there are richer logical relationships between events, and irrelevant contextual details can increase incoherence by an order of magnitude. We conclude by discussing how alternative training strategies may improve probabilistic coherence.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 荷兰语言模型图书
articles.content_zh: 人们越来越多地使用语言模型来支持生命决策. 许多此类决定都涉及概率预测: 重大生命事件、自然灾害或经济后果的可能性有多大? 语言模型的使用者可能暗中相信这些预测出自一个连贯的世界模型. 在本文中,我们通过一个基于de Finetti定理的程序来评价语言模型概率预测的一致性. 我们从各种语言模型中获取从库存回报数据生成的各种事件的预测。 然后我们用线性程序来计算最大的荷兰图书利润——一个套利者可以通过对模型产生的概率进行赌注来保证利润——我们以此来衡量不一致。 我们的程序不需要成果标签,因此,即使在成果没有得到遵守或尚未解决的情况下,我们也能评价一致性。 我们发现大量证据表明语言模型预测不一致。 当事件之间的逻辑关系更加丰富时,这种不一致性就会增加,不相关的背景细节会以数量级的顺序增加不一致性. 最后,我们讨论了替代培训战略如何提高概率一致性。

articles.title: DiscoSign: Discourse-Aware Text to Sign Language Gloss Translation
articles.content: Sign language processing systems have traditionally operated at the sentence level, ignoring critical discourse phenomena fundamental to sign language comprehension. We introduce DiscoSign, a computational approach for discourse-aware text to sign language gloss translation grounded in linguistic research. We address three key phenomena within our modular Large Language Model (LLM)-based translation framework: (i) spatial coreference resolution, where entities maintain consistent spatial locations throughout discourse; (ii) Question-Answer Clauses (QACs), pseudocleft structures serving specific discourse functions; and (iii) concept-gloss consistency, ensuring stable mappings between English concepts and American Sign Language (ASL) signs. Traditional translation metrics fail to capture discourse-level quality, so we introduce a suite of novel evaluation metrics designed to assess each dimension of discourse coherence addressed by our framework. Experiments on sentence-level and discourse-level datasets show that our approach for discourse-aware processing significantly improves spatial consistency and entity tracking relative to sentence-only translation, while maintaining competitive single-sentence gloss translation quality. Our work establishes the first systematic framework for discourse-level text to sign language gloss translation with corresponding evaluation methodology.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DiscoSign: 向手语 Gloss 翻译的 discour- Aware 文本
articles.content_zh: 手语处理系统传统上在句子层面运作,忽略了对手语理解至关重要的批判性话语现象. 我们介绍DiscoSign,一种计算方法,用于语言研究基础上的手语拼音翻译。 我们在基于模块的大语言模型(LLM)的翻译框架内处理三个关键现象:(一) 空间共参照分辨率,实体在整个讨论中保持一致的空间位置;(二) 问题-答复条款(QAC),为特定讨论功能服务的伪左侧结构;(三) 概念-损失一致性,确保英文概念与美国手语符号之间的稳定映射。 传统的翻译衡量标准未能反映讨论的质量,因此,我们采用了一套新的评价衡量标准,旨在评估我们框架所处理的讨论一致性的每个方面。 关于句子层次和语句层次数据集的实验表明,我们关于语句意识处理的方法大大改进了空间一致性和实体跟踪相对于句子唯一翻译,同时保持竞争性的单句光泽翻译质量. 我们的工作建立了第一个系统框架,以便用语言进行翻译,并采用相应的评价方法。

articles.title: EarlyEval: Cheaper Agent Evaluation via Early Outcome Prediction
articles.content: Evaluating LLM agents is essential for guiding their development, yet it has grown prohibitively expensive: a single pass of a frontier model over an agentic benchmark can cost hundreds to thousands of dollars, a price paid repeatedly across iterative development cycles. Prior efforts, centered on benchmark distillation, reduce the number of evaluation tasks but leave the cost of executing each retained task untouched. In this work, we introduce early outcome prediction, a complementary axis of efficiency that instead cuts cost within each task. Our key insight is that an agent's final outcome is often evident from its intermediate behavior well before execution completes. We instantiate this idea in EarlyEval, a lightweight framework that trains a pair of LightGBM success and failure classifiers over behavioral, textual, and reference-solution features, and halts an agent run the moment either classifier crosses a calibrated confidence threshold, adding negligible per-step overhead. Across three benchmarks, SWE-bench Verified, TerminalBench, and Toolathlon, EarlyEval can eliminate 13%-26% of agent steps and up to 44.1% input tokens and 29.4% output tokens at 89%-97% prediction accuracy, while perturbing per-agent resolve rates by only one to two percentage points on average.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 早期评价:通过早期结果预测进行便宜剂评价
articles.content_zh: 评估LLM代理人对于指导其发展至关重要,然而,它已经变得昂贵得令人望而却步:一个前沿模型单次超越代理基准就可能花费数百至数千美元,而这一价格在迭代发展周期中反复支付。 以基准提炼为核心的先前努力减少了评价任务的数量,但使执行每项保留任务的费用保持不变。 在这项工作中,我们引入了早期结果预测,这是效率的一个互补轴心,可以减少每项任务的成本。 我们的关键洞察力是,一个特工的最终结果往往从它的中间行为中可以明显看出,早在执行完成之前. 我们在EarlyEval中即刻提出这个想法,这是一个轻量级框架,它训练一对LightGBM成功和失败分类者,而不是行为、文字和参考解析特性,并停止一个代理运行,即任一分类者越过一个校准的置信阈值,增加可忽略不计的每步管理费用。 跨越三个基准:SWE-bench 验证、终端奔驰和Tolathlon,Early Eval可以消除13%-26%的代理阶梯以及高达44.1%的输入令牌和29.4%的输出令牌,以89%-97%的预测精度计算,同时使每个代理解决率平均只有一到两个百分点的扰动.

articles.title: ShallowStream: Index Shallow then Answer Deep for Streaming Video Understanding
articles.content: Streaming video understanding is a critical capability for real-world applications, including embodied intelligence, autonomous driving, industrial monitoring, surveillance and early warning, and wearable assistants. However, processing continuous video streams with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is computationally expensive. Existing efforts have explored reducing streaming overhead through visual token pruning, token merging, quantization, on-demand frame retrieval, and context offloading. However, most existing methods overlook the dimension of model depth. Repeatedly executing full-depth MLLM prefill over incoming frames is prohibitively expensive, incurring substantial computational overhead and causing the KV cache to grow at a rate directly proportional to the prefill depth. To address these challenges, we propose ShallowStream, a novel framework that leverages the shallow layers of an MLLM to simultaneously perform frame encoding and retrieval index building. During stream processing, ShallowStream maintains an always-on lightweight index using the KV cache of shallow layers. During query-time answering, we leverage the attention scores generated by the shallow layers to score context frames and employ a diversity-aware selection strategy to retrieve precise and comprehensive evidence. ShallowStream achieves performance on par with the strongest existing streaming methods, while reducing per-frame prefill latency and 10-second end-to-end latency by up to 52.1x and 11.9x, respectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/CURRENTF/ShallowStream.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 浅色结构:索引浅色,然后回答深色的流媒体理解
articles.content_zh: 流畅的视频理解是现实世界应用的关键能力,包括体现的智能、自主驾驶、工业监测、监测和预警以及可穿戴的助手。 然而,使用多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)处理连续视频流在计算上是昂贵的. 现有努力探索通过目视信物查抄、信物合并、量化、点播框检索和上下文卸载等方式减少流线性间接费用。 然而,大多数现有方法忽略了模型深度的层面。 反复在进入的框架上执行完全深入的MLLM预填,费用高昂,造成大量的计算间接费用,导致KV缓存以与预填深度直接成比例的速度增长. 为了应付这些挑战,我们提议采用ShallowStream这个新颖的框架,利用MLLM的浅层同时进行帧编码和检索索引建设。 在溪流处理过程中,ShallowStream使用浅层的KV缓存来维持一个恒定的轻量级指数. 在回答询问时,我们利用浅层产生的关注分数来评分上下文框架,并采用了解多样性的选择策略来检索准确和全面的证据。 ShallowStream与现有最强的流线法一样实现性能,同时将每帧的预填空闲和10秒的端对空闲分别减少至52.1x和11.9x. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/CURRENTF/ShallowStream上查阅。

articles.title: HyperStyler: Low-resource Authorship Style Transfer via Context-aware Style Navigation and Hypernetworks
articles.content: Low-resource authorship style transfer (LAST) aims to rewrite text into the style of an arbitrary target author using only a few reference examples while preserving the original meaning. Existing methods often struggle to achieve both high style fidelity and semantic preservation because they compress diverse references into a single static author embedding, which averages out context-dependent stylistic variation, and rely on hidden representations for style control, which entangle style with content. We propose HyperStyler, a novel architecture that decouples LAST into style selection and style realization. Stylo-navigator predicts style coordinates by jointly modeling the source context and target-author references, and Stylo-hypernet realizes them via dynamic parameter modulation instead of hidden-state injection. Our experiments on Reddit, Blog, and News datasets demonstrate that HyperStyler consistently outperforms prior methods including LLM-based approaches and generalizes robustly across domains. Notably, HyperStyler achieves superior performance with as few as 2.4% additional parameters over T5-large, while being over 1.8x faster than LLMs at inference.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 超时速计 : 通过上下文认知到的样式导航和超网络进行低资源授权样式传输
articles.content_zh: 低资源作者风格传输(LAST)旨在将文本重写成任意目标作者的风格,只使用几个参考实例,同时保留原意. 现有方法往往要同时实现高风格忠实和语义保存,因为它们将不同的引用压缩成一个单一的静态作者嵌入,这平均得出了上下文依赖的风格变异,依赖隐藏的表示来进行风格控制,其风格与内容纠缠在一起. 我们提出HyperStyler, 一个新颖的建筑 脱钩LAST的风格选择和风格实现。 Stylo-navigator通过联合建模源上下文和目标作者引用来预测样式坐标,Stylo-hypernet通过动态参数调制而不是隐藏状态注入来实现它们. 我们的Reddit、Blog和News数据集实验显示, HyperStyler 一贯优于先前的方法, 值得注意的是,HyperStyler的性能优异,比T5型大号多2.4%的参数,而推论比LLMS快1.8x以上.

articles.title: From Reweighting to Rewriting: Unlocking the Intervention Effects of Influential Samples in Training Data Attribution
articles.content: Training data attribution (TDA) aims to identify training examples that shape model behavior, but its intervention value depends on both which examples are selected and how they are modified. Influence functions (IF) estimate behavioral changes under infinitesimal reweighting, yet IF-selected examples often show limited advantages over random selection under conventional weight-based interventions. This raises the question of whether influential examples lack intervention value or whether reweighting fails to realize their behavioral leverage.We introduce influence-guided response rewriting, which uses IF to identify intervention targets and replaces their responses with behavior-aligned or behavior-opposed supervision while keeping instructions fixed. Across four open-weight LLMs, we compare rewriting and reweighting on the same influence-selected examples using epistemic abstention as our primary testbed. Response rewriting produces stronger, more persistent, and bidirectional behavioral shifts, while reweighting the same examples yields weak and inconsistent effects. Further analyses show that influence-selected examples provide greater rewriting leverage than alternative selectors, with changes remaining concentrated on target-relevant behaviors. The same qualitative contrast extends to safety refusal. These results distinguish the local reweighting effects captured by influence estimates from the broader intervention leverage of the examples they identify, motivating intervention-aware evaluation of TDA methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从重新加权到重写:解锁培训数据分配中存在影响力的样本的干预效果
articles.content_zh: 培训数据归属(TDA)旨在识别塑造模型行为的培训实例,但其干预价值取决于选择哪些实例以及如何修改。 影响函数(IF)在无限重量下估计行为变化,然而IF选取的例子往往显示在常规重力干预下相对于随机选择的优势有限. 这提出了一个问题,即有影响力的例子是否缺乏干预价值,或者重新加权是否未能实现其行为杠杆. 我们引入了影响引导反应重写,它使用IF来识别干预目标,并以行为对称或行为对峙的监督来取代其反应,同时固定指令. 在四个开放量级的有限责任公司中, 我们比较了重写和重评 相同的影响力选择的例子, 使用感官弃权作为我们的主要试验床。 反应重写产生更强,更持久和双向的行为转变,同时重估相同的例子会产生弱和不一致的效果. 进一步的分析显示,所选择的影响实例比替代选择器提供了更大的重写杠杆,变化仍然集中在目标相关行为上. 同样的质量对比也延伸到拒绝安全。 这些结果将影响估计所捕捉的当地再加权效应与它们所查明的例子的广泛干预杠杆区分开来,促使对TDA方法进行具有干预意识的评价。

articles.title: Untangling the Mechanisms of Misleading Context in Medical Question Answering
articles.content: Large language models now answer medical questions with expert-level performance. However, the context these systems act on can be misleading, and misleading context can corrupt a model's medical judgment. To understand how misleading context corrupts this judgment, we examine the model's susceptibility to the context, disclosure of it, mechanism of corrupted reasoning, and monitorability of the decision. On the medical reasoning subset of MedMisBench, a clinician-reviewed question-answering benchmark of 8,627 questions, we inject two types of misleading context cues, fabricated evidence and a bare assertion. We test three reasoning models, two that expose their full reasoning trace and one frontier model that exposes only its response. All three are more susceptible to the assertion than to the fabricated evidence, adopting the asserted answer 10 to 27 points more often. The misleading cues are disclosed in 81 to 98% of traces but only 7 to 90% of responses, and the assertion is disclosed less often than evidence based cues. Resampling from reasoning traces without disclosure shows the two cues corrupt reasoning differently, evidence entering early and accumulating while the assertion redirects the conclusion near its end. An LLM monitor catches 78% of corrupted decisions at 5% false positives when reading an open model's trace with guidance, against at most 32% from any response. The misleading context that models are most susceptible to is disclosed least, and was caught reliably only from an open reasoning trace, which frontier providers withhold.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 解除医疗问题回答中错误背景的机制
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型现在以专家级的性能回答医学问题. 然而,这些制度所根据的背景可能具有误导性,而误导背景可能破坏模型的医疗判断。 为了了解误导背景是如何腐蚀这个判断的,我们考察了模型对上下文的易感性,披露它,腐败推理机制,以及决定的可监控性. 在MedMis Bench的医学推理子集上, 一个由临床医生审查的8,627个问题的问答基准, 我们注入了两种误导性的语境提示, 捏造的证据和一个赤裸裸的断言。 我们测试了三个推理模型,两个揭示了它们完全推理的踪迹,一个前沿模型只揭示了其反应. 所有这三种情况都比捏造的证据更容易受到这种断言的影响,而是更经常地采用所声称的答复10至27点。 在81%至98%的痕迹中披露误导提示,但只有7%至90%的答复,而且披露这一说法的次数少于证据提示。 从没有披露的推理痕迹中复制出来,显示了两个提示不同地腐败推理,证据提早进入并积累,而断言则将结论的方向转移到接近尾声的地方。 一个LLM监视器在读取一个开放模型的线索时,以5%的虚假阳性值捕获了78%的腐败决定,而从任何答复中最多只能得到32%。 模型最容易被披露的误导性背景最少,而且只是从公开的推理追踪中可靠地发现的,而前沿提供商对此加以隐瞒。

articles.title: Repo-To-Skill: Distilling GitHub Repositories Into AI4AI Skills
articles.content:
Autonomous agents are beginning to carry out machine-learning (ML) research end to end. These agents combine a model backbone with a harness for planning, execution, memory, and verification, but this architecture still leaves domain-specific know-how outside the agent. We call this missing layer operational knowledge, the know-how that separates knowing a method from making it work. That knowledge is not absent from the field. It appears in repositories and papers, but in forms written for human readers and too large to load during a task. Once distilled into compact, verified skills, this knowledge can be reused across tasks rather than rediscovered during each run.
  We present DisCo, a skill-powered research agent that creates skills and uses them during research. Its distillation runs in two complementary forms: task-agnostic, condensing the field's widely used repositories into reusable skills, and task-oriented, producing the skills a concrete task calls for. The former, applied across the open ecosystem, yields the AREX-Skill Library, with 5,000+ verified skills distilled from 1,000 widely used ML repositories and organized into 20 areas and 178 capability families. With the GPT-5.5 backbone, research harness, and downstream execution budget held fixed, the skill-equipped research agent scores 134.3% higher on MLE-bench, 34.4% higher on PaperBench, 9.2% higher on FrontierCS, and 14.0% higher on PassNet than the same agent without skills. These gains come from adding distilled operating context under that fixed setup.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Repo-to-Skill:将 GitHub 存储器分解为 AI4AI 技能
articles.content_zh:
自主代理开始进行机器学习(ML)研究,最终结束. 这些代理商将模型骨干与用于规划,执行,内存和验证的牵引力结合在一起,但这种架构仍然将特定域的专门技能留在代理商之外. 我们称之为缺少的层层操作知识,也就是把了解一种方法与使它发挥作用区分开来的知识。 这一知识并非没有在野外。 它出现在寄存器和论文中,但写成的形式是供人类读者阅读,在任务进行时太大,无法加载. 一旦被提炼成精密的,经过验证的技能,这种知识可以跨任务重复使用,而不是在每次运行中重新发现.
我们介绍DisCo, 一个技能强的研究代理, 创造技能并在研究期间使用这些技能。 它的蒸馏有两种互补的形式:任务不可知性,将广泛使用的外地寄存器凝聚为可重复使用的技能,以及面向任务,产生需要的具体任务的技能. 前者适用于开放的生态系统,生成AREX-技能图书馆,从1 000个广泛使用的ML储存库中提取出5 000+经核实的技能,并组织成20个地区和178个能力家庭。 随着GPT-5.5主干、研究手段和下游执行预算的固定,技术装备的研究代理人在MLE-bench的得分比134.3%,在Paper Bench的得分比34.4%,在FrontierCS的得分比9.2%,在PassNet的得分比没有技能的同一代理人高14.0%。 这些收益来自在固定设置下增加蒸馏操作环境。

articles.title: Incremental Pooled LLM Evaluation for Cost-Effective Retrieval Model Selection
articles.content: Selecting a retrieval model for a production RAG system requires reliable comparative evaluation, but obtaining relevance judgments at scale is expensive and difficult to repeat as new candidate systems arrive. We study pooled LLM evaluation, in which an LLM judges the union of documents retrieved by the current set of candidate systems, and the pool is then expanded incrementally as new systems are introduced by judging only the new documents they contribute. These judgments are reused to evaluate all systems on a common basis. We validate this approach on four retrieval benchmarks with 11 systems spanning dense, sparse, and hybrid configurations, and deploy it to compare 62 retrieval configurations for a financial news QA system. Pooled LLM rankings correlate strongly with gold-standard evaluation across datasets, and 97% of pairwise system orderings are preserved once bootstrap uncertainty in the qrels is taken into account. In production, document overlap yields 65-80% judgment reuse and up to 4.9x lower evaluation cost, allowing teams to benchmark new retrieval candidates without re-judging previously assessed documents. These results suggest pooled LLM evaluation is a practical and cost-effective workflow for incremental retrieval model selection in deployed systems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 为成本效益高的检索模式选择而逐步集合LLM评价
articles.content_zh: 为生产RAG系统选择一个检索模型需要可靠的比较评价,但随着新的候选系统到来,获得规模的相关判断费用高昂,难以重复。 我们研究集合的LLM评价,其中LLM判断的是现有一套候选系统检索到的文件的联盟,然后随着新系统的引入,仅仅通过判断它们所贡献的新文件而逐步扩大集合. 这些判决被重新用于共同评价所有系统。 我们以四个检索基准验证这种方法,其中11个系统跨越密集、稀少和混合的配置,并将其用于比较62个财务新闻质量保证系统的检索配置。 组合式LLM排名与不同数据集的黄金标准评价密切相关,一旦考虑到qrels的靴子陷阱不确定性,97%的双向系统订单得到保留。 在制作方面,文件重叠产生65-80%的判断重复使用率,最高可降低4.9x评价费用,使各小组能够在不重新判断先前评估的文件的情况下,为新的检索候选人确定基准。 这些结果表明,集合LLM评价是在部署的系统中选择增量检索模型的实用和成本效益高的工作流程。

articles.title: Language Models Can Control Their Own Attention
articles.content: Language models spend most of their attention on a small fraction of context, yet they read the entire KV cache to find the few tokens that matter. If the user asks about a previous detail in a 1M-token conversation, global attention layers must scan the full context to generate each token of the reply. A prominent approach mitigates this cost by pre-selecting relevant tokens via lightweight proxy scores, but this extrinsic scoring still incurs O(N) per step. We take an intrinsic approach motivated by the simple question: wouldn't the model already know which parts of the context are relevant? To this end, we introduce Declarative Attention (DA), a protocol that elicits the model to declare where it needs to attend within its chain-of-thought, partitioning generation into three modes: <global> (full context), <focus> (a specific region), and <local> (recent output only). The inference engine parses these declarations like tool calls and skips most of the KV cache read. Under zero-shot evaluation across 15 long-context tasks, DA on off-the-shelf models (Gemma-4-31B, Qwen-3.6-27B) significantly reduces total attended tokens during decoding (52.0%, 31.1%) with modest accuracy drops (1.27pp, 2.75pp) that shrink with model scale. DA unlocks a new axis of sparse attention, with further potential under training-based methods that future work can explore.

articles.title_zh: 语言模型可以控制自己的注意力
articles.content_zh: 语言模型将大部分注意力花在一小部分的上下文上,然而他们读取了整个KV缓存,以找到少数重要符号. 如果用户在1M-token对话中询问之前的细节,全局关注层必须扫描整个上下文,以生成回复的每个符号. 一种突出的方法通过轻量级代用分数预先选择相关符号来减轻这一成本,但这种外在分数仍然每步需要O(N). 我们从一个简单的问题出发,采取了一种内在的方法:模型是否已经知道上下文的哪些部分是相关的? 为此,我们引入了声明性注意(DA),这是一份协议,该协议可以引申出一个模式,宣布它需要在其思维链内进行哪些活动,将生成物分为三种模式: " 全球 " (完整背景)、 " 焦点 " (特定区域)和 " 局部 " (仅最近产出)。 推论引擎将这些声明描述为工具调用,并跳过大多数读取的KV缓存. 在对15个长文本任务的零镜头评价下,现成模型上的DA(Gemma-4-31B,Quen-3.6-27B)在解码(52.0%,31.1%)时会大幅降低总的被送信符,其精度略微下降(1.27pp,2.75pp)随着模型尺度缩小. DA打开了新轴心,很少注意,在基于培训的方法下还有进一步的潜力,未来的工作可以探索.

articles.title: Choosing a PEFT Variant for Per-Patient Dysarthric ASR: A Single-Speaker Case Study on Two ASR Bases
articles.content: Per-patient adapters are the preferred production architecture for dysarthric automatic speech recognition (ASR), yet parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) variants have not been compared in the speaker-dependent, per-patient regime. We present a single-speaker case study comparing seven LoRA-family methods (LoRA, QLoRA, AdaLoRA, DoRA, LoHA, VeRA, VB-LoRA) on two production bases (Whisper-large-v3 with Hungarian fine-tuning, and a multilingual Qwen3-ASR-1.7B checkpoint) for one post-stroke Hungarian male speaker (S1, 409 utterances; severe dysarthria on auditory-perceptual clinical assessment). Attention-projection adapters substantially improve CER on both bases. Across three seeds, a paired bootstrap detects no significant LoRA-DoRA difference (p>0.5; 13.86/13.90 % CER on Whisper, 28.10/28.33 % on Qwen3-ASR), so we adopt the simpler, cheaper LoRA. Real 4-bit (NF4) QLoRA is worse on every seed and both bases (14.56/30.09 % CER) with no memory saving at this scale, and LoHA, VeRA, VB-LoRA and AdaLoRA do not reach the LoRA family, though LoHA still gives an 18.6 % relative CER reduction on Whisper. On the same base, full fine-tuning is more accurate (11.43 % CER), but a 115 MB LoRA that also adapts the feed-forward blocks reaches within 0.66 pp of it at approximately 3.7 % of the per-patient storage. A 6-point enrollment grid shows about 5 min of patient audio captures 45.6 % of the zero-shot-to-30-min CER reduction, with further gains at 10 and 30 min (caveat: one speaker, one language, severe post-stroke dysarthria). Training scripts and recipes will be released, source-available under a research-use licence, on publication.

articles.title_zh: 选择一个PEFT方案,用于 " 辅助性 " ASR:关于两个ASR基础的单一发言人案例研究
articles.content_zh: 患者人均适配器是Dysarthric自动语音识别(ASR)的首选生产架构,然而参数高效的微调(PEFT)变体在依赖演讲器的患者人均系统中还没有被比较. 我们提出一个单一语言的案例研究,比较七个匈牙利语家庭方法(LORA、QLORA、AdaLORA、DORA、LOHA、VERA、VB-LORA)在两个生产基地(Whisper-great-v3与匈牙利语微调,以及一个讲多种语言的Qune3-ASR-1.7B检查站),一个讲匈牙利语后男语者(S1, 409话;关于听觉-听觉临床评估的严重病症)。 注意-预测适配器在两个基础上大大改进了核证的排减量。 在三种种子中,一对靴子检测到没有明显的洛拉-多拉差异(p>0.5;13.86/13.90%的Whisper的CER,28.10/28.33%的Quen3-ASR),所以我们采用更简单,更便宜的洛拉. 真实的4位(NF4)QLORA在每一个种子和两个碱基上都更糟糕(14.56/30.09%CER),没有这个尺度的内存保存,LoHA,VERA,VB-LORA和AdaLORA都没有到达LORA家族,尽管LOHA仍然在Whisper上给予18.6%的相对CER减量. 在同一基础上,完全微调更准确(11.43 % CER),但同样调整饲料前进区块的115 MB LORA在0.66 pp以大约3.7%的人均贮存量达到其中. 一个6分的入学网格显示大约5分钟的患者音频捕捉到45.6%的零射至30分钟的CER减量,在10分钟和30分钟的增量(caveat:一个演讲者,一种语言,严重的中风后沙皇). 在出版时,将根据研究使用许可证公布培训脚本和食谱。

articles.title: CORAL: An LLM-Native Harness for Production Recommender Systems
articles.content: Production recommender systems shape what billions of people see, and sustaining their performance requires continual optimization: as content, user behavior, and upstream models shift, the choices governing retrieval, ranking, and serving must be revisited. Traditionally, human engineers test such changes through online experiments--a slow, reactive process limited by engineering effort, leaving parts of the system unrevised as conditions change. Although large language models have been applied to ranking, user modeling, and offline model development, few systems place an agent in a continual closed loop that acts on a live recommender and learns from the measured effects of its decisions. We present CORAL (Constraint-Optimized Recommender via an Agentic Loop), an LLM-native harness that closes this loop: each cycle, the agent observes operating signals, reasons over a memory of past decisions and outcomes, and invokes tools--including a numerical optimizer that keeps changes within a fixed operating budget--to reconfigure the recommender, with measured outcomes informing the next cycle. We formulate this as a partially observed, non-stationary, constrained optimization problem in which the policy improves in context, without parameter updates, from its prior actions. Across two large-scale social platforms, evaluated with A/B experiments, the same harness improves engagement at no additional serving cost on one and reduces serving cost without degrading engagement on the other, spanning the engagement-efficiency frontier. Performance improves as the loop iterates, suggesting that a single agentic loop can automate continual optimization work traditionally performed by human algorithm engineers under explicit guardrails.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CORAL:生产推荐系统 LLM-Native Harness
articles.content_zh: 生产推荐者系统塑造了数十亿人所看到的东西,维持其业绩需要不断优化:随着内容、用户行为和上游模式的转变,必须重新审视关于检索、排名和服务的选择。 传统上,人类工程师通过在线实验测试这种变化——一个缓慢的,被动的过程,受到工程努力的限制,随着条件的变化,系统的一些部分没有修改. 虽然大型语言模型已应用于排名、用户模型制作和离线模型开发,但很少有系统将一个代理人置于一个连续的闭合循环中,该循环对现场推荐者起作用,并学习其决定的衡量效果。 我们提出CORAL(通过Agentic Loop进行约束-优化的推荐人),这是一种LLM-内在的利用,它关闭了这个循环:每个循环,代理人观察操作信号,观察过去决定和结果的记忆中的原因,并援引各种工具——包括将变化保持在固定业务预算范围内的数字优化器——来重新配置推荐人,并将衡量的结果告知下一个循环。 我们把它说成是部分观察到的、非固定的、受制约的优化问题,在这个问题上,政策从以往的行动出发,在没有参数更新的情况下,在上下文中得到了改进。 在通过A/B实验评估的两个大型社会平台上,同样的工具可以改善一个平台的参与,不增加服务费用,并降低服务费用,而不会降低另一个平台的参与程度,跨越参与效率领域。 性能随着环绕周期的提高而提高,表明单一的代理环可以使传统上由人类算法工程师在明显的护栏下完成的持续优化工作自动化.

articles.title: Door-in-the-Face Requests and Refusal Behaviour in Large Language Models
articles.content: Does the door-in-the-face technique work on language models? In humans, a large request that is refused makes a smaller follow-up request more likely to be granted. We test this on nine production models from three providers: each model refuses a large request, then receives a smaller version of the same request, and we compare its compliance with asking directly. The answer depends on the model. On Anthropic's frontier models the technique works: Opus 5 answers the smaller request 65.8% of the time after refusing the larger one, against 29.3% when asked directly. On the frontier models of OpenAI and Google, and on Haiku 4.5, it backfires, lowering compliance by 15.5 to 23.0 points. A control locates the effect: a refused large request on an unrelated topic does less than the related one on all nine models, so the concession itself matters everywhere, while the reaction to having just refused something differs by model family. The technique does not transfer to refusals drawn from public benchmarks. What decides whether a retreat can work is what the request asks for: rewriting 265 refused requests for usable instructions into requests for explanations of the same topic removed the refusal in 263 cases. Human influence techniques port to language models one model family at a time.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 大语言模型中的门内请求和拒绝行为
articles.content_zh: 门面技术对语言模型有用吗? 在人类中,一个被拒绝的大请求使得一个较小的后续请求更有可能获得批准. 我们从三个供应商的9个生产模型中测试这个:每个模型拒绝一个大请求,然后收到一个较小版本的同一个请求,我们把它的遵守与直接询问进行比较. 答案取决于模型。 在Anthropic的前沿模型上,技术的作用是: Opus 5在拒绝较大请求后答复了65.8%的较小请求,而当直接被问及时答复率为29.3%. 在OpenAI和Google的前沿模型上,在Haiku 4.5上,它反射,将合规率降低15.5到23.0点. 控制定位效应:对一个无关话题的拒绝大请求比所有9种模型的相关请求要小,因此特许权本身随处可见,而刚刚拒绝某事的反应则因模型家族而异. 这种方法不会转移到从公共基准中得出的拒绝。 决定务虚会能否奏效的是请求所要求的:将265项被拒绝的关于可用指示的请求改为关于同一专题的解释请求,从而消除了263个案件中的拒绝。 人类影响技术移植语言模型 一次一个模范家庭。

articles.title: Trace as State: Reasoning Traces as Conditional States for Long-Context Transformers
articles.content:
Transformers process information causally, but long-context reasoning may depend on task state discovered only later. We formalize this mismatch through conditional state update tasks. For causal state update processors, providing the condition first can require exponentially less memory in the worst case than providing it last.
  Motivated by this principle, we introduce Trace as State. We use collected reasoning traces as a textual proxy for task state and place it before the long-context block on a fresh pass, allowing information derived previously to guide rereading.
  We conduct extensive experiments on Trace as State and Trace Append, a matched control that uses the same task state proxy but put it after the context. Across three models and three long-context datasets, Trace as State outperforms Trace Append in 26 of 27 reported combinations of model, task, and metric. On GraphWalks Parents, exact match lifts DeepSeek V4 Pro Preview from 29.2% on the initial pass and 43.0% with Trace Appendto 81.8% with Trace as State, and from 66.4% and 83.2% to 100.0% for GLM-5.2. These results show that placing traces before the context can improve long-context reasoning while retaining the causal transformer structure.

articles.title_zh: 追踪作为国家:长文本变换器的有条件国家
articles.content_zh:
变形器会因果地处理信息,但长的文本推理可能依赖于仅仅在后来发现的任务状态. 我们通过有条件的状态更新任务将这种不匹配正式化. 对于因果状态更新处理器来说,提供条件第一可以在最坏的情况下要求的内存比提供最后的要少指数.
基于这一原则,我们引入了 Trace作为国家。 我们使用收集的推理痕迹作为任务状态的文字代名词,并将它放在长文本块之前,放在新的通行证上,让以前获得的信息指导重读.
我们进行了广泛的实验 追踪作为状态和追踪附录, 一个匹配的控制 使用相同的任务状态代理 但放在上下文之后。 3个模型和3个长文本数据集,在所报告的27个模型、任务和计量组合中的26个中,跟踪作为国家业绩超过跟踪附加。 在GraphWalks Parents上,将DeepSeek V4 Pro预览从初始通行证的29.2%和追踪附录的81.8 %精确匹配,GLM-5.2从66.4%和83.2%精确匹配到100.0%。 这些结果显示,在上下文之前放置痕迹可以改善长文字推理,同时保留因果变压器结构.

articles.title: DKL: Decoupled Knowledge Learning for Instruction-Tuned Language Models
articles.content: RAG has become the de facto method for incorporating new, corpus-specific knowledge into an instruction following LLM (Instruct LLM). Although RAG-based prompting improves factual grounding, it fails when retrieval is incorrect or incomplete, leading to hallucinations. Finetuning methods such as RAFT and PA-RAG enhance RAG by injecting new knowledge into the model's parameters, but require generating a massive amount of synthetic QA that covers the entire corpus. Extended Pre-Training (EPT) on the text corpus avoids the need for comprehensive synthetic data generation but compromises an Instruct LLM's instruction-following capabilities, necessitating instruction fine-tuning (IFT) after pre-training. However, IFT is costly and may be infeasible due to the unavailability of an instruction-tuning corpus. In this work, we propose DKL-Decoupled Knowledge Learning for Instruction-Tuned Language Models. Instead of doing EPT on the Instruct LLM, DKL performs EPT on its corresponding base LLM to infuse new knowledge. These knowledge infused weights are then merged with the Instruct LLM, imparting new knowledge without affecting their instruction-following capabilities. DKL is a lightweight method that avoids expensive instruction fine-tuning and relies on model merging to infuse the new knowledge into the Instruct LLM without destroying its instruction following capabilities. Empirical results show that DKL improves RAG accuracy from 54.17 to 79.26 on retrieval failure cases, while outperforming prior approaches with substantially less training data.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DKL: 教学知识学习的脱钩语言模型
articles.content_zh: RAG已成为将新的、针对具体实体的知识纳入LLM(LLM指示)之后的教学的实际方法。 虽然基于RAG的提示可以改善事实基础,但在检索不正确或不完整时失败,导致幻觉. RAFT和PA-RAG等微调方法通过将新知识注入模型的参数来增强RAG,但需要产生大量的合成QA,涵盖整个体. 关于文本库的扩展预培训(EPT)避免了全面合成数据生成的需要,但损害了指导LLLM的教学跟踪能力,需要在预培训后进行教学微调。 然而,IFT费用高昂,由于缺少指示调试程序,可能不可行。 在这项工作中,我们提出DKL-Decoupled Knowledge Learning for discription-Tuned Language Models. DKL没有在指令LLM上做EPT,而是在相应的基底LLM上进行EPT来注入新知识. 这些知识注入的权重随后与指导性LLM合并,传授新的知识而不影响其遵循教学的能力。 DKL是一种轻量级方法,它避免昂贵的指令微调,依靠模型将新知识融合到指令LLM中,而不会破坏其跟随能力的指示. 经验结果显示,DKL在检索失败的情况下提高了RAG的准确度,从54.17提高到79.26,同时在培训数据少得多的情况下,比以往的做法表现好。

articles.title: From Tokens to Semantics: Leveraging Complementary Signals for Hallucination Detection in Black-Box LLMs
articles.content: When LLMs support public-facing or high-stakes workflows, missed fabrications can harm users and institutions, while false alarms consume limited human-review capacity. When no trusted context or reference document is available, we study two signals accessible through black-box model APIs: semantic entropy, which measures disagreement among sampled response meanings, and uncertainty derived from token log-probabilities. Their failure modes can be complementary: semantic entropy becomes uninformative when responses form one semantic cluster, while token uncertainty can miss consistently confident errors. We extend token-based uncertainty detection by aggregating token-level signals across sampled responses through our TopK method, evaluate the hybrid CoCoA method, which combines target-response uncertainty with semantic dissimilarity, and propose and study two supervised methods: Gated, which routes single-cluster cases to an aggregated-token-feature classifier, and Stacked, which learns jointly from semantic uncertainty and broader token features. We evaluate seven benchmarks, including five public benchmarks (four text datasets and multimodal handwritten-cheque extraction) and two constructed benchmarks (Financial Summaries and Long-Text QA), using four language models. In our evaluation across models and datasets, Stacked gave the best performance in nearly half of the cases, while TopK and CoCoA remain competitive without supervised training labels, although their thresholds require careful calibration. No method is universally strongest. We therefore evaluate performance at false-positive-rate budgets from 1% to 15%, assess their sensitivity to generation and calibration choices, and examine variation across dataset characteristics.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从托肯斯到语义学:利用辅助信号在黑盒LLMs中进行幻觉检测
articles.content_zh: 当LLMS支持公交或高收视率的工作流程时,错失的捏造会伤害用户和机构,而假警报则消耗有限的人审查能力. 在没有可信赖的上下文或参考文件时,我们研究通过黑盒模型API可以访问的两个信号:语义式的entropy,它测量抽样反应含义之间的分歧,以及从符号对数概率中得出的不确定性. 他们的失败模式可以互补:当反应形成一个语义集群时,语义 en会变得不灵,而符号不确定性则会错失一贯的自信错误. 我们通过我们TopK方法汇总所有抽样反应的符号级信号,扩大基于符号的不确定性检测,评价混合CoCoA方法,将目标-响应不确定性与语义差异相结合,并提出并研究两种监督方法: Gated,它将单个集群案例引导到一个集合语系特征分类器,Stacked,它从语义不确定性和更广泛的符号特征中共同学习. 我们评价了7项基准,包括5项公共基准(4项文本数据集和多式联运手写提取)和2项构建的基准(财务摘要和长文本QA),使用4种语言模式。 在我们对各种模型和数据集的评价中,Stacked在近一半的案例中表现最好,而TopK和CoCoA则保持竞争力,没有监督培训标签,尽管其门槛要求仔细校准。 没有一种方法是普遍最强的。 因此,我们用1%至15%的不实率预算来评估业绩,评估其对生成和校准选择的敏感性,并审查不同数据集特征的差异。

articles.title: oHC: Orthogonal Hyper-Connections on SO(4) via Quaternions
articles.content: Hyper-Connections (HC) replace the single residual stream of a Transformer with $n$ parallel ones, mixing them at every layer with a learned $n \times n$ residual matrix. Leaving that matrix unconstrained places no limit on the factor by which the mixing step rescales the residual streams, and that factor compounds across layers, which destabilizes training. Manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) address this by restricting the matrix to the doubly stochastic matrices. That caps the factor at one, so the mixing can no longer amplify any direction, but nothing bounds it from below. We prove that inside this set the mixing step can reduce the norm of the residual streams only by shrinking the differences between the streams, while their mean is left unchanged; and since the reduction accumulates over layers, the streams grow more alike and their diversity is spent with depth. We therefore propose Orthogonal Hyper-Connections (oHC), restricting the residual matrix to the rotation group $SO(n)$, so that the mixing step can neither amplify nor attenuate the residual streams in any direction, which keeps training stable and no longer forces the differences between the streams to contract. Specifically, at the four streams used by recent HC models we parameterize the group in closed form by a pair of unit quaternions, which adds no parameters, replaces the iterative projection with a fixed pattern of signed additions, and can be constructed faster than mHC. We evaluate oHC across a comprehensive set of downstream tasks, where it outperforms the single-stream residual baseline, mHC and iHC, which fixes the residual matrix to the identity.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: (单位:千美元) HC:通过Quaternion在SO(4)上的垂直超连接
articles.content_zh: Hyper-Connections(HC)将变形器的单个残余流替换为$n$并行流流流,在每一层都与一个学到的$n\times n$的残余矩阵混合. 使该基体不受限制,对混合步骤调整残余溪流规模的因素和层层复合因素没有限制,这破坏了训练。 通过将矩阵限制在双层结构矩阵中来解决这一问题。 这把因素限制在一个上面, 所以混合不能 扩大任何方向, 但没有什么从下面。 我们证明,在这个集合中,混合步骤只能通过缩小各流之间的差别来降低残余流的常态,而其平均值则保持不变;并且,由于这些流的积聚层层,因此这些流的增殖更加相似,其多样性被用在深度上. 因此,我们提议使用正弦超连接(oHC),将剩余基质限制在转动组$SO(n)$,这样混合步骤既不能放大,也不能减轻任何方向的剩余流,从而保持培训稳定,不再迫使各流之间的差异缩小。 具体地说,在最近HC模型所使用的四个流中,我们用一对单位之四nion对组进行封闭式参数化,它不添加参数,用一个固定的签名添加图案取代迭代投影,并且可以比mHC更快构造. 我们评价了一套全面的下游任务中的oHC,它的表现超过了单流残留基线,mHC和iHC,它们将剩余基质固定在身份上.

articles.title: WinoQueer-NL: Assessing Bias in Dutch Language Models toward LGBTQ+ Identities
articles.content: While English language models have been widely examined for anti-queer bias, Dutch models remain understudied. To address this gap, we developed a culturally and linguistically adapted Dutch dataset based on the English WinoQueer benchmark, containing pairs of stereotypical and counter-stereotypical sentences. To validate and expand it, we conducted an online survey with 43 Dutch queer participants, confirming 145 of 171 stereotypes as culturally relevant and identifying 22 new biases through free-text responses. The final released dataset, comprising 42,906 sentences, was evaluated using a range of Dutch-specific and multilingual models, including both masked language models (MLMs) and autoregressive language models (ARLMs), with bias measured via a score comparing log-likelihoods of stereotypical versus counter-stereotypical sentences. While the mean bias score across models appeared neutral (~50%), closer analysis revealed significant disparities: some models favored stereotypical sentences up to 97% of the time for transgender identities, but only 6% of the time for gay-related pairs, with transgender and non-binary identities consistently receiving the highest bias scores. Our findings highlight the importance of culturally grounded datasets for evaluating and mitigating biases that disproportionately impact marginalized groups in Dutch language models.

articles.title_zh: WinoQueer-NL:在荷兰语言模式中评估比亚斯对LGBT-X的身份
articles.content_zh: 虽然英语模式被广泛研究抗泻性偏差,但荷兰模式仍然研究不足. 为了弥补这一差距,我们开发了一个基于英语WinoQueer基准的文化和语言调整的荷兰数据集,包含一对陈规定型和反定型的句子。 为了证实和扩大这一范围,我们与43名荷兰同性恋者进行了在线调查,确认171个定型观念中145个具有文化相关性,并通过自由文本答复查明22个新的偏见。 最终发布的数据集包含42,906句,使用一系列荷兰特有的多语种模型进行了评价,包括蒙面语言模型(MLM)和自递性语言模型(ARLMs),通过比对定型句与反定型句的对日志的相似性来衡量偏差. 虽然不同模型的平均偏差得分看起来是中性的(~50%),但更仔细的分析揭示了显著的差别:一些模型倾向于对变性人身份做出长达97%的定型判决,但对与同性恋有关的对等人来说只有6%的时间,变性人和非二进制身份始终获得最高的偏差分数. 我们的调查结果强调,基于文化的数据集对于评价和减轻荷兰语言模型中不成比例地影响边缘化群体的偏见十分重要。

articles.title: Loom: Weaving Diagnostic Strands into Free-Text Consensus via Embedding-Space Reweighting
articles.content: Aggregating noisy, conflicting textual hypotheses into a reliable consensus is a fundamental challenge when deploying NLP systems in real-world industrial settings. While monolithic Large Language Model (LLM) agents offer unbounded expressivity for tasks like Root Cause Analysis (RCA), they suffer from context limits, compounding hallucinations, and prohibitive inference latency. Traditional weak supervision offers statistical rigor but is mathematically restricted to discrete classes. We present Loom, a generative consensus framework deployed for real-world RCA that bridges these paradigms. Loom aggregates open-form hypotheses emitted by modular heuristics (diagnostic templates dynamically populated with episode-specific entities, times, and metrics) by projecting them into a continuous embedding space, and resolves conflicting signals with an iterative centroid-based reweighting algorithm. The resulting consensus weights ground a single lightweight LLM synthesis step. Evaluated on the OpenRCA benchmark, Loom occupies the accuracy--efficiency Pareto frontier: it matches a state-of-the-art autonomous agent on Bank and Market-2 and trails on Market-1 and Telecom, while using a single LLM call per incident on all four datasets ($\sim$26$\times$ faster; $\sim$33$\times$ with an 8B-parameter synthesizer). We discuss our deployment experience, highlighting lessons learned regarding the trade-offs between agentic depth and inference latency, negative results in redundancy detection, and how deterministic consensus fosters trust among Subject Matter Experts~(SMEs).
