articles.title_zh: Loom:通过嵌入空间再加权将诊断棒编织成自由文本共识
articles.content_zh: 在现实世界的工业环境中部署NLP系统时,将吵闹、相互矛盾的文字假设综合到可靠的共识中是一项根本性的挑战。 虽然单体大语言模型(LLM)代理为Root Cause Analysis(RCA)等任务提供无约束的表达力,但他们却受到上下文限制,使幻觉复合,以及令人无法忍受的推论延缓. 传统的薄弱监管提供了严格的统计,但数学上仅限于离散类别。 我们向大家介绍Loom,这是为现实世界的RCA部署的一个基因共识框架,它弥合了这些范式。  Loom 聚合通过投影到连续嵌入空间中,通过模块化的heuristics(诊断模板动态地包含各集特定实体,时间,和度量衡)所释放的开式假说,并用一个迭代的基于中间行星的重量算法来解决相互冲突的信号. 由此产生的共识权重为单一轻量级LLM合成步骤打下了基础. 根据OpenRCA基准评估,Loom占据了精确效率的Pareto前沿:它匹配银行和市场2上最先进的自主代理以及市场1和电信上的线索,同时在所有四个数据集上每起事件使用一次LLM呼叫(26美元\时间更快;33美元\时间用8B参数合成器)。 我们讨论了我们的部署经验,强调了在代理人深度与推断延迟之间的权衡、冗余探测的负面结果以及确定共识如何促进主题专家之间的信任方面的经验教训。

articles.title: TaRA: Training-Aware Low-Rank Adaptation Initialization
articles.content: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a de facto standard for parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), yet its performance is highly sensitive to initialization due to the information bottleneck imposed by low-rank decomposition. Existing approaches attempt to construct high-quality LoRA initializations by exploiting principal components of pretrained weights, activations, or gradients. However, these methods do not directly account for the training dynamics of the full-rank model. In this paper, we propose Training-aware Low-Rank Adaptation Initialization (TaRA), a method that initializes LoRA such that the gradients induced by the low-rank factors closely approximate the gradient of the corresponding full-rank weight matrix. Derived from a mathematical formulation, TaRA improves gradient fidelity at the start of training while introducing negligible computational overhead. Across diverse and challenging fine-tuning tasks, TaRA consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods, establishing a simple, robust, and scalable solution for effective LoRA initialization.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TRA: 培训-了解低辐射适应初始化
articles.content_zh: Low-Rank适应(LORA)已经成为参数效率微调(PEFT)的事实上的标准,然而由于低排名分解带来的信息瓶颈,其性能对初始化高度敏感. 现有方法试图通过利用预先训练的重量、激活或梯度的主要成分来构建高质量的LORA初始化。 然而,这些方法并没有直接说明全等级模式的培训动态. 在本文中,我们提出培训认识低Rank适应初始化(TRA),这种方法将LORA初始化,这样低等级因素引起的梯度就与相应的全等级权重矩阵的梯度相近. 根据数学公式,TaRA在培训开始时提高梯度忠诚度,同时引入可忽略不计的计算间接费用。 在整个多样化和具有挑战性的微调任务中,TaRA的绩效始终高于以往最先进的方法,为有效的LORA初始化建立了一个简单、有力和可扩展的解决办法。

articles.title: Scalable Direction-Following TTS via Voice Impression-Guided Pseudo Triplet Construction
articles.content: Voice actors often re-read the same script while modifying their delivery in response to performance directions. We study this setting as direction-following TTS, where a system generates a new utterance that reflects a given direction relative to a reference utterance while preserving speaker identity and linguistic content. A key challenge is the lack of training data capturing such relative modifications. To address this, we propose a scalable pseudo-triplet construction pipeline that generates~(reference utterance, direction text, modified utterance) triplets. It generates controlled style variations using an impression-controllable TTS model and uses an LLM to produce natural language directions from estimated impression differences. Experimental results demonstrate that pseudo-triplets alone enable stable speaker-preserving modification, and that combining pseudo and recorded data further improves direction alignment while maintaining speaker similarity. Audio examples are available on our demo page https://ntt-hilab-gensp.github.io/IS2026pseudo/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过Voice Impression-Guided Pseudo Triplet 构建可扩展方向跟踪 TTS
articles.content_zh: 语音演员经常在修改其交付时根据表演方向重读相同的剧本. 我们研究这个环境作为方向跟踪TTS,在这个环境中,一个系统产生一种新的语句,反映相对于参考语的某一方向,同时保留扬声器身份和语言内容. 一项关键挑战是缺乏掌握这些相对修改的培训数据。 为了解决这一问题,我们建议采用可伸缩的伪三重构管线,生成~(参考语句,方向文本,修改语句)三重音. 它使用可印象控制的TTS模型生成可控制的风格变化,并使用LLM从估计的印象差异中生成自然语言方向. 实验结果表明,单是伪三聚体就能够进行稳定的保留扬声器修改,将伪数据与记录数据结合起来,在保持扬声器相似性的同时进一步提高了方向一致性. 音频实例见我们的示范网页https://ntt-hilab-gensp.github.io/IS2026pseudo/。

articles.title: Predictors of Loneliness in Older Adults Using Multimodal Analysis of Speech and Language
articles.content: Loneliness is a critical public health issue among older adults, linked to higher risks of depression, cognitive decline, and mortality. Scalable, objective methods for its detection remain limited, particularly in natural conversational contexts. We analyzed speech and language markers of loneliness in 310 older adults using semi-structured telephone interviews to help understand how they process feeling lonely and how their language differs at different levels of feeling loneliness. Our multimodal framework combined linguistic features (psycholinguistic dictionaries, n-grams, and topic models) with acoustic features (pitch, tone, loudness) to examine associations with self-reported loneliness scores. Both predefined and data-driven methods captured patterns in verbal content and vocal delivery. Higher loneliness was associated with negations(r = 0.11), negative tone(r = 0.12), and conflict-related language. Lower loneliness was linked to social references(r = -0.18), motivational drives(r = -0.11), and emotional richness in speech(r = -0.12). We also found that the multimodal model (r = 0.298) outperforms the text-only and audio-only models. Findings suggest that loneliness manifests through both linguistic and acoustic cues, supporting the potential of speech-based analysis in psychological assessments and as an early indicator of emotional loneliness when used alongside existing assessments, rather than as standalone diagnostic tools.

articles.title_zh: 使用多种语言和语言分析的老年人孤独感预测器
articles.content_zh: 孤独是老年人的一个重要公共卫生问题,与抑郁症、认知下降和死亡率的较高风险有关。 可扩展、客观的检测方法仍然有限,特别是在自然对话背景下。 我们用半结构的电话访谈来分析310个老年人中孤独的言语和语言标记,以帮助了解他们如何处理孤独感,以及他们的语言在不同孤独感层次上的差异. 我们的多式联运框架将语言特征(心理语言词典,n-grams,以及主题模型)与声学特征(pitch,语气,高音)结合起来,以检查自报孤独分数的关联. 预先定义和数据驱动的方法都捕捉到口头内容和语音表达中的规律. 更高的孤独与否定(r = 0.11)、负面语调(r = 0.12)以及与冲突有关的语言有关。 较低的孤独感与社会参考(r = -0.18),激励驱动(r = -0.11),以及情感丰富的言语(r = -0.12)有关. 我们还发现,多式联运模式(r = 0.298)优于文本模式和音频模式。 研究结果表明,孤独通过语言和声学提示表现出来,支持在心理评估中进行基于语言的分析的潜力,以及作为与现有评估一起使用的情感孤独的早期指标,而不是作为独立的诊断工具。

articles.title: When Persona Attributes Improve Population Alignment in Large Language Models
articles.content: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to predict the responses of human participants in survey panels. Towards that goal, persona prompting has recently emerged as a technique to inform and align large pretrained language models. Persona prompting refers to the practice of using short textual descriptions of 'personas' in prompts to steer the LLM's generations. Personas describe individuals through different attributes such as their socio-demographics, attitudes, or behaviors, with the aim of aligning LLMs to produce responses that correlate with the corresponding human responses. Yet, recent work has produced mixed and partly conflicting results of persona prompting without clear patterns of success and failure. Among the few consistent findings is that the selection of persona attributes matters, and that using more attributes does not necessarily lead to better performance. It remains unclear how different attribute selection methods perform and how to choose among them. In this paper, we propose that observed human response variation of a survey question is a potential explanation for the mixed performance observed so far. In addition, we compare the performance of persona prompting associated with different methods for selecting persona attributes. We evaluate these methods on four different (general) social surveys across two countries, six LLMs, and twenty prediction tasks per survey. Our work helps to identify when persona prompting can be expected to be useful in survey prediction tasks, and provides new insights on the effectiveness of different attribute selection methods for LLM-based survey prediction using persona prompting.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当Persona 属性改善大语言模型中的人口配比时
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)越来越多地用于预测人类参与者在调查小组中的反应. 为了实现这一目标,最近出现了一种诱导人心的技巧,用以通报和调整经过培训的大型语文模式。 Persona 提示是指在提示中使用“permanas”的简短文字描述来引导LLM的几代人的做法. Personas通过不同的属性,如社会人口、态度或行为来描述个人,目的是调整LLMS,以产生与人类相应反应相关的反应。 然而,最近的工作产生了因人而异、部分冲突的结果,没有明显的成败模式。 少数一致的调查结果包括:人物属性的选择很重要,使用更多的属性并不一定能导致更好的性能. 仍然不清楚的是,不同的属性选择方法是如何运作的,以及如何在其中作出选择。 在本文中,我们提议,观察到的人类对调查问题的反应变化是迄今所观察到的好坏参半的可能解释。 此外,我们比较了与选择人属性的不同方法相关的人物提示的性能. 我们在两个国家的四项不同的(一般的)社会调查中评估这些方法,6项有限责任公司调查,20项每项调查的预测任务。 我们的工作有助于确定人们何时可以预期在调查预测任务中促进人的作用,并使人们对不同属性选择方法的有效性有新的见解,以便利用人来进行基于LLM的调查预测。

articles.title: Debias-SparseGPT: Bias-Aware Pruning for Large Language Models
articles.content: Model compression techniques such as pruning and quantization facilitate the efficient deployment and acceleration of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, recent studies show that weight sparsification methods, such as SparseGPT, can amplify existing biases in models, with outputs varying significantly depending on persona cues in the prompt. In this paper, we introduce Debias-SparseGPT, a post-training pruning method incorporating representational debiasing using a second-order term defined over demographically contrasting inputs. We perform empirical validation of our method over a wide range of generative LLMs. Across models and sparsity regimes (25%, 50%, and structured 2:4 sparsity), Debias-SparseGPT consistently reduces pruning-induced bias compared to SparseGPT while preserving model perplexity and zero-shot accuracy. Under the most restrictive 2:4 structured sparsity pattern, which most aggressively degrades model quality, augmenting the calibration set with long-context, content-rich examples further improves both downstream performance and fairness. Overall, Debias-SparseGPT advances the bias-performance trade-off while preserving the computational efficiency of sparse models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Debias-SparseGPT: Bias-Aware Pruning 用于大语言模型
articles.content_zh: 推算和量化等模型压缩技术有利于大语言模型(LLM)的有效部署和加速. 然而,最近的研究表明,诸如SparseGPT等重力溅射法可以扩大模型中现有的偏差,其输出量因人物提示而有很大差异。 在本文中,我们介绍了Debias-SparseGPT,这是一种培训后调试方法,采用二顺序术语定义,而不是人口对比投入。 我们用经验验证我们的方法 来验证各种遗传性有限责任公司 与SparseGPT相比,Debias-SparseGPT在模型和sparsity系统(25%、50%和结构化的2:4sparsity)中始终减少推挤引起的偏差,同时保持模型的偏差和零射精度。 在最限制性的2:4结构化的垃圾邮件模式下,内容丰富的实例进一步提高了下游的性能和公平性,这种模式使模型质量急剧下降,使套装的校准更加贴切。 总体而言,Debias-SparseGPT推进了偏差-性能权衡,同时保持了稀疏模型的计算效率.

articles.title: ViSAR: Training-Free Adaptive-$k$ Retrieval for Visual Document Question Answering
articles.content: Document Visual Question Answering (DocVQA) often leverages Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), where late-interaction encoders are commonly used to identify document pages relevant to a user query, before answer generation by a Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM). Existing approaches typically retrieve a fixed top-$k$ number of pages regardless of query complexity, which increases LVLM latency and may degrade answer accuracy. We introduce ViSAR (Visual Semantic Activation Retrieval), a training-free adaptive-$k$ retrieval method for late-interaction visual document retrieval. ViSAR operates directly in the embedding space to construct a query-conditioned page-level similarity matrix that highlights query-relevant semantics and dynamically determines the number of pages to retrieve. Across multiple encoders and LVLMs, ViSAR retrieves compact, query-adapted page sets that reduce RAG latency by up to 58.7\%, while maintaining or improving answer accuracy compared with fixed top-$k$ and adaptive retrieval heuristics. Furthermore, we show that the similarity matrix structure correlates with answer accuracy, suggesting future directions for retrieval quality-aware document understanding.

articles.title_zh: ViSAR:可视文件答题的免费培训适应性检索
articles.content_zh: 文档可视化问答(DocVQA)经常会利用检索-增强生成(RAG),其中后期交互编码器通常用于识别与用户查询相关的文档页面,而后再由大型视觉-语言模型(LVLM)生成答案. 现有方法通常可以检索固定的顶美元页数,而不论查询的复杂程度如何,这会增加LVLM的活度并可能降低答题的准确性。 我们采用Visual语义活性检索法(Visual Semanic Actionivation Retrieval),这是一种免费的适应性检索方法,用于后期交互视觉文件检索. ViSAR在嵌入空间中直接运行,以构建一个有查询条件的页面级类似矩阵,突出与查询相关的语义并动态地决定要检索的页面数量. 通过多个编码器和LVLM,VISAR检索了紧凑的,经过查询调整的页面集,可以将RAG的空闲度降低到58.7%%,同时与固定的上行元和适应性检索高压相比,保持或提高答案的准确性. 此外,我们表明,相似性矩阵结构与答案的准确性相关,为了解质量的文件提出未来方向。

articles.title: How LLMs Build Fictional Worlds: Setting and Narrative Space in AI-Generated Creative Storytelling
articles.content: In this paper, we analyze how Large Language Models (LLMs) employ worldbuilding strategies, focusing on setting as one measurable dimension of storyworld construction. We compare 1,000 AI-generated stories per model in English and German with human-authored fiction from Project Gutenberg. Building on prior work, we operationalize setting through five types of narrative space: "action", "perceived," "visual," "descriptive" and "no space", identified using fine-tuned BERT classifiers for German and English. We generate narratives using GPT 4.1, LlaMA 3.3, Mistral 3.2, and Gemma 3 and compare their spatial distributions to a human-authored baseline. We find that human-authored texts predominantly employ "action space," grounding narratives in embodied character-environment interaction, whereas LLMs systematically overproduce "perceived space," emphasizing atmosphere and affect. This divergence remains stable across narrative time. Overall, our findings show that LLMs exhibit worldbuilding patterns that differ consistently from human-authored fiction in ways that are both model-specific and language-sensitive.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LLMS 如何构建虚构世界: AI-Generated Creative Storyteling中的设置和叙述空间
articles.content_zh: 在本文中,我们分析大语言模型(LLMs)如何运用世界建设战略,侧重于将故事世界构建设定为可衡量的一个层面. 我们用英语和德语将每个模型的1000个AI生成的故事与Gutenberg项目中的人造小说进行比较. 在先前工作的基础上,我们通过五种类型的叙事空间进行实际设置:"动作","透视","视觉","描述性"和"没有空间",用精细的BERT分类器对德语和英语进行识别. 我们用GPT 4.1,LlaMA 3.3,Mistral 3.2,和Gemma 3生成叙事,并将其空间分布与人类授权的基线进行比较. 我们发现,人类撰写的文本主要使用“行动空间”,将叙事定位在体现的性格-环境互动中,而LLMS则系统地过度生产“感知空间”,强调大气层和影响。 叙述期间的这种分歧仍然稳定。 总体而言,我们的调查结果表明,法学硕士课程展现的世界建设模式与人类编著的虚构作品在模式上和语言上都具有一致性。

articles.title: PragAlign: Feedback-Guided Pragmatic Alignment for Controlled Synthetic Dialogue Generation
articles.content: Synthetic dialogue generation can support research in privacy-restricted service settings, but generated conversations must preserve communicative intent, affective meaning, and natural dialogue flow. We introduce PragAlign, a feedback-guided framework for controlled synthetic dialogue generation conditioned on service context, target intent, and target emotion, with auxiliary trait-style controls. PragAlign uses a generate--evaluate--revise loop in which an LLM-based evaluator scores intent alignment, emotion alignment, coherence, fluency, and aggregate quality, then provides criterion-specific feedback for up to three refinement rounds. On 800 matched dialogue specifications, PragAlign achieves 99.50\% evaluator-defined acceptance, compared with 72.25\% for one-shot generation and 95.88\% for repeated generation without structured feedback. This indicates that repeated attempts account for much of the gain over one-shot generation, while structured feedback primarily improves last-mile multi-constraint satisfaction rather than broad average quality. Refinement gains are concentrated in emotion alignment, which is also the dominant failure mode in ablations. A separate human evaluation of 1,200 generated dialogues shows that intent expression and dialogue flow are highly recognizable to annotators, while emotion appropriateness is less stable and more subjective. These results support PragAlign as a quality-control framework for improving evaluator-defined communicative constraint satisfaction, while showing that affective realization and independent human-perceived quality remain open challenges.

articles.title_zh: PragAlign: 为控制合成对话框生成提供反馈指导的实用对齐
articles.content_zh: 合成对话生成可以支持隐私限制服务环境的研究,但生成的对话必须保持沟通意图,情感意义,以及自然对话流. 我们引入了PragAlign,这是一个以服务背景、目标意图和目标情感为条件的控制合成对话生成的反馈指导框架,带有辅助特性式控制。 PragAlign使用生成-评价-重置环路,其中基于LLM的评价者对意图对齐,情感对齐,一致性,流畅度,以及总体质量进行评分,然后为最多三轮的完善提供具体标准的反馈. 在800个匹配的对话框规格上,PragAlign实现了99.50QQ评价者定义的接受,而一弹一代则达到72.25XX,重复一代则达到95.88XX,没有结构化反馈. 这表明,多次尝试在一弹一发中获得了很大收益,而结构化反馈主要提高了最后一英里的多节制满意度,而不是广泛的平均质量。 完善增益主要集中在情感对齐上,这也是爆发中最主要的失败模式. 对1200个生成的对话进行单独的人评价表明,意向表达和对话流对注释者来说是高度识别的,而情感的适宜性则不太稳定,更主观. 这些成果支持PragAlign作为质量控制框架,以改善评估者界定的沟通约束满意度,同时表明,情感实现和独立的人-感知质量仍然是公开的挑战。

articles.title: Learning to Fuse LLMs with Ontology Rankers for Rare-Disease Diagnosis
articles.content: Ontology rankers remain useful for rare-disease diagnosis because each candidate can be traced to matched patient phenotypes. Large language models (LLMs) can generate differential diagnoses from the same patient description, but their predictions lack an equally clear evidence trail. Rather than asking which system should replace the other, we ask whether an LLM can improve the ranker without giving up its evidence. Our behavior-based fusion model examines the two ranked lists, their agreement, and the ontology support behind each candidate, and learns how much to rely on each system for the individual case. Before comparison, we remove a documented test-set leakage pathway caused by benchmark cases and ontology annotations being derived from the same publications. Across eight open LLMs, fusion improves Phenomizer Recall@1 by 7.86 percentage points on Phenopacket Store and 20.18 points on RAMEDIS. When paired with DeepSeek-V4-Flash through an API, a fusion model trained only on the other LLMs improves Recall@1 from 0.1657 to 0.2176, a 5.19-point gain, without retraining. For 90.8% of correct fused diagnoses, the disease retains candidate-level ontology evidence that can be inspected. These results show that LLMs can strengthen an established diagnostic tool without discarding the structured evidence that makes it useful.

articles.title_zh: 向Fuse LLMs学习小病诊断的肿瘤学兰花
articles.content_zh: 肿瘤分级器仍然可用于罕见病症诊断,因为每个考生都可以被追踪到对应的患者酚型. 大语言模型(LLMs)可以从同一位病人的描述中产生差异诊断,但其预测缺乏同样清晰的证据线索. 我们不问哪个系统应该取代另一个系统,而是问一个LLM是否能够在不放弃证据的情况下改进等级表. 我们基于行为的聚变模型检查了两个排名列表,他们的协议,以及每个候选人背后的本体学支持,并学习每个系统对单个案例的依赖程度. 在进行比较之前,我们删除了由基准案例和来自同一出版物的本体学说明造成的有记录的测试套漏损路径。 在八个开放的LLMs中,聚变使Phenomizer Recall@1在Phenopacket Store上提高了7.86个百分点,在RAMEDIS上提高了20.18个百分点。 在通过API与DeepSeek-V4-Flash配对时,一个只接受其他LLMs训练的聚变模型将Recalls@1从0.1657提高到0.2176,这是5.19分的增益,没有再培训. 对于90.8%的正确的引信诊断,该疾病保留了可检查的候选肿瘤证据。 这些结果显示,LLMS可以加强一个既定的诊断工具,而不丢弃结构化的证据,使其有用.

articles.title: Scalable Kronecker-Fisher Approximation: Efficient Hessian Analysis for Billion-Parameter Language Models Compression
articles.content: In this paper, we propose a scalable Kronecker-based approximation that captures cross-layer interactions without storing the entire Fisher matrix, enabling practical Hessian analysis for billion-parameter networks where full computation is infeasible. Our approach reveals consistent vulnerability patterns: value projection layers exhibit the highest sensitivity and strongest cross-layer correlations across multiple model families, while other components exhibit architecture-specific behaviors. Through extensive experiments on quantization, sparsification, inter-layer corruption, and post-corruption fine-tuning, we demonstrate that our approximation strongly correlates with both performance degradation and recovery. Our framework provides a practical, theoretically grounded tool for identifying fragile components in large models, opening new avenues for guided compression and optimization strategies, such as mixed-precision allocation, layer-wise sparsity, and adaptive low-rank decomposition across layers and even individual weight groups.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 可缩放 Kronecker- Fisher 近似: 高效的Hessian 分析 亿-帕雷米特语言模型压缩
articles.content_zh: 在本文中,我们提出了一个基于Kronecker的可伸缩近似法,在不存储整个Fisher矩阵的情况下,捕捉到跨层相互作用,从而能够对十亿参数网络进行实用的黑森分析,因为完全计算不可行。 我们的方法揭示了一贯的脆弱性模式:价值投射层在多个模型家族中表现出最高的敏感性和最强的跨层关联性,而其他组件则表现出结构特定的行为. 通过大量关于量化、抽筋、层际腐败和腐败后微调的实验,我们表明,我们的近似与性能退化和复原密切相关。 我们的框架为识别大型模型中的脆弱成分提供了实用的,基于理论的工具,为引导压缩和优化策略开辟了新的途径,如混合精度分配,层层分解,以及不同层甚至单个重量组的适应性低位分解.

articles.title: When Decodability Is Not Enough: Logical Validity Representations, Behavioral Dissociation, and Causal Tests in Language Models
articles.content: Large language models can look capable of logical reasoning, but correct or incorrect answers alone tell us little about what the model represents internally. We study logical verification in five open-weight transformer models using matched valid--invalid premise--claim pairs that vary across inference families, semantic domains, templates, and difficulty levels. Despite near-chance behavioral performance, logical validity is often almost perfectly decodable from hidden states and remains strongly decodable under held-out templates, domains, and inference families. Validity also remains highly decodable on behaviorally incorrect examples in the conditions where correctness-conditioned evaluation is well defined. At the same time, exhaustive leave-one-out tests reveal clear limits to this generalization, and interventions along probe-derived validity directions have only weak, nonspecific effects compared with random controls. Our results suggest that representing validity, expressing it in behavior, and using it causally are distinct. Validity related information can be strongly decodable from a model's hidden states without being reliably expressed in its output.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当解码性不够:逻辑有效性表示、行为分离和语言模型的因果关系测试
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型可以看起来能够逻辑推理,但只有正确或不正确的答案并不能告诉我们模型在内部代表什么. 我们研究5个开放量级变压器模型的逻辑验证,使用匹配的无效前提-要求对,它们因推论家族,语义域,模板,和难度级别而异. 尽管行为表现近乎奇异,逻辑有效性往往几乎完全可以从隐藏状态解码,在被搁置的模板,域和推论家族下仍然可以强烈解码. 在正确性条件评价得到明确定义的条件下,在行为不正确的例子上,有效性仍然非常可解码。 与此同时,详尽无遗的 " 一一 " 试验揭示了这种概括性的明确限制,与随机控制相比,在探针衍生有效性方向上的干预只能产生薄弱的非特定影响。 我们的结果表明,代表有效性、在行为中表达有效性以及因果使用有效性是不同的。 有效性相关信息可以从模型的隐藏状态中强烈解码,而不在其输出中可靠地表达.

articles.title: UTP-Bench: Uncertainty-aware Travel Planning Benchmark
articles.content: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated strong capabilities in automated travel itinerary generation. However, real- world travel planning is inherently uncertain: transportation delays, crowd fluctuations, and unexpected stochastic delays frequently inval- idate otherwise feasible schedules. Existing benchmarks like TravelPlanner and TripCraft assume deterministic environments, evaluating only static constraint satisfaction and ignoring whether generated plans remain robust when such uncertainties arise. To address this limitation, we introduce UTP-Bench1 , a large-scale benchmark for uncertainty-aware travel planning. The dataset integrates real-world travel data spanning 504 cities of India, including attractions, restau- rants, accommodations, and multi-modal trans- portation networks. To model realistic disrup- tions, UTP-Bench incorporates empirical delay distributions and crowd-density patterns col- lected from major cities, enabling evaluation of travel plans under stochastic conditions. We further propose three evaluation metrics, namely Buffer Adequacy Score (BAS), Crowd- Aware Timing Score (CATS), and Transport Delay Absorption Score (TDAS), which quan- tify the ability of generated itineraries to main- tain robustness against transit delays and crowd variability. Experiments with state-of-the-art LLMs like GPT-5, Qwen3, Mistral and Phi-4 re- veal substantial gaps between model-generated and human-authored plans, particularly in tem- poral buffering, delay-aware transportation scheduling, and crowd-sensitive planning.

articles.title_zh: UTP-Bench:不确定-意识不足的旅行规划基准
articles.content_zh: 大型语文模型(LLMS)最近在自动旅行行程生成方面显示出强大的能力。 然而,现实世界旅行规划本身就不确定:交通延误、人群波动、以及意外的时空拖延 -- -- 在其他方面可行的时间表。 旅行规划员和TripCraft等现有基准假定了决定性的环境,只评价静态制约的满意程度,并忽略了在出现这种不确定性时产生的计划是否仍然有力。 为解决这一限制,我们引入了UTP-Bench1,这是了解不确定性的旅行规划的大规模基准。 数据集综合了涵盖印度504个城市的实时世界旅行数据,包括景点、restau-rants、住宿和多式联运网络。 为了树立现实的混乱模式,UTP-Bench纳入了经验性延迟分布和人群密度模式,这些模式由各大城市共同讲述,从而得以在扭曲的条件下评价旅行计划。 我们进一步提出三个评价指标,即缓冲充足计分(BAS)、人群意识计时计分(CATS)和交通延迟吸收计分(TDAS),这些衡量标准使生成的行程在抵御过境延误和人群变化方面主要保持稳健能力。 与GPT-5、Qune3、Mistral和Phi-4等最先进的LLMs进行实验,在模型生成的计划和人力开发的计划之间再次出现巨大差距,特别是在tem-poral缓冲、延迟意识运输调度和对人群敏感的规划方面。

articles.title: Before the Script, Set the Stage: How Worldview Simulation Amplifies Psychologically Grounded Persuasion in Multi-Turn Jailbreaking
articles.content: Multi-turn jailbreak attacks demonstrate that harmful intent can be distributed across dialogue, yet existing methods obscure what conversational mechanisms drive vulnerability. We introduce BLUEPRINT, a safety-evaluation framework separating a factorized social-influence strategy space from WORLDVIEWSIM, a cross-turn situational context module. Monte Carlo Tree Search optimizes turn-level combinations of 18 theory-grounded influence factors across a four-turn trajectory. Across six frontier models, BLUEPRINT achieves near-ceiling ASR on major open-weight and proprietary models, while requiring the fewest average queries (2.46). The resulting trajectories further reveal model-specific vulnerability among resistant targets: each responds to distinct influence factors and strategy transitions, yet all share a common recovery pathway-shifting toward concrete, executable task framing consistently escapes hard-refusal states. Ablations confirm operational cues matter most: making requests actionable has the largest impact, gain framing is unusually potent, and some legitimacy appeals can backfire. These findings suggest robust multi-turn safety requires monitoring not only harmful content, but also how dialogue state makes unsafe requests appear concrete and locally executable.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在脚本之前,设定阶段:世界观模拟如何放大多轮监狱破解中的心理说服力
articles.content_zh: 多轮越狱攻击表明,有害的意图可在对话中传播,但现有方法掩盖了哪些对话机制造成脆弱性。 我们引入了BLUEPRINT,这是一个安全评价框架,将一个因素化的社会影响战略空间与WorldVIEWSIM(一个跨回合情况背景单元)相分离。 蒙特语Name 卡罗 树搜索优化了18个理论基础影响因子的回合级组合,跨越了4个回合轨迹. 在六个前沿模型中,BLUEPRINT在主要的开放重量和专有模型上实现了接近上限的ASR,同时要求平均查询最少(2.46)。 由此产生的轨迹进一步揭示了抵制目标中模式特有的脆弱性:每个目标都对不同的影响因素和战略过渡作出反应,但都有一个共同的恢复途径,转向具体、可执行的任务框架,始终摆脱了困难的状态。 拖延证实行动提示最为重要:使请求可以采取行动产生最大影响,收益框架异常有力,一些合法性呼吁可能适得其反。 这些调查结果表明,强有力的多回合安全不仅需要监测有害内容,而且需要监测对话状态如何使不安全请求显得具体和可以在当地执行。

articles.title: Improving Health Literacy through Lay Summarization of Radiological Reports: An Evaluation of BioNER and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.content: Radiology reports are written primarily for clinicians, and their specialized terminology often makes them difficult for patients to interpret. As a result, many patients turn to publicly available Large Language Models (LLMs) to help explain their reports, despite well-documented risks of factual inaccuracies and hallucinations. Automated lay-summary generation has emerged as a promising alternative, yet the effectiveness of retrieval-enhanced and clinically informed approaches for radiology-specific communication remains underexplored. This study investigates the extent to which Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Named Entity Recognition (NER) improve the quality, factual consistency, and readability of automatically generated lay summaries compared with standard LLM-based generation. We develop a framework combining NER-based extraction of clinically relevant findings with a RAG mechanism for contextual grounding, evaluated across few-shot and fine-tuned variants of two models (Qwen, BioBART). Results show that NER consistently improves readability and overall quality, while RAG alone offers no benefit and can introduce hallucinations from irrelevant retrieved terms. Combining RAG with NER degrades performance in few-shot settings but improves readability when fine-tuned. Fine-tuned BioBART with NER achieves the best overall performance, highlighting entity-aware extraction as the primary driver of improved patient-friendly summaries.

articles.title_zh: 通过对辐射报告进行总结来提高健康素养:对生物NER和回收-强化一代的评价
articles.content_zh: 放射科报告主要是为临床医生撰写的,其专业术语往往使患者难以解释. 因此,许多患者转向公开的"大语言模型"(LLMs)来帮助解释他们的报告,尽管有充分的记载存在事实不准确和幻觉的风险. 自动非总结生成已经成为一种有希望的替代方法,然而,在放射学特定通信方面,改进的和临床上知情的检索方法的有效性仍然没有得到充分利用。 本研究调查了与基于LLM的标准生成相比,检索增强型生成(RAG)和命名实体识别(NER)提高自动生成的编目摘要的质量、事实一致性和可读性的程度。 我们开发了一个框架,将基于NER的临床相关结果提取与用于背景定位的RAG机制相结合,对两种模型(Quen, BioBART)的几发和微调变体进行评价。 结果显示NER不断提高可读性和整体质量,而光是RAG是没有好处的,能够从不相关的检索术语中引入幻觉. 将RAG与NER结合,在几发环境中降解性能,但微调后可读性得到提高. 用NER进行精细校正的BioBART实现最佳的整体性能,突出实体意识提取是改进的方便病人摘要的主要驱动力.

articles.title: PolERo: Studying Political Evasion in Romanian
articles.content: Political evasion refers to responses that engage with a question while withholding the requested information. Recent NLP work frames political evasion as a classification task using a two-level taxonomy of response clarity and fine-grained evasion strategies. Existing work on response clarity and evasion classification is limited to English, leaving open whether the taxonomy and model behavior transfer across languages and political contexts. We introduce PolERo, a dataset of 3,574 human-annotated question-answer pairs extracted from official transcripts of five Romanian presidents. We evaluate multiple classification approaches on both datasets under matched conditions, including TF-IDF baselines, fine-tuned encoder models, a proposed sliding-window encoder, and zero/few-shot LLM prompting. We study cross-lingual transfer through joint bilingual training and machine-translation-based data augmentation. Our results indicate that fine-tuned encoders are competitive, cross-lingual transfer is asymmetric, and ambivalent evasion categories involving pragmatic cues remain the main challenge across all model families.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 波列罗:学习罗马尼亚政治疏散
articles.content_zh: 政治逃避是指在拒绝提供所要求的信息的同时提出问题的答复。 近期NLP工作将政治逃逸作为分类任务,采用反应清晰度和精细的逃逸策略的两级分类法. 现有关于反应清晰度和逃逸分类的工作仅限于英语,使得分类学和模式行为是否跨语言和政治背景的转移存在争议. 我们介绍Polero,这是从罗马尼亚五位总统的官方笔录中提取的3 574个人类附加说明的问答组合。 我们评价两个数据集在相应条件下的多个分类方法,包括TF-IDF基线,微调编码器模型,一个拟议的滑窗编码器,以及零/ few-shot LLM提示. 我们通过联合双语培训和基于机器的翻译数据扩充,研究跨语言的转移。 我们的结果显示,微调编码器具有竞争力,跨语言的传输不对称,涉及务实提示的矛盾性逃逸类别仍然是所有示范家庭的主要挑战。

articles.title: MultiGhostBench: A Multilingual Benchmark for Long-Form LLM-Generated Text Attribution under Distribution Shifts
articles.content: While existing work on LLM authorship attribution (AA) has made progress, available benchmarks remain limited, often focusing on English, controlled settings, or relatively outdated models, with the few multilingual studies considering only relatively short texts. We introduce MultiGhostBench, a multilingual benchmark comprising 928 books generated by five recent LLMs across six languages and three scripts, with an average length of approximately 59K words per book. The benchmark supports evaluation under domain, author, and language shifts. Evaluation of representative AA methods shows that no single method consistently performs best across settings, and performance generally degrades under distribution shifts. Transformer-based detectors can retain generator-related information across languages, although transfer effectiveness varies by language pair, whereas statistical and fingerprint-based detectors are more language-dependent. We envision MultiGhostBench as a valuable resource for the development and evaluation of robust AA methods. The dataset and code can be found at https://github.com/GrecoMT/MultiGhostBench.

articles.title_zh: MultiGhost Bench: 分布式移动下长期 LLM 生成文本的多种语言基准
articles.content_zh: 虽然关于LLM作者归属(AA)的现有工作取得了进展,但现有基准仍然有限,往往侧重于英语,受控设置,或相对过时的模式,少数多语种研究只考虑相对较短的文本. 我们采用MultiGhost Bench这一多语种基准,由最近5种语言的LLMS和3种文字生成的928本书组成,每本书平均长度约59K字. 该基准支持域下的评价,作者和语言的转变. 对具有代表性的AA方法的评价表明,没有一个单一方法在不同的环境之间一贯发挥最佳效果,在分配变化中,性能通常会下降。 基于变形器的检测器可以保留不同语言的生成器相关信息,虽然传输效果因语言对等而异,而基于统计和指纹的检测器则更依赖语言. 我们设想,“多鬼奔驰”是制定和评价强有力的自动取款法的宝贵资源。 数据集和代码见https://github.com/GrecoMT/MultiGhost Bench。

articles.title: NE-R1: Enhancing Named Entity Recognition Model via Reinforcement Learning
articles.content: Named Entity Recognition (NER) has achieved substantial progress since the advent of large language models (LLMs). Nevertheless, the recognition of long-tail and domain-specific entities remains challenging due to the deficiency in parametric knowledge. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) offers a promising remedy by injecting external knowledge, but it also introduces noise and unnecessary cost when dealing with familiar cases. In this paper, we propose NE-R1, a novel framework for adaptive retrieval-augmented NER. We design a "retrieval-on-demand" mechanism for NER. Then we integrate it into models by a two-stage training method: (1) multi-task instruction tuning initialization; (2) end-to-end RL optimization with CoT. To achieve reasonable selection between parameterized and external knowledge, we design a multi-dimensional reward considering both accuracy and retrieval benefit. NE-R1 achieves state-of-the-art performance on various benchmarks, with an average F1 score gain of 2.52% in in-domain evaluation and 1.18% in zero-shot cross-domain evaluation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: NE-R1:通过强化学习加强命名实体识别模式
articles.content_zh: 命名的实体识别(NER)自大型语言模型(LLM)出现以来取得了实质性的进展. 然而,由于参数化知识的不足,对长尾和具体领域实体的承认仍然具有挑战性。 检索增强的生成(RAG)通过注入外部知识提供了有希望的补救,但在处理熟悉的案件时,它也带来了噪音和不必要的费用。 在本文中,我们提出NE-R1,这是适应性检索强化NER的新框架. 我们设计了NER的"按需检索"机制. 然后通过两级训练方法将其整合到模型中:(1)多任务指令调试初始化;(2)端对端RL优化与CoT. 为了在参数化和外部知识之间实现合理的选择,我们设计了一个多维奖励,既考虑到准确性,也考虑到检索利益. NE-R1在各种基准上实现了最先进的性能,在域内评价中F1的平均得分收益为2.52%,在零镜头跨域评价中为1.18%.

articles.title: SonicCaps: Large-Scale Diverse and Fine-Grained Captioning for Improved Audio-Retrieval
articles.content: Recent advances in audio-language modeling have been driven by large-scale audio captioning datasets. However, existing datasets remain limited by low semantic diversity, generic descriptions lacking acoustic details, and one-to-one audio-caption mappings that poorly reflect the inherent ambiguity of auditory perception. We introduce SonicCaps, a large-scale audio captioning dataset comprising ~15M captions paired with ~700k audio clips, generated using a multi-modal large language model (Qwen3-Omni) conditioned on both audio and text. To explicitly promote diversity, we generate around 24 captions per audio via structured prompt engineering and few- shot generation, spanning main descriptions, rephrased variants (verbosity, style) and semantic tags. Human evaluation shows that SonicCaps is rated significantly higher than existing captioning datasets, with fine-grained analyses indicating that our captions are perceived as more descriptive and precise, which strongly correlates with quality judgments. Finally, training CLAP models on SonicCaps with a multi-caption sampling strategy consistently improves audio retrieval and zero-shot classification, with stronger generalization across public and commercial benchmarks. We release both SonicCaps and two specialized CLAP models on hugging face: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Zineb/SonicCaps.

articles.title_zh: 音效能力:用于改进音频检索的大型分型和精细说明
articles.content_zh: 音频语言建模的近期进展是由大规模音频字幕数据集驱动的. 然而,现有的数据集仍然受到低语义多样性的限制,通用描述缺乏声学细节,以及一对一的音频封装映射不能很好地反映听觉感知的固有模糊性. 我们介绍SonicCaps,这是一个大型音频字幕数据集,由~15M字幕与~700k音频剪辑对齐组成,使用基于音频和文本的多式大语言模型(Qune3-Omni)生成. 为了明确促进多样性,我们通过结构化的即时工程和少镜头生成,在主要描述、重写变体(动词、风格)和语义标记中,每个音频生成大约24个字幕。 人类评价显示,SonicCaps的评分大大高于现有的字幕数据集,精细分析显示,我们的字幕被视为描述性更强、更准确,这与高质量的判断密切相关。 最后,采用多封装取样策略对Sonic Caps的CLAP模型进行培训,不断改善音频检索和零镜头分类,在公共和商业基准中更加普及。 我们发布了SonicCaps和两个专门的CLAP模型关于拥抱面部:https://huggingface.co/datasets/Zineb/SonicCaps.

articles.title: SALA: Semantic-Aware Logical Alignment for Complex Reasoning in In-Context Learning
articles.content: Effective in-context learning (ICL) for complex reasoning relies on selecting the right demonstrations. Traditional retrieval methods based on surface similarity fail to capture the underlying problem-solving logic. Recent logic-based methods address this by matching predefined reasoning steps, but the rigid rules and exact-match criteria is improper to handle flexible or diverse reasoning processes. To address the problem, we propose SALA, a Semantic-Aware Logical Alignment framework. Instead of relying on a fixed inventory, SALA automatically learns task-specific reasoning operations. It then embeds these operations into a continuous semantic space and uses dynamic time warping (DTW) to align the reasoning sequences. This approach allows for soft, flexible matching of reasoning logic while remaining highly interpretable. Experiments across four reasoning benchmarks and three LLMs demonstrate that SALA outperforms existing demonstration selection methods. Further analysis confirms the roles of the operation induction and the logical semantic alignment.

articles.title_zh: SALA: 语义学- 智能逻辑对齐 复合语境学习中的复杂原因
articles.content_zh: 对复杂推理的有效内文学习依赖于选择正确的演示. 基于表面相似性的传统检索方法无法捕捉到基本的解决问题逻辑. 最近基于逻辑的方法通过匹配预先定义的推理步骤来解决这个问题,但刚性的规则和精确匹配的标准对于处理灵活或多样的推理过程是不适当的. 为了解决这一问题,我们提议采用语义学-认知逻辑对齐框架——SALA。 SALA不依靠固定的盘点,而是自动学习任务特定推理操作. 然后将这些操作嵌入一个连续的语义空间,并使用动态时间摆动(DTW)来对齐推理序列. 这种方法允许对推理逻辑进行软而灵活的匹配,同时保持高度可解释性. 跨越四个推理基准和三个LLMs的实验表明,SALA优于现有的示范选择方法. 进一步的分析证实了操作感应和逻辑语义对齐的作用.
